summary: The SEC approved the 27th amendment to the National Market System LULD Plan, creating temporary overnight price band protections for trading centers operating overnight. The measure is the first phase of a two-phase approach for overnight trading, with further plan amendments expected later. Trading centers operating during overnight protected hours must implement the new framework when it takes effect.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form N-8B-2
summary: The SEC seeks comments on extending the existing Form N-8B-2 information collection for unit investment trusts under the Investment Company Act. The notice does not change the form’s requirements, but asks for feedback on burden, utility and ways to reduce filing burden by October 9, 2026.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form N-17f-2
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on the extension of Form N-17f-2, the administrative filing used with Rule 17f-2 for funds’ custody-of-assets examinations. The notice describes the current reporting/recordkeeping burden and asks for comments by 2026-10-09. It does not itself change the rule or the form requirements.

title: Vivisol / Air Liquide (home oxygen services business) merger inquiry
summary: The CMA is inviting comments on Vivisol’s proposed acquisition of Air Liquide’s home oxygen services business in the UK. Interested parties can submit views during the phase 1 invitation-to-comment period, which closes in late September 2026. This is part of the CMA’s merger information-gathering process, not a final decision or binding rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of applications for bank holding company formation, acquisitions and mergers under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-10 on the listed application to acquire additional voting shares of Heartland State Bancorp and indirectly Heartland State Bank.

title: Innovation Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced an Innovation Advisory Committee public meeting for August 20, 2026. The committee will discuss crypto assets, artificial intelligence and prediction markets, and the public may submit comments by August 27, 2026. No rule or obligation is created by this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Transaction Fees at Options 7, Section 3, Note 18
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change, effective on filing, to increase certain Penny Symbol Taker Fees for Market Makers and Non-Nasdaq GEMX Market Makers under Options 7, Section 3, note 18. The SEC is soliciting comments. The filing is operative on 2026-08-03, and the notice was published on 2026-08-11.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 3100, Interpretation and Policy .06, To Reduce the Waiting Periods for Retaking FINRA Qualification Examinations
summary: MIAX Pearl filed and immediately made effective a rule change reducing the waiting periods for retaking failed FINRA qualification exams under Exchange Rule 3100. The change applies to Exchange members and associated persons who must pass representative or principal qualification exams. No separate compliance date is stated beyond immediate effectiveness.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 515A Related to PRIME and cPRIME Functionality
summary: MIAX filed and immediately made effective a proposed rule change to amend Exchange Rule 515A for PRIME and cPRIME auctions. The change removes the initiating price from RFR messages, so only option, side, and size will be disseminated. MIAX expects to implement the functionality in Q3 2026 and will later announce the exact date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 1900, Interpretation and Policy .06, To Reduce the Waiting Periods for Retaking FINRA Qualification Examinations
summary: The SEC is publishing an immediate-effectiveness filing by MIAX proposing to amend its exchange rule on FINRA qualification exams. The change would shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed exams for exchange members and associated persons. It is not yet a final rule, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 1900, Interpretation and Policy .06, To Reduce the Waiting Periods for Retaking FINRA Qualification Examinations
summary: MIAX Emerald filed a proposed rule change to shorten the waiting periods for retaking FINRA qualification exams under Exchange Rule 1900. The SEC is soliciting comments, so the change is not yet final. It would affect Exchange members and associated persons who take the SIE and representative/principal exams.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Establish a Guaranty Fund at the Government Securities Division
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on FICC’s proposed rule change to create a Guaranty Fund at the Government Securities Division. The fund would add prefunded resources to cover member default and certain non-default losses and would change how clearing fund deposits are treated. No compliance date is set because this is a proposal, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing and Extension of the Review Period of an Advance Notice, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Establish a Guaranty Fund at the Government Securities Division
summary: The SEC published notice of FICC’s advance notice to establish a guaranty fund at the Government Securities Division, and extended the review period while soliciting comments. This is not a final rule; it affects central clearing arrangements for U.S. government securities and related repo transactions. No compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proposed Rule Change To Modify the GSD Rules To Adopt a U.S. Treasury Clearing Trade Submission Requirement
summary: The SEC published a notice extending its review period for FICC’s proposed rule change to require Netting Members to submit eligible U.S. Treasury secondary market transactions for central clearing. No new substantive rule is adopted here; the SEC says it will act by 2026-10-07.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.280 (Limit Up-Limit Down Plan and Trading Halts on the Exchange) To Reflect That IEX Will Not Cancel Outstanding Orders During a Regulatory Halt or Operational Halt in Anticipation of the SIP Implementation of the New Regulatory Halt Rules
summary: IEX filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing subject to SEC notice, to amend its halt rule so it will not cancel outstanding orders during a regulatory or operational halt. The filing reflects anticipated SIP implementation of new halt rules and is relevant to exchange trading operations and rule management. Comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Offer Additional Tickets Under the Exchange's Rodeo Program and Re-Open the Application Window for the Rodeo Program; and Permit Sponsored Participants To Participate in the Rodeo Program Together With a Sponsoring Member of the Exchange as Joint Participants
summary: The SEC published notice of a proposed Texas Stock Exchange rule change to expand the Rodeo Program, reopen the application window, and allow sponsored participants to join as joint participants. It is a notice soliciting comments, not the rule itself, so it does not directly create obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 1900, Interpretation and Policy .06, To Reduce the Waiting Periods for Retaking FINRA Qualification Examinations
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing but still open for comment, to shorten the waiting periods for retaking FINRA qualification exams under Exchange Rule 1900. It affects exchange members and associated persons who must pass representative or principal examinations. No firm deadline is stated in the excerpt, but the filing is published for comments and can be acted on now.

title: Strategic review of CMA markets remedies
summary: The CMA is conducting a strategic review of 33 market remedies, with a provisional decision consultation open until 11 September 2026 and a final decision due in October 2026. It covers remedies across several sectors, including financial services. Firms affected by CMA undertakings or orders may want to assess whether any remedy changes could affect their business.

title: Provisional decision: strategic review of CMA markets remedies
summary: The CMA has published a provisional decision in its strategic review of legacy markets remedies, proposing to revoke, release or vary a range of existing Enterprise Act remedies and undertakings. The document is a consultation-style interim decision and does not itself change obligations yet. Firms affected by the named remedies should monitor the final order and any notice periods.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is inviting public comments on an application by PBI Holdings, Inc. to become a bank holding company by acquiring Premier Bancshares, Inc. and indirectly Premier Bank National Association. Comments must be submitted by 2026-09-11. This is an application notice, not a rule or approval.

title: Renewal of the Innovation Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced renewal of its Innovation Advisory Committee for two years. The committee will advise on technological innovation, new technologies, and related issues in derivatives and commodities markets; it does not itself impose new requirements on firms.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Numismatic Products
summary: The US Mint announced retail prices for certain 2026 numismatic gold and clad products, effective 2026-08-14. It also noted that precious-metal product pricing may be adjusted weekly based on the LBMA gold price average.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to Foreign Status and U.S. Withholding Certifications
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an extension of the existing information collection for Forms W-8 and related foreign status and U.S. withholding certifications. There are no changes to the burden or filing requirements in this notice. Comments are due by 2026-10-13.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Application for Determination for Employee Benefit Plan
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form 5300, used by eligible plan sponsors to seek determination letters for certain employee benefit plans. Comments are due by 2026-10-13. The notice updates burden estimates but does not change substantive tax or plan qualification rules.

title: Regan Capital Alternative Income Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief allowing certain BDCs, closed-end funds and open-end funds to co-invest with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-01. This is a notice only; it does not itself create new obligations.

title: Source Capital and First Pacific Advisors, LP
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Source Capital and First Pacific Advisors seeking exemptive relief under the Investment Company Act to allow certain closed-end funds to make more frequent capital gain distributions. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-01. This is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Increase the Discounted External Distribution Fee for the EDGX Top Feed Available Under the Exchange's Existing Small Retail Broker Distribution Program From $750 per Month to $1,250 per Month
summary: The SEC notice invites comments on Cboe EDGX’s proposed rule change to raise the discounted external distribution fee for its EDGX Top Feed under the Small Retail Broker Distribution Program from $750 to $1,250 per month. It also makes conforming and clarifying fee-schedule updates. This affects eligible broker-dealers and takes effect immediately on filing, subject to the SEC process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Pursuant to IEX Rule 15.110(a) and (c) To Amend the Exchange's Fee Schedule Applicable to Members To Modify IEX's Incremental Fee Tiers and To Make Organizational Changes to the Fee Schedule in Preparation for the Launch of IEX Options Later This Year
summary: IEX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule, including new incremental fee tier mechanics and moving certain fees into a separate additional-fees schedule ahead of IEX Options launching later this year. The fee changes were effective on filing and implemented on 2026-08-01. The SEC notice also invites comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Rules Relating to Trading Permit Holder (“TPH”) Transaction Reporting Duties
summary: Cboe Exchange filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Trading Permit Holder transaction reporting rules and correct a cross-reference in Rule 6.1. The filing clarifies reporting duties for open outcry trades and states that electronic trades already captured by the system do not require extra post-execution reporting. It is effective on filing, with SEC comments solicited.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; Conversions From Mutual to Stock Form
summary: The OCC is requesting comments on renewal of its Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for mutual-to-stock conversions by savings associations. This does not change the underlying conversion rules, but comments are due by 2026-10-13 and the OCC says it will issue a second 30-day notice after this 60-day comment period.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a bank control notice inviting comments on an application under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for several individuals to join a control group and retain voting shares of a bank holding company and its subsidiary bank. Comments are due by 2026-08-28. This is a notice of an application, not a new rule.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced an open Sunshine Act meeting for August 14, 2026, at which it will consider whether to propose new rules for a tailored offering regime for certain crypto asset investment contracts. This is a public meeting notice only and does not itself create obligations.

title: Reopening of Comment Period; Notices of Request for Exemptive Relief, Pursuant to Section 36(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, From Certain Aspects of Rule 17ad-22(e)(18)(iv) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Requests for Comment
summary: The SEC reopened the comment period on exemptive relief requests from aspects of Rule 17ad-22(e)(18)(iv), which requires certain U.S. Treasury securities covered clearing agencies to mandate submission of eligible secondary market transactions. This affects foreign financial institutions that are direct participants and trade with non-U.S. clients, as well as related repo and affiliate exceptions. No new obligations are imposed yet; comments are sought on the relief requests.

title: Program for Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Pursuant to Rule 17d-2; Notice of Filing and Order Approving and Declaring Effective an Amendment to the Plan for the Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Among NYSE American LLC, Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc., the Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc., Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc., Cboe Exchange, Inc., Nasdaq ISE, LLC, Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc., NYSE Arca, Inc., The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, BOX Exchange LLC, Nasdaq Texas, LLC, Nasdaq PHLX LLC, Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC, Nasdaq GEMX, LLC, Nasdaq MRX, LLC, MIAX PEARL, LLC, MIAX Emerald, LLC, MIAX Sapphire, MEMX LLC, MX2 LLC, and Investors Exchange LLC Concerning Options-Related Market Surveillance
summary: The SEC issued a notice and order approving an amendment to a Rule 17d-2 plan that reallocates options-related market surveillance responsibilities among multiple U.S. exchanges and FINRA. It affects participating self-regulatory organizations and common members, and became effective on the order date. No new compliance obligations are created for ordinary bank activities.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 30b1-7 and Form N-MFP
summary: The SEC is requesting comments on extending the existing PRA collection for Rule 30b1-7 and Form N-MFP, which requires money market funds to file monthly portfolio reports electronically. This is an information-collection notice, not a new rule, and it affects registered money market funds. No new compliance date is stated; the collection remains mandatory for in-scope funds unless extended by OMB approval.

title: AMG BBH Asset-Backed Credit Fund, LLC, et al.; August 10, 2026.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief allowing certain business development companies and closed-end management investment companies to co-invest with affiliated entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-04. This is a notice, not the order itself, so it does not yet change obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the PHLX Pricing Schedule at Options 7, Sections 2 (Customer Rebate Program) and 4 (Multiply Listed Options Fees)
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options pricing schedule, including customer rebate tiers and multiply listed options fees. The notice invites SEC comments, and the pricing changes are operative from 2026-08-03. It affects exchange members and member organizations trading PHLX options.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Market Maker Quoting Obligations
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change to amend its options market maker quoting obligations by aggregating quoting activity for Primary Market Makers and Preferred Market Makers associated with the same member. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal; no binding change is made yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the LCH SA CaLM Minimum Cash Collateral Requirement and to LCH Liquidity Risk Policy
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on LCH SA’s proposed rule change to its CDS Clearing Rules and Liquidity Risk Policy. The change would introduce a minimum cash collateral floor for certain clearing member house accounts and make related collateral-management clarifications. It is not yet effective and would apply only if approved by regulators.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 14.1 Regarding Information Circular Requirements
summary: MEMX filed and the SEC published a proposed rule change, effective immediately for filing purposes, to amend Rule 14.1 on UTP exchange-traded products. The exchange would remove its duplicate pre-trading information circular requirement, add cross-references to customer recommendation/disclosure rules, and revise written-description requirements. This is a proposal open to comment, not a binding final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Criteria for Underlying Securities
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on Nasdaq ISE’s proposed rule change to amend options listing criteria for underlying securities, specifically to align options rules with updated standards for Commodity-Based Trusts holding digital commodities. This is a proposal only, so there is no immediate compliance date, but comments are being solicited from interested persons.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Market Maker Quoting Obligations
summary: The SEC is publishing a Nasdaq PHLX proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, that would amend options market maker quoting obligations by aggregating quoting activity for certain Lead Market Makers and Directed Market Makers affiliated with the same member organization. It is a request for comment rather than a final rule, and no specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: nexfibre / Substantial merger inquiry
summary: The UK CMA has accepted a fast-track reference request and referred Liberty Global/Telefónica/InfraVia’s proposed acquisition of nexfibre’s target business to a phase 2 merger investigation under the Enterprise Act 2002. This is a competition-law procedural decision affecting the parties to the transaction, with no new substantive obligations for the wider market.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for proposed acquisitions of voting shares of Docking Bancshares Inc. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-31. This is a public notice and comment request, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of a pending application for 7 Gen Holdings, Inc. to become a bank holding company by acquiring Legacy Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-14. This is an application/public notice rather than a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Regulatory Agenda
summary: The CFPB published its 2026 regulatory agenda, listing matters it expects to consider from January to November 2026, including possible reconsideration of its section 1071 small-business lending rule, personal financial data rights rule, and clarification of ECOA obligations. It is an informational agenda, not a rule or consultation, and creates no new requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Extend Collection 3038-0005
summary: The CFTC is seeking public comment on renewing OMB Control No. 3038-0005, covering information collections for commodity pool operators, commodity trading advisors, and monthly reporting by futures commission merchants. Comments are due by 2026-10-13. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a new rule, but it affects reporting and recordkeeping obligations tied to existing CFTC requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and any property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective from the August 7, 2026 action date.

title: Agenda
summary: Treasury’s regulatory agenda lists current and planned rules, including FinCEN proposals on customer due diligence, CIP requirements for investment advisers, and AML/CFT programs. It is an agenda/notice only, not a rulemaking itself. The item is informational and does not itself impose new obligations; the listed NPRMs and final rules would matter when later published.

title: Regulatory Flexibility Agenda
summary: The SEC published its semiannual regulatory flexibility agenda, listing rulemaking topics it expects to consider over the next 12 months and inviting public comment by 2026-09-14. It does not itself change requirements, but flags proposed-rule work across securities, investment company, and adviser areas, including disclosure, custody, crypto assets, and Form PF.

title: Order Granting Temporary Conditional Exemptive Relief to 24X National Exchange LLC From Certain Requirements of Rule 602 of Regulation NMS, Certain Requirements of Certain Equity Data Plans, and Section 19(g)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, Pursuant to Section 36 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rules 602 and 608 of Regulation NMS, To Permit Certain Overnight Trading, Subject to Certain Conditions, and Effective As of January 24, 2027 and Until the Earlier of (1) the date the Extended Hours Amendments Are Implemented or (2) July 2, 2027
summary: The SEC granted 24X National Exchange LLC temporary conditional exemptive relief from certain NMS data-plan and Exchange Act requirements so it can operate overnight trading sessions from 2027-01-24, subject to conditions. The relief runs until the earlier of implementation of the extended-hours amendments or 2027-07-02. It applies to 24X and the related market-data plan arrangements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Introduce a Small Retail Broker Distribution Program for the BZX Top Data Feed
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed SEC rule change to add a Small Retail Broker Distribution Program for the BZX Top Data Feed, giving eligible brokers a lower external distribution fee of $2,000 per month instead of $2,500. The program applies only to broker-dealers meeting specified retail-user thresholds. Comments were solicited; no exact comment deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Introduce the New One-Minute Interval Intra-Day Report
summary: NYSE American filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to add a new One-Minute Interval Intra-Day Report for options volume data. The new report would update every minute during the trading day and be available to subscribers within five minutes after each interval. This is a proposal/comment solicitation, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Transaction Fees at Options 7, Section 2
summary: Nasdaq filed a rule change to amend its options transaction fee and rebate schedule in Options 7, Section 2, including the Tier 5 rebate criteria for NOM Market Makers. The change is immediately effective and operative from 2026-08-03, so affected trading and fee-management teams should review pricing impacts now.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To Amend Rule 11.25 To Introduce an Optional, Contingent Instruction Applicable to Periodic Auction Only Orders, Introduce a Time-in-Force of Auction or Cancel, and Make Conforming Changes to Its Periodic Auction Processing Behavior To Support the Proposed Contingent Instruction
summary: The SEC has published notice of a Cboe BYX Exchange proposed rule change, as amended, and instituted proceedings to decide whether to approve or disapprove it. The proposal would add an optional contingent instruction for Periodic Auction Only Orders, add an Auction or Cancel time-in-force, and make related auction-processing changes. This is a consultation/comment process for market participants, not a final rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice that Silver Queen Financial Services, Inc. has applied to become a bank holding company by acquiring Colorado Federal Savings Bank. Interested persons may submit comments on the application by 2026-09-16.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for persons acting in concert to retain voting shares in First San Benito Bancshares Corporation, indirectly controlling First Community Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-01. This is a public notice of an ownership/control filing, not a rule change.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Authorization Agreement for Preauthorized Payment (SF 5510)
summary: The Treasury Department/Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on extending an approved Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for SF 5510, used to authorize preauthorized payments from financial institution accounts. Comments are due by 2026-10-16. This does not itself change any substantive regulatory requirement.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Annual Financial Statement of Surety Companies-Schedule F
summary: The Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking comments on extending the existing Schedule F information collection for Annual Financial Statement of Surety Companies. Surety companies involved in Federal surety bonds may be affected, with comments due by 2026-10-16. This is a paperwork burden notice, not a new substantive rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Taxpayer Experience Office Speaker Request
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection, the Taxpayer Experience Office Speaker Request, under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It does not change the form or requirements; comments are due by 2026-10-16. The notice applies to businesses and not-for-profit institutions that may submit the request.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of West Virginia Affected by Severe Storms
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief to help FDIC-supervised financial institutions recover from severe storms in West Virginia. It applies to all FDIC-supervised institutions, with particular relevance to those operating in the affected area. No specific compliance deadline or new rule is stated.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of Mississippi Affected by Tropical Storm Arthur
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief and recovery support for FDIC-supervised financial institutions in Mississippi affected by Tropical Storm Arthur. It is applicable immediately to all FDIC-supervised institutions in the affected area; no new filing date or hard compliance deadline is stated.

title: Parvin Decentralized Fund and Parvin Fund Management, LLC
summary: SEC notice of an application by Parvin Decentralized Fund and Parvin Fund Management seeking exemptive relief for a registered closed-end fund to use multiple share classes, early withdrawal charges, and asset-based distribution/service fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-07. This is a notice of a request, not a rule or order.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC published notice of a closed Sunshine Act Commission meeting on August 20, 2026. The notice gives the time, place, and general subject areas to be discussed, including enforcement and litigation matters, but it does not create any new obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Northern Lights Fund Trust and Ocean Park Asset Management, LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Northern Lights Fund Trust and Ocean Park Asset Management seeking exemptive relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure with ETF and mutual fund share classes. It is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order, so there is no direct obligation yet. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-08.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form N-2
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on an extension of the information collection for Form N-2, used by registered closed-end funds and BDCs to register securities and file amended registration statements. Comments are due by 2026-10-16. The notice explains the paperwork burden and says compliance with the disclosure requirements remains mandatory.

title: Elevation Series Trust and Norris Perné and French LLP
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Elevation Series Trust and Norris Perné and French LLP seeking exemptive relief to allow subadvisory agreements to be entered into or materially amended without shareholder approval and to relieve certain fee disclosure requirements. Interested parties may request a hearing by 2026-09-07. This is a notice, not a rule or order.

title: Stone Point Credit Income Fund and Stone Point Credit Income Adviser LLC
summary: SEC notice of an application by Stone Point Credit Income Fund and its adviser for exemptive relief to allow certain BDCs/closed-end funds to issue multiple share classes with different fees and sales loads. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-07. This is a notice of a request, not a rule or order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Pearl Options Exchange Fee Schedule Regarding the Routing Fee Table
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX PEARL’s proposed immediate rule change to amend its options fee schedule routing fee table. The change would add MX2 and IEX to the exchange groupings and rename Nasdaq BX Options as Nasdaq Texas Options. It affects MIAX Pearl members trading options, with comments solicited but no specific closing date stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Emerald Options Exchange Fee Schedule Regarding the Routing Fee Table
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on MIAX Emerald’s proposed fee schedule change for routed options orders. The exchange would update routing fee table groupings to add MX2 and IEX, reflect Nasdaq BX’s rename to Nasdaq Texas, and reassign MIAX Pearl to a different fee tier. No compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Sapphire Options Exchange Fee Schedule Regarding the Routing Fee Table
summary: The SEC has published notice of MIAX Sapphire’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options exchange fee schedule routing fee table. The changes add MX2 and IEX routing categories, reflect Nasdaq BX’s name change to Nasdaq Texas, and adjust MIAX Pearl’s fee tiers. It is effective immediately, with comments invited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Fee Schedule Regarding the Routing Fee Table
summary: The SEC published MIAX’s notice of a proposed exchange rule change that is immediately effective, amending the options routing fee schedule to add MX2 and IEX, update Nasdaq BX’s name to Nasdaq Texas, and shift MIAX Pearl between fee tiers. The filing was published for comment and affects exchange routing fees for MIAX members and routed customer orders.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Short Term Option Series Program Related to Qualifying Securities
summary: The SEC approved Nasdaq ISE’s rule change to expand the Short Term Option Series Program for exchange-traded fund shares. Eligible ETFs may now have up to two Tuesday/Thursday expirations under the existing criteria, and the exchange may also use new Tier 2 criteria for Monday/Wednesday expirations. The change is effective once the approved exchange rule becomes operative; no bank filing deadline is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Pearl Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Amend Certain Fees and Rebates Applicable to Transactions in Non-Penny Classes for Certain Origins
summary: MIAX Pearl filed a fee schedule amendment that immediately became effective under SEC exchange rule procedures. It changes maker rebates and taker fees for certain non-Penny options classes and origins. The change applies to MIAX Pearl options market participants, including market makers, firms, and other professional origins, with no separate compliance date stated in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Sapphire Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Amend Fees and Rebates for Professional Customer Orders for QCC and cQCC Transactions, and Establish a Tiered Fee Structure for Away Market Maker Facilitation of Customer QFOs or cQFOs
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX Sapphire’s proposed immediate rule change to its options exchange fee schedule. It would lower certain fees and rebates for Professional Customer QCC/cQCC trades and add a tiered fee structure for certain Trading Floor QFO/cQFO transactions. It is a proposal open for comment, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Fee Schedule To Modify Certain Volume Thresholds for the Priority Customer Rebate Program
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fee schedule by adjusting volume thresholds in the Priority Customer Rebate Program. The change affects MIAX members trading options and became effective upon filing, with comments solicited after publication. No specific compliance deadline is stated in the text beyond the filing and notice process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed rule change to amend its equities fee schedule, including removing Step-Up Tier 2, adding a new Single MPID Investor Tier, and dropping expired liquidity provision rates. The SEC is soliciting comments, and the exchange says it will implement the changes effective August 3, 2026. This affects firms trading on BZX.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change by The Options Clearing Corporation Concerning Amendments to Its Rules To Establish a Procedures-Based Approach for Determining Product Eligibility During Overnight or Extended Trading Sessions Utilizing Its Current ETH Risk Management Framework
summary: The SEC has published OCC’s proposed rule change to create a procedures-based approach for deciding which products can trade in overnight or extended trading hours using OCC’s existing ETH risk framework. It is a proposal open for comment, not a final rule. The change would affect OCC clearing arrangements for exchange-traded products and related exchanges, with no compliance date yet stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change to amend its fees schedule, including MGTN options transaction fees and changes to GTH VIX/VIXW and SPX/SPXW liquidity-maker incentive program quoting requirements. The SEC is seeking comments, and the filing is immediately effective under exchange rule-filing procedures. No new compliance deadline is stated, but trading and product teams should review fee impacts.

title: Designation of Databases to the Do Not Pay Working System
summary: Treasury has designated OpenCorporates’ U.S. legal entity dataset for inclusion in the Do Not Pay Working System, effective immediately. This affects screening/verification processes for entities using U.S. public registration data to prevent improper payments. No comment period remains open.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 2 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 2, To Amend Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual
summary: The SEC approved, on an accelerated basis, a NYSE rule change amending Section 802.01C of the Listed Company Manual. The change extends the effective date for the proposal from October 1, 2026 to July 1, 2027 and affects continued listing, cure and delisting procedures for listed companies. It is binding on NYSE-listed issuers once effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 4 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 4, To Amend Section 1003 of the NYSE American Company Guide
summary: The SEC approved, on an accelerated basis, NYSE American’s amended rule change to update Section 1003 of the Company Guide, which governs continued listing standards and delisting/suspension procedures. The change extends the proposal’s effective date from 2026-10-01 to 2027-07-01. It applies to issuers listed on NYSE American and is binding once effective.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17g-1 and Form NRSRO
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection for Rule 17g-1 and Form NRSRO, which govern NRSRO registration and ongoing disclosure. Public comments are invited within 30 days of publication, by 2026-09-18. This is a notice about paperwork burden and does not itself change the rule requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17g-2
summary: The SEC published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on extending the information collection under Rule 17g-2 for NRSROs. Comments are due by 2026-09-18. This is an administrative notice about paperwork burden and recordkeeping, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17g-1
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on extending the Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Rule 17g-1, which requires registered funds to maintain fidelity bonds and file related Form 17G materials. This is a notice and request for comment only; no new substantive rule change or deadline is created in the text.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17Ad-3(b)
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on extending the PRA information collection tied to Rule 17Ad-3(b) for registered transfer agents. It explains the estimated burden and comments are invited on necessity, accuracy, and ways to reduce burden. This is a notice and does not itself change the rule or create new obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form SF-3
summary: The SEC announced submission to OMB for extension of the existing information collection for Form SF-3, used by asset-backed securities issuers to register public shelf offerings. The notice invites public comments by 2026-09-18. No new substantive filing rule is created here.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form SF-1
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB review and public comment on extending the existing Form SF-1 information collection for asset-backed securities registration. Issuers using Form SF-1 should note the 30-day comment window ending 2026-09-18; the notice does not itself change filing requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form 6-K-Exchange Act Rules 13a-16 and 15d-16
summary: The SEC published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on extending the Paperwork Reduction Act clearance for Form 6-K under Exchange Act Rules 13a-16 and 15d-16. Foreign private issuers using Form 6-K are described as the affected filers. Comments are due by 2026-09-18.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced that an open meeting previously scheduled for August 14, 2026 was cancelled. This is a public notice only and does not create any new requirements or deadlines.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; National Securities Clearing Corporation; Order Approving of Proposed Rule Change To Enhance the Supplemental Liquidity Deposit Rules, Methodology and Processes
summary: The SEC approved an NSCC rule change that enhances how Supplemental Liquidity Deposits are calculated and collected, including methodology and process updates for members that generate higher liquidity needs. This is binding on NSCC members operating in the U.S. securities clearing system and affects liquidity/resource management requirements once the approved rule change becomes effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; CME Securities Clearing Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Amendments to the CMESC Stress Testing & Guaranty Fund Sizing Policy (or the “Policy”) and Proposed Amendments to Rule 402(b)
summary: The SEC published a notice of CMESC’s proposed rule change to amend its stress testing and guaranty fund sizing policy and Rule 402(b) for U.S. Treasury clearing. The changes add detail to stress scenarios, explain guaranty fund sizing and member allocation, and clarify the rulebook. This is a proposal open for comment; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Redemptions Service Guide and the Operational Arrangements (Necessary for Securities To Become and Remain Eligible for DTC Services)
summary: The SEC approved DTC’s proposed rule change to update its Redemptions Service Guide and Operational Arrangements. The changes make DTC’s Payment without Presentation process mandatory except where opt-out is necessary, remove some physical document requirements, allow automated notifications, and set retention/destruction rules for certificates. DTC participants, agents and issuers must follow the updated procedures once effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change of Amendments to Rules 7.31, 7.35, and 7.35B
summary: NYSE has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately under SEC procedures, to amend Rules 7.31, 7.35 and 7.35B on discretionary orders and closing auction mechanics. It would enhance auction imbalance information and change related processing for UTP securities. This is a proposed exchange rule change, not a final SEC rule, so firms should review and comment before implementation details settle.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Advance Notice Relating to The Options Clearing Corporation's Proposal To Amend the Evergreen Provisions Relating to Its Revolving Credit Facility
summary: The SEC published notice of OCC’s advance notice and is soliciting public comments on proposed changes to OCC’s revolving credit facility evergreen provisions. OCC wants to remove the need for a further advance notice before changing the facility’s lead or backup administrative agent, update the commitment amount, and make other non-substantive changes. No firm action date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Sections 303A.00 and 303A.07 of the NYSE Listed Company Manual
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on NYSE’s proposed rule change to extend the transition period for listed companies to establish an internal audit function from one year to five years. It would affect NYSE-listed companies, including newly listed issuers, but is not yet binding. Comments are being solicited under the SEC filing process; no closing date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Extend Collection 3038-0059: Part 41, Relating to Security Futures Products
summary: The CFTC is seeking public comment for 60 days on extending OMB Control No. 3038-0059 for Part 41 security futures product information collection requirements. Comments are due by 2026-10-19. This is a paperwork reduction notice, not a new rule, and applies to firms subject to the security futures reporting/recordkeeping requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Improving Customer Experience (OMB Circular A-11, Section 280 Implementation)
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection related to improving customer experience under OMB Circular A-11 Section 280. It updates burden estimates and invites comments by 2026-10-19. No new substantive requirements are created for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Annual Certification for Multiemployer Defined Benefit Plans
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on an unchanged extension of the information collection for the annual certification of multiemployer defined benefit plans (Form 15315). Comments are due by 2026-10-19. The notice concerns reporting burden only and does not change substantive requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend a Continued Listing Standard Relating to Beneficial Holders Applicable to Exchange Traded Fund Shares Listed Under Rule 17.104(b)(2)(B)
summary: The SEC published a notice extending the time to act on TXSE’s proposed rule change to amend a continued listing standard for ETF shares. The Commission set October 4, 2026 as the new deadline for approval, disapproval, or proceedings. This is a procedural notice only and does not itself change any rule or requirement.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Equity 4, Rule 4120 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: Nasdaq has filed an immediately effective rule change to update and conform its Equity 4, Rule 4120 trading-halt framework before the previously approved version becomes operative. The change is for Nasdaq members, issuers and market participants, and the operative date is August 10, 2026; the SEC notice solicits comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Equity 4, Rule 3100 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC published notice of Nasdaq PHLX’s proposed rule change to update Equity 4, Rule 3100 on trading halts so the text matches the exchange’s current operative rule and related cross-references. It is a notice seeking comments on an exchange filing, not a final rule. No direct obligation is created by the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of 3x Gold ETF, 3x Silver ETF, 3x Bitcoin ETF, 3x Ether ETF, 3x Crude Oil ETF, and 3x Natural Gas ETF, Each a Series of the VS Trust, Under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4) (Commodity-Based Trust Shares)
summary: The SEC published a notice of Cboe BZX’s proposed rule change to list and trade shares of several 3x commodity and crypto ETFs under its commodity-based trust shares rules. It is a request for comment, not a final rule. No filing deadline is stated in the excerpt; the main impact is on exchange-traded product listing and trading teams, with compliance and legal review.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Price List
summary: NYSE has filed an immediately effective rule change to its Price List, increasing the free volume threshold for Late D Orders at the close from 5.25 million to 10 million shares, effective August 11, 2026. The SEC is also soliciting comments on the filing. This affects NYSE member organizations and trading activity at the close.

title: FirstCash / Ramsdens merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has opened a Phase 1 merger inquiry and is inviting comments on FirstCash Holdings Inc.’s proposed acquisition of Ramsdens Holdings PLC. Interested parties can submit views on UK competition issues by 4 September 2026. This is an information-gathering step before any formal investigation, not a final decision or rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of a bank holding company application under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-09-21 on Meade Bancorp, Inc.’s proposal to retain voting shares of Bedford Loan and Deposit Bancorp, Inc. and indirectly Bedford Loan & Deposit Bank.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe C2’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule for certain Open-Close Data free trials. Instead of letting each requester choose any six-month historical window, all participants would receive the fixed period July 1, 2022 to December 31, 2022 for the three data products. Comments are solicited; the filing is already effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: Cboe EDGX filed a proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule so all free trials for its Open-Close Data products use the same fixed historical sample period, July 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022, instead of letting each requester choose any six-month window. The SEC notice solicits comments; the change is not yet final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change to amend the fee schedule for its Open-Close Data free trials. It would replace participant-selected six-month historical sample windows with a fixed sample period of July 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022 for three data products. The SEC is soliciting comments before the change becomes final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq Texas filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to remove several legacy fiber optic and wireless market data connectivity offerings from its fee schedule and to discontinue a previously proposed POD colocation service. The filing also updates the rulebook to reflect services already terminated. No customer action is stated, but the exchange is seeking comments and the changes are tied to terminations effective August 31, 2025 and September 30, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its connectivity schedule, removing several terminated fiber-optic and wireless market data connectivity offerings and discontinuing a previously proposed POD colocation offering. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing. The exchange states the removed services were already terminated or never implemented, with some terminations effective September 30, 2026 and prior wireless terminations effective August 31, 2025.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to remove obsolete connectivity and market data offerings, delete related fees and protocol text, and discontinue a previously proposed POD service. The changes affect Nasdaq connectivity customers and market data users, with some services terminating on 2026-09-30 and others already terminated. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing.

title: Eagle Point Credit Management LLC and Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company
summary: The SEC published a notice that Eagle Point Credit Management LLC and Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company have applied for exemptive relief to allow certain BDCs/closed-end funds to offer multiple share classes with varying sales loads and asset-based distribution or service fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-11. This is a notice of an application, not a rule.

title: Clearlake Private Markets Fund and Clearlake Capital RIC Management, LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Clearlake Private Markets Fund and Clearlake Capital RIC Management, LLC seeking exemptive relief from several Investment Company Act provisions to allow multiple share classes, early withdrawal charges, and asset-based distribution/service fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-11.

title: Valued Advisers Trust and Alaia Capital, LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Valued Advisers Trust and Alaia Capital, LLC seeking exemptive relief to allow subadvisory agreements to be entered into or materially amended without shareholder approval, and to relax certain fee-related disclosure requirements. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-11. This is a notice of an application, not a final order or rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application: Journey Financial Group, Inc. applied to become a bank holding company by acquiring Lone Star Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-21.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The IRS published a notice of a modified computer matching program with Louisiana agencies to verify income and eligibility for certain benefit programs. Comments are due within 30 days of publication, and the re-established agreement is expected to take effect on 2026-09-01 if no comments are received. The notice describes ongoing data-sharing arrangements and program participants.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Renewal Without Change of the Registration of Money Services Businesses Regulation and FinCEN Form 107
summary: Treasury/FinCEN is seeking OMB approval to renew, without change, the money services business registration information collection and FinCEN Form 107 under 31 CFR 1022.380. Money services businesses are invited to comment by 2026-09-21. This is a paperwork-control notice, not a new rule.

title: Establish Price for 2026 Freedom 250 Race Medal
summary: The U.S. Mint announced the price of $60 for the 2026 Freedom 250 Race Medal and said orders open on 2026-08-21 and run through 2026-09-04, subject to a 15,000-unit limit. This is a product availability notice, not a regulatory change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form ADV
summary: The SEC published a notice seeking public comment on its request to extend the OMB approval for Form ADV, the mandatory registration/reporting form for investment advisers and exempt reporting advisers. The comment period closes on 2026-09-21. This is an information-collection notice, not a rule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Rules at Options 7, Section 4 (Complex Order Fees and Rebates) and Section 6 (Other Options Fees and Rebates)
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fee and rebate schedule for complex orders and other options fees. The notice solicits public comments but does not itself impose a new compliance deadline in the text provided. It affects exchange participants trading options on Nasdaq ISE.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposal To Amend Rule 20.6 (Nullification and Adjustment of Options Transactions Including Obvious Errors) Regarding the Roster Requirements for the Obvious Error Panel
summary: MEMX filed and immediately made effective a proposed rule change to amend its options obvious-error rule. The change removes the requirement to maintain a minimum roster of panel representatives, while keeping the panel composition itself unchanged. It applies to MEMX options members and panel participants. The SEC is also seeking comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 13.4(a) To Reflect the Operation of TXSE Exchange
summary: MEMX has filed a proposed SEC rule change, effective immediately as a non-controversial filing, to amend Rule 13.4(a) so its public data-feed disclosure reflects TXSE Exchange’s launch as a registered national securities exchange. The change affects exchange order handling, routing, execution and related compliance processes. No firm action date is stated, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change Relating to the LCH SA Liquidity Plan
summary: The SEC approved LCH SA’s proposed Liquidity Plan for its CDSClear clearing agency. The plan sets governance, responsibilities, stress testing, monitoring, and escalation arrangements for liquidity risk. It applies to LCH SA as a registered clearing agency and becomes effective through the SEC approval order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq MRX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq MRX filed an immediately effective rule change to update its connectivity schedule by deleting discontinued fiber-optic and wireless market data connectivity offerings and dropping a previously proposed POD colocation service that was never implemented. The exchange says the changes align the rulebook with services no longer offered, with some terminations already effective and one effective September 30, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change to remove discontinued connectivity and market data offerings from its fee schedule and to drop a previously proposed POD colocation service that was never implemented. The SEC is seeking comments, and no immediate compliance date is set in this notice. The filing affects exchange members and users of the connectivity services.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to clean up its connectivity schedule by removing terminated fiber-optic and wireless market data connectivity offerings and dropping an unimplemented POD colocation offering. The filing is open for SEC comment, and no new customer obligation is created beyond the exchange’s rulebook update. The terminated offerings are effective as of August 31, 2025 or September 30, 2026, as stated.

title: Referral of the proposed Scottish Zero Emission Truck Fund Scheme by Transport Scotland
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has opened a referral on Transport Scotland’s proposed Scottish Zero Emission Truck Fund. Third parties can submit comments by the deadline in the timetable. The report will assess whether the scheme complies with subsidy control requirements; no direct obligations are created for regulated firms.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee
summary: The IRS announced an open virtual meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee on September 16, 2026, and invited public comments and submissions. Advance registration is required by September 11, 2026. This is an informational meeting notice only and does not create new obligations for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form N-54A
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice to extend Form N-54A, the mandatory notification used by eligible investment companies to elect business development company status. Comments are due by 2026-10-23. No substantive rule change is made, but firms that file this form should note the ongoing collection requirement.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17f-1
summary: SEC notice seeking public comment under the Paperwork Reduction Act on extending the information collection for Rule 17f-1. It does not change the rule itself; it only asks for comments on the estimated burden and OMB approval for existing custody reporting requirements for registered management investment companies and their boards.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 163
summary: The SEC issued a notice seeking comment on extending the existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Rule 163. It does not change the rule itself; comments are due by 2026-10-23.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 433
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on a proposed extension of its existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Rule 433 (free writing prospectuses). It does not change the rule itself; comments are due by 2026-10-23.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules 903G and 906G
summary: The SEC extended the time for acting on NYSE American’s proposed rule change to allow cash settlement for up to 50 non-ETF FLEX options under Rules 903G and 906G. This is a procedural notice on a pending exchange rule filing, not a final rule. The Commission must act by 2026-10-05.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules 5.32-O and 5.35-O
summary: The SEC extended its review period for NYSE Arca’s proposed rule change to allow cash settlement for up to 50 non-ETF FLEX Options. This is a procedural notice, not a final rule. The Commission must act by 2026-10-05 on approval, disapproval, or proceedings.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule To Eliminate Customer and Professional Customer Fees and Introduce a Floor Broker Incentive for Trading in Certain MSCI Related Index Options
summary: NYSE Arca filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to cut certain MSCI index options customer and professional customer manual execution fees to $0.00 and add a $0.25 floor broker rebate for MXEA and MXEF. The fee changes were effective August 11, 2026. This affects options trading activity on NYSE Arca, not a bank-wide regulatory obligation.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Update Its Fees Schedule in Connection With Binary Options That Overlie the Mini-S&P 500 Index
summary: Cboe Exchange filed and made immediately effective a proposed rule change to update its fee schedule for XSP binary options overlying the Mini-S&P 500 Index, including new transaction fee codes and related fee-footnote rules. The SEC notice also seeks comments on the filing. The change is for exchange participants and takes effect immediately upon filing, subject to the rule process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Fee Schedule
summary: The SEC published notice of MEMX’s proposed and immediately effective exchange fee schedule change. MEMX would amend eligibility criteria for a retail sub-dollar liquidity removal fee tier, with an alternative qualification path that would expire no later than 2027-01-31. The notice seeks comments; it does not itself impose a new obligation on firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Correct an Internal Cross-Reference Error in Rule 23.150
summary: IEX filed an immediately effective exchange rule change to fix an internal cross-reference in Rule 23.150 so it points to the correct definition in Rule 22.160. The change is a technical correction only and does not alter system functionality or processes. The SEC notice invites comments, but the filing is effective immediately under the Exchange Act.

title: Pender Real Estate Credit Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief allowing certain business development companies and closed-end funds to co-invest in portfolio companies with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-14. This is a notice, not a rule or order, so it does not itself change obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 31a-4
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection tied to Rule 31a-4 recordkeeping for registered investment companies and BDCs. The notice does not change substantive obligations, but comments are due by 2026-09-24. Affected firms should note the paperwork burden estimate and continue current recordkeeping arrangements.

title: Schlumberger / ChampionX merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has published an invitation to comment on Schlumberger’s proposed acquisition of ChampionX. Interested parties can submit initial views by 2024-12-10. This is an early merger-review information-gathering step and does not itself impose new requirements on firms.

title: Interagency Rescission of the Interagency Statement on Special Purpose Credit Programs Under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act and Regulation B
summary: The OCC and other US agencies issued a notice rescinding the 2022 interagency statement on special purpose credit programs under ECOA/Regulation B. The rescission took effect on 2026-08-25, and agencies say creditors should not rely on the prior statement or related issuances going forward.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a change-in-bank-control notice for proposed acquisitions of shares in Pueblo Bancorporation and indirectly PB&T Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-09. This is a notice of an application and comment period, not a final decision.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published updated SDN designations under Executive Order 13224, blocking property and interests in property of the listed persons under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from transacting with them. Banks and other U.S.-touching firms must screen and prevent dealings with the named individuals immediately; the action was issued on 2026-08-20.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under E.O. 14059 and E.O. 13224, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealings. The notice is effective from 2026-08-20 and is relevant immediately for sanctions screening, asset freezes, and transaction controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one entity to the SDN List and blocked its property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with the designated person as of the action date, 2026-08-07.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on U.S. Individual Income Tax Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on a Paperwork Reduction Act notice to renew and revise the approved information collection for Form 1040 and related individual income tax forms, schedules and guidance. Comments are due by 2026-10-26. The notice says form additions/removals and guidance changes may affect burden estimates, which will be updated in a later 30-day notice.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Rescission of Interagency Statement on Special Purpose Credit Programs Under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act and Regulation B
summary: FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter telling FDIC-supervised institutions that the interagency statement on special purpose credit programs under ECOA/Regulation B has been rescinded. The change is effective via the agencies’ Federal Register notice dated 2026-08-25 and means firms should not rely on the rescinded statement when designing or operating such programs.

title: Press Release: FDIC-Insured Institutions Reported Return on Assets of 1.37 Percent and Net Income of $90.1 Billion in Second Quarter 2026
summary: FDIC published its Quarterly Banking Profile press release for Q2 2026, highlighting industry-wide ROA, net income, deposits, loan growth, asset quality and Deposit Insurance Fund trends for FDIC-insured institutions. It is informational only and does not create new requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change Relating to the CDS Instrument On-Boarding Policies and Procedures
summary: The SEC approved ICE Clear Credit’s rule change updating CDS instrument on-boarding policies. The amendment adds a third criterion for considering single-name instruments for clearing and clarifies the existing selection criteria. It applies to ICC as a clearing agency and affects clearing participants and instrument onboarding processes from the approval date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Enhance Certain Aspects of the Activity-Based Risk Controls Applicable to IEX Options Members Set Forth in IEX Rule 22.250, and To Make Conforming and Typo Clean-Up Changes to IEX Rules 22.250 and 22.260
summary: The SEC published notice of IEX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to enhance activity-based risk controls for IEX Options members and make conforming/typo clean-up edits to IEX Rules 22.250 and 22.260. The filing is open for comment and relates to the upcoming launch of IEX Options on 2026-10-02. No direct bank obligation is created yet, but options market participants should review the control changes.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 4759 Regarding Sources of Data Used
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend Exchange Rule 4759 on the sources of data used during the Night Session. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal, which supports Nasdaq’s planned 23/5 trading model. No firm compliance date is set in the text, but the exchange’s Night Session framework is tied to a future SEC-approved launch and related conditions.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications for bank holding company formation and acquisitions under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-25. The notice concerns Versa Bancorp’s proposed acquisition of VersaHoldings US Corp and VersaBank USA, plus related nonbanking activities.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company application activity, inviting public comments on an application by Agricultural Banking Corporation to acquire Buckley Bancorp and indirectly Buckley State Bank. Comments must be received by 2026-09-25. This is a notice of pending authorization, not a final approval or rule change.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing Change in Bank Control Act applications for persons seeking to retain voting shares of a bank holding company. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-10. This is an informational notice and does not itself change requirements, but it may affect parties involved in bank ownership changes.
