title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Methylene Diphenyl Diisocyanate; n=2.0-3.0
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add methylene diphenyl diisocyanate (MDI) to the US Superfund list of taxable substances. This is not a final determination. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-10-26 for interested parties such as importers and exporters of MDI.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Acrylate Monomer Synthetic Rubber; x=587.30, y=583.29, z=258.18, a=1.58
summary: The IRS issued a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add acrylate monomer synthetic rubber (ACM Rubber) to the U.S. list of taxable substances under the Superfund chemical tax rules. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-10-26. This is not a final determination and does not yet change tax liability.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Poly(divinylbenzene-ethylvinylbenzene); x=1.33x1017, y=3.27x1016
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add poly(divinylbenzene-ethylvinylbenzene) (DVB-EVB) to the US Superfund list of taxable substances. This is not yet a determination or rule change. Comments or hearing requests are due by 2026-10-26 for interested parties such as importers and other affected firms.

title: ARK Venture Fund and ARK Investment Management LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by ARK Venture Fund and ARK Investment Management LLC to amend a prior exemptive order. The requested amendment would let the fund offer a listed exchange class and a tokenized class traded on ATSs, instead of relying only on the prior interval-fund structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-18.

title: Order Making Fiscal Year 2027 Annual Adjustments to Registration Fee Rates
summary: The SEC announces the FY 2027 annual adjustment to securities registration fee rates, which affects issuers filing registration statements and related Exchange Act fee calculations. It updates the target fee collection amount and applies the statutory methodology for calculating the new rate. The order is effective for FY 2027; no firm-specific filing deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18E Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC noticed NYSE American’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.18E on trading halts and resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions. It applies to NYSE American-listed securities and is part of the market’s move toward 23/5 trading. No compliance deadline is stated in the notice; firms should monitor the final operative rule and related exchange implementation.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC published notice of NYSE Texas’s proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend trading-halt rules for securities subject to certain corporate actions. The change would require specific halt and resume procedures, including resuming trading via auction for affected securities. Market participants should review the proposal, but this notice itself does not yet impose new obligations on member firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Phlx Rules
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change with the SEC to make non-substantive clean-up edits to several Phlx options rules, including alphabetising definitions, fixing rule citations, removing duplicated text, and replacing legacy terms such as "Off-Floor Broker-Dealer" with "broker-dealer". It is open for SEC comment, but no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public list of financial institutions for which it has been appointed receiver, liquidator, or manager. This notice records that Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank, Philadelphia, PA, was closed on 2026-08-21 and entered FDIC receivership. It is informational for institutions and operations teams, and confirms the status of the failed bank.

title: Renewal of the Commission on Social Impact Partnerships
summary: The Treasury Department announced renewal of the charter for the Commission on Social Impact Partnerships for two years, effective no sooner than seven days after publication. It is an administrative notice about an advisory committee and does not itself create new obligations for firms.

title: FDIC Board of Directors Approve New Actions
summary: FDIC published a board-matters bulletin announcing that its Board unanimously approved a final rule on unsafe or unsound practices and matters requiring attention, and an interim final rule on reciprocal deposits under the Road to Housing Act. The notice points readers to related board materials, press releases and the financial institution letters.

title: Fenimore Asset Management, Inc. and Fenimore Asset Management Trust
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Fenimore Asset Management, Inc. and Fenimore Asset Management Trust seeking exemptive relief to operate a multi-class ETF structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-21. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposal To Adopt Rules for the Listing and Trading of Securities Event Contracts on the Exchange
summary: The SEC published a notice asking for comment on MEMX LLC’s proposed rule change to add Chapter 30 for listing and trading securities event contracts on MEMX Options. It is not yet binding, but it would expand the exchange’s listed-options framework for these products. No comment deadline or implementation date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Warrant Performance Incentive Program To Add ETPs to the Definition of Liquidity Improvement Symbols and High-Volume Symbols
summary: The SEC published notice of an immediately effective Texas Stock Exchange rule change that amends the Rodeo warrant incentive program to include ETPs in the definitions of Liquidity Improvement Symbols and High-Volume Symbols. This affects how the exchange calculates program incentives for members/participants during the existing Rodeo Period. No separate compliance deadline is stated in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Introduce Intra-Day Snapshots to NTX Options Trade Outline
summary: The SEC published a notice of Nasdaq Texas’s proposed rule change to add optional intra-day snapshots to NTX Options Trade Outline, giving customers more frequent updates of market sentiment information. It is a proposed rule filing, not a final change, so firms should review and comment by the filing process deadline if applicable. The change would affect exchange product delivery rather than create immediate obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 19b-7 and Form 19b-7
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection for Rule 19b-7 and Form 19b-7. The notice does not change the rule itself, but it invites comments by 2026-09-28 and updates the estimated reporting burden for self-regulatory organizations that file proposed rule changes for security futures products.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 404, Series of Option Contracts Open for Trading, To Amend the Short Term Option Series Program With Respect to Qualifying Securities
summary: MIAX filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately subject to SEC process, to expand its short-term options program for certain ETFs. It would allow additional Tuesday/Thursday expirations for some products and additional Monday/Wednesday expirations for others, and create Tier 1 and Tier 2 qualifying securities. The filing is not a final rule but is open for comment.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published changes to the SDN List, adding one or more persons and vessels and updating identifying information for one listed person. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with the listed parties, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. Effective on the listed action date of 2026-08-24.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of the  Northern Mariana Islands Affected by Super Typhoon Bavi
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief to help FDIC-supervised institutions recover in areas of the Northern Mariana Islands affected by Super Typhoon Bavi. It applies to all FDIC-supervised financial institutions, with operational response expected immediately and no specific compliance deadline stated.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 2a-5
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the Paperwork Reduction Act collection tied to Rule 2a-5 on fair value for registered investment companies and BDCs. The notice does not change the rule, but reminds respondents that compliance with Rule 2a-5 remains mandatory and highlights ongoing quarterly, annual, and event-driven board reporting requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting on September 3, 2026, covering enforcement, litigation, and examination matters. This is an administrative meeting notice only; it does not create new obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Delay the Implementation of SR-GEMX-2026-15
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change to delay the implementation of SR-GEMX-2026-15 until on or before November 10, 2026. The filing itself makes no substantive rule changes; it only extends the outside implementation date and says a trader alert will announce the specific date. Comments were solicited on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Long-Term Stock Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain of Its Rules Regarding Statutory Disqualifications
summary: The SEC published notice that LTSE filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately, to amend its statutory-disqualification and membership rules and to align them more closely with FINRA and BZX. The notice seeks public comments; no firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt. Firms that are LTSE members, or persons associated with members, may be affected.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Codes of Arbitration Procedure To Make Changes to Certain Provisions Relating to Arbitrator List Selection
summary: FINRA has filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to amend its arbitration codes on arbitrator list selection, giving parties more input when initial panels are formed and when arbitrators are replaced. The SEC is seeking comments; no filing deadline or effective date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Program for Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Pursuant to Rule 17d-2; Notice of Filing and Order Approving and Declaring Effective an Amendment to the Plan for the Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Among Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc., BOX Exchange, LLC, Cboe Exchange, Inc., Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc., Nasdaq ISE, LLC, Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc., Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC, NYSE American LLC, NYSE Arca, Inc., The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, Nasdaq Texas LLC, Nasdaq PHLX LLC, Nasdaq GEMX, LLC, Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc., Nasdaq MRX, LLC, MIAX PEARL, LLC, MIAX Emerald, LLC, MIAX Sapphire, LLC, MEMX LLC, MX2 LLC and Investors Exchange LLC Concerning Options-Related Sales Practice Matters
summary: The SEC approved and made effective an amended Rule 17d-2 plan allocating regulatory responsibilities among multiple U.S. options exchanges and FINRA for options-related sales practice matters. It affects how member-firm regulatory exams and enforcement duties are shared, but it does not create new substantive conduct requirements for firms. No compliance date is stated beyond the order becoming effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Delay the Implementation of SR-ISE-2026-18
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to delay the implementation of SR-ISE-2026-18. The exchange says the underlying auction-mechanism changes are unchanged and the outside implementation date is extended to on or before 2026-11-10, with a later Options Trader Alert to announce the exact date.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on Novus Capital Holdings’ application to become a bank holding company by acquiring Novus Bank. Interested persons may submit views by 2026-09-30. This is a notice of an application process, not a rule change.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve announced public notices of Change in Bank Control Act applications for groups seeking to acquire or retain voting shares in named US banks and bank holding companies. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-15. This is an authorisation/perimeter notice, not a rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC has updated the SDN List by removing some persons whose property is unblocked and adding others subject to U.S. blocking and transaction prohibitions under Executive Order 13224, as amended. U.S. persons and any business with U.S.-jurisdictional touchpoints must screen against the changes immediately; the notice states the relevant actions were determined on August 24, 2026.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and entities to the SDN List under Executive Order 13224, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Banks and other U.S.-exposed firms must screen and block immediately; the notice was issued on 2026-08-26.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council on September 10, 2026, to discuss possible future recommendations on IRS operations, taxpayer service, compliance, tax administration, information reporting, and tax-exempt entities. Public attendees may register by September 8, 2026, and written statements may be submitted by that date.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Registration
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an extension of the existing FATCA information collection, including related forms and online registration. There is no change to the approved collection, and comments are due by 2026-10-30. This is a notice under the Paperwork Reduction Act, not a new rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 489 and Form F-N
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on the extension of the existing Rule 489/Form F-N information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Foreign banks, foreign insurance companies and certain related entities that rely on the exemption and make public securities offerings in the US remain subject to the filing requirement. Comments on the 60-day notice are due by 2026-10-30.

title: DTCC ITP LLC; Notice of Filing of Application for Exemption From Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: The SEC published notice of DTCC ITP LLC’s application for an exemption from registration as a clearing agency, and invited public comments before deciding whether to grant it. This concerns DTCC ITP’s proposed direct provision of matching and electronic trade confirmation services in the US securities market. No firm deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: TriOptima AB; Notice of Filing of Application for Exemption From Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: The SEC published a notice seeking comments on TriOptima AB’s application for an exemption from clearing agency registration for certain post-trade risk reduction services in security-based swaps, and a planned expansion to repo products. No obligations are created for firms; comments are invited while the SEC considers whether to grant the exemption.

title: OSTTRA Limited; OSTTRA Services, LLC; Notice of Filing of Applications for Exemption From Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: The SEC is inviting comments on OSTTRA Limited and OSTTRA Services’ applications for exemption from clearing agency registration under the Exchange Act. The notice concerns post-trade, pre-settlement matching services for security-based swaps and repo products. No deadline is stated in the excerpt, and the notice itself does not impose new requirements.

title: LSEG Post Trade Services Limited; Notice of Filing of Application for Exemption From Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: The SEC notice asks for public comments on LSEG Post Trade Services Limited’s application for an exemption from registration as a clearing agency for its Veris post-trade reconciliation and lifecycle management platform for equity security-based swaps. It does not itself change rules or impose a deadline in the text provided. Firms active in security-based swaps and post-trade services may want to monitor the outcome.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Delay Implementation of a Change to Rule 515A, MIAX Emerald Price Improvement Mechanism (“PRIME”) and PRIME Solicitation Mechanism
summary: MIAX Emerald filed a proposed rule change to delay implementation of previously approved changes to Rule 515A for PRIME and cPRIME auctions. The exchange says the delay gives it and members more time to complete technical changes and plans to issue a regulatory circular at least 30 days before implementation, now expected in Q2 2027.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Delay Implementation of a Change to Rule 515A, MIAX Price Improvement Mechanism (“PRIME”) and PRIME Solicitation Mechanism
summary: MIAX filed a proposed Exchange Act rule change to delay implementation of a prior change to Rule 515A governing PRIME and PRIME Solicitation Mechanism functionality for market makers in options classes. The exchange says the delay would give it and members more time for technical changes and would be announced by regulatory circular at least 30 days before implementation. The SEC is soliciting comments; no exact comment deadline is stated in the text provided.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MX2 LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposal To Amend Rule 20.6 (Nullification and Adjustment of Options Transactions Including Obvious Errors) Regarding the Roster Requirements for the Obvious Error Panel
summary: MX2 LLC filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its options obvious error rule by removing the minimum roster requirement for panel representatives. The panel composition itself stays the same, and the SEC published the filing for comment. This affects MX2 options members and exchange rule administration from 2026-08-31.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Rules To Permit the Listing of Binary Options Overlying Key Performance Indicators Reported by Certain Issuers of Stock
summary: The SEC has extended its review period for Cboe Exchange’s proposed rule change to allow listing and trading of binary options overlying KPI data reported by certain stock issuers. This is not a final rule; the Commission must act by 2026-10-13, when it will approve, disapprove, or institute proceedings on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; CME Securities Clearing Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Standards for Establishing Cross-Margin Arrangements and Adopt a Cross-Margin Arrangement With Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on CME Securities Clearing Inc.’s proposed rule change to add cross-margining standards and implement an initial cross-margin arrangement with CME. The filing would revise CMESC rulebook provisions and related risk-management policies for cross-margining of eligible securities transactions and interest rate futures. No compliance date is set yet; comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe BZX has filed a proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, increasing the fee for on-exchange customer-range options transactions and making related clarifying edits. The SEC is soliciting comments. The filing references an effective date of July 1, 2026 for the underlying methodology, but this notice itself is not a final binding rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: The SEC published a notice of Cboe EDGX’s proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, including a higher ORF rate and clarifying edits tied to on-exchange customer-range options transactions. The notice solicits public comments; it does not itself change obligations. The change is described as effective July 1, 2026, under the exchange filing, but the SEC notice is only a publication of the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe C2 Exchange filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, increasing the fee to $0.01417 per contract side for on-exchange customer-range options transactions and updating related fee schedule wording. The change is effective July 1, 2026, and comments were solicited on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe Exchange has filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, increasing the fee for on-exchange customer-range options trades and clarifying related fee language. The change is effective July 1, 2026 and affects trading permit holders and clearing firms handling options transactions on Cboe Options.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company application activity, inviting public comments on a proposed acquisition by Farmers Bancorp Inc. Comments are due by 2026-10-01. This is an informational notice about an application process, not a rule or approval.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection on exemptions from derivatives clearing organization registration is under OMB review for extension. It invites comments by 2026-10-01 on the burden and costs of the collection for firms seeking or maintaining DCO exemption under CFTC regulation 39.6.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Form 1098-E
summary: The IRS is asking for public comments on the existing Form 1098-E information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It says there is no change to the approved collection; comments are due by 2026-11-02. The notice concerns student loan interest reporting by financial institutions and similar entities.

title: Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service Information Collection Requests
summary: Treasury issued a notice seeking public comment on several IRS information collection requests and related OMB renewals. The collections cover country-by-country reporting, excise tax terminal activity reporting, nuclear decommissioning returns, and IRS e-file provider participation requirements. Comments are due by 2026-10-01. This is an information-collection notice, not a new rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Bureau of the Fiscal Service Information Collection Requests
summary: Treasury is asking for public comment on two existing Bureau of the Fiscal Service information collection requests before submitting them to OMB for Paperwork Reduction Act clearance. The notice concerns bond and savings-bond forms used by individuals or households, with comments due by 2026-10-01. It does not create new obligations for banks.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Regulation Agency Protests
summary: Treasury published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on an extension of its information collection for contractor protests under the FAR. Comments are due by 2026-10-01. This is a notice and request for comment only; it does not itself change substantive requirements.

title: Deregistration Under Section 8(f) of the Investment Company Act of 1940
summary: The SEC published notices of applications for deregistration under Section 8(f) of the Investment Company Act for several closed-end investment companies that have liquidated or reorganized. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-22; absent a hearing order, deregistration orders will be issued. This affects the named fund applicants and their advisers/administrators.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Listing Fees for Exchange-Traded Products and Add a New Quality Liquidity Provider Program
summary: Nasdaq has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately but not yet operative, to amend listing fees for exchange-traded products and create a new Quality Liquidity Provider program. Issuers of Nasdaq-listed ETPs may opt for a new $50,000 Premier Annual Listing Fee to access expanded liquidity support and QLP eligibility. The Exchange says the change is operative on 2026-09-01.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the Plan for the Purpose of Developing and Implementing Procedures Designed To Facilitate the Listing and Trading of Standardized Options To Add MX2 LLC as a Plan Sponsor
summary: The SEC published notice that MX2 LLC has been added as a sponsor to the Options Listing Procedures Plan, which governs procedures for listing and trading standardized options. This affects options exchanges and plan participants; the notice was published for comment but does not itself create new firm obligations.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the Plan for the Purpose of Developing and Implementing Procedures Designed To Facilitate the Listing and Trading of Standardized Options To Add Investors Exchange LLC as a Plan Sponsor
summary: The SEC gives notice that an amendment to the Options Listing Procedures Plan became immediately effective to add Investors Exchange LLC as a plan sponsor. This affects participating options exchanges and related market-structure operations; the filing is open for public comment. No direct compliance deadline is stated for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 5.52 (Market-Maker Quotes) To Adopt Two-Sided Quote Bid/Ask Differentials
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change to add maximum bid/ask differentials for market-maker quotes in options series, generally $5 for expirations within 270 days and $15 for longer-dated series, with certain exceptions. It applies to Cboe Options market makers and is open for SEC comment; the filing becomes immediately effective on filing, but the rule is still subject to SEC review. No compliance date is stated in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 5.52 (Market-Maker Quotes) To Adopt Two-Sided Quote Bid/Ask Differentials
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe C2’s proposed rule change to add two-sided quote bid/ask differential limits for market-makers under Exchange Rule 5.52. The filing is immediately effective but the SEC is soliciting comments. It affects C2 market-makers and their quoting practices; no specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 22.6 (Market Maker Quotations) To Adopt Two-Sided Quote Bid/Ask Differentials
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe EDGX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to add two-sided quote bid/ask differential limits for market makers under Exchange Rule 22.6. The change would cap electronic quote widths at $5 in covered options series, with some exchange-set exceptions. It affects EDGX options market makers and is subject to SEC comment solicitation, not a firm deadline.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt New Rule 24 Under Article 22 of the NYSE Texas Rule Book
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on NYSE Texas’s proposed rule change to add Rule 24 to its rule book. The rule would provide complimentary services to all listed issuers and a visibility/investor-engagement package for eligible dual listings meeting a 160 million shares-outstanding threshold. No compliance date is set because this is only a proposal.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on Comment Request Relating to Penalty on Income Tax Return Preparers Who Understate Taxpayer's Liability on a Federal Income Tax Return or Claim for Refund
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on an existing information collection under tax-return preparer penalty rules. It does not change the burden or create new requirements; comments are due by 2026-11-02. The notice concerns preparers and other affected respondents in the US.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Joint Statement on Suspicious Activity Report Confidentiality Considerations Regarding Communications with Customers
summary: The FDIC and other US agencies issued a joint statement reminding FDIC-insured institutions about SAR confidentiality when communicating with customers about suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity, including payment fraud and account closures. It is immediate guidance for all FDIC-insured financial institutions; no specific compliance date is given.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Order Granting Approval of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules Regarding Intermarket Sweep Orders
summary: The SEC approved a Cboe EDGA Exchange rule change allowing Intermarket Sweep Orders to be entered as non-displayed orders and letting non-displayed orders re-price more aggressively. The exchange also set when ISO limit prices are available for new orders or repricing across trading sessions. This is effective for the exchange’s users once the rule change becomes operative.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Program
summary: The SEC has published notice of Cboe BZX Exchange’s proposed fee-schedule change to create an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program. Eligible members could receive fee credits for temporary redundant logical ports used only as backup connections during an exchange-initiated migration, subject to notice, cancellation, usage, and credit-request conditions. This is a proposal/open for comment, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Order Granting Approval of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules Regarding Intermarket Sweep Orders
summary: The SEC approved Cboe BZX’s rule change to let Intermarket Sweep Orders be entered as non-displayed orders and to allow certain non-displayed orders to re-price more aggressively. The change also sets when ISO prices are available for new orders or repricing across trading sessions. Cboe BZX members/users should implement the exchange rule changes once effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Order Granting Approval of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules Regarding Intermarket Sweep Orders
summary: The SEC approved a Cboe EDGX rule change allowing intermarket sweep orders to be entered as non-displayed orders and setting when ISO prices can be used for new orders or repricing. The exchange also may allow non-displayed orders to re-price more aggressively. This is effective for Cboe EDGX users once the approved rule change becomes operative under the exchange’s filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Order Granting Approval of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules Regarding Intermarket Sweep Orders
summary: The SEC approved a Cboe BYX Exchange rule change allowing intermarket sweep orders to be entered as non-displayed orders and changing when ISO limit prices are treated as available for new orders or repricing. The exchange may also let non-displayed orders re-price more aggressively. This is effective for exchange users once the approved rule is operative.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 2, and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 2, To Amend Its Rules To Extend Trading Hours for Certain Eligible Equity Options
summary: The SEC is publishing notice of, and granting accelerated approval to, NYSE American’s proposed rule change to extend trading hours for certain eligible equity options, with related rule and auction-process changes. This affects exchange participants and options products, including some ETP-related options. No firm action date is stated in the excerpt, but the rule change is being approved now and the notice solicits comment on Amendment No. 2.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt a New Rule Governing the Operation of a Proposed Step Up Mechanism (“SUM”) on the Exchange and To Make Conforming Changes in Other Rules
summary: Cboe C2 filed a proposed rule change to add a new Step Up Mechanism for certain eligible orders on the exchange and make conforming rule changes. The SEC is soliciting comments; no compliance date is set in the notice. The proposal would affect exchange order handling for participants in designated classes.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule Equity 7 Regarding Pricing of Ports for the Night Session
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, immediately effective, to amend Equity 7 fees for ports used to connect to its Night Session trading environment and to add fee waivers for members. The exchange said it plans to implement the fee changes on 2026-09-01. This is a US exchange filing open for comment and affects market participants using Night Session access ports.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe EDGX filed a proposed exchange rule change, effective immediately under SEC procedures, to amend its fee schedule and offer fee credits for backup logical ports used during an exchange-initiated order entry protocol migration. It applies to exchange members/broker-dealers that set up redundant ports and meet notice, cancellation and credit-request conditions. No exact compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Fees and Rebates for Professional Customer Orders for QCC and cQCC Transactions and Establish a Tiered Fee Structure for Away Market Maker Facilitation of Customer QFOs or cQFOs
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed and immediately made effective a proposed options fee schedule change for Professional Customer QCC/cQCC transactions and certain Trading Floor QFO/cQFO facilitation trades. It lowers some fees and rebates and adds a tiered fee structure based on breakup percentages and minimum sizes. The SEC is seeking comments; the filing is dated August 17, 2026, and the notice was published August 28, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment Nos. 1 and 2, To Adopt VIX Future-Option Orders
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to a Cboe Exchange rule change allowing combined VIX option and VIX futures orders, as modified by two amendments. The change applies to Cboe Options users and became approved on an accelerated basis, with the notice also inviting comment on Amendment No. 1.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications by bank holding companies to form or acquire other banking organizations under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-10-05. The notice itself does not approve the transactions; it opens a public comment process for affected bank holding companies and their acquisitions.

title: Notice to All Interested Parties of Intent To Terminate Receiverships
summary: The FDIC says it will terminate receiverships for three failed banks after asset liquidation is complete and final dividends may be paid. Interested parties may submit written comments within 30 days of the notice date; termination becomes effective no sooner than 30 days after the notice.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC published notice that the receivership for Citizens National Bank, Macomb, Illinois, was terminated effective 2026-09-01. The receivership has been discharged and ceased to exist as a legal entity. No ongoing filing or compliance action is set out for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Advance Notice of Rescission of Health Coverage
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-11-02 on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for advance notices of rescission of health coverage. It does not change the underlying rule, but updates burden estimates for the existing collection tied to the 30-day advance notice requirement.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Fuel Tax Guidance and Related Third-Party Disclosure and Recordkeeping Requirements
summary: The IRS is seeking public comment by 2026-11-02 on the Paperwork Reduction Act burden associated with fuel tax guidance and related third-party disclosure and recordkeeping requirements. It states there is no substantive change to the underlying requirements; the notice mainly consolidates an existing information collection under one OMB control number.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Disclosure of Returns and Return Information by Other Agencies
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act relating to disclosure of tax returns and return information by other agencies. There is no change to the collection and no new compliance obligation for firms. Comments are due by 2026-11-02.

title: Notice of a Request for Exemption From Certain Provisions of the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail Related to the Recovery of Costs Incurred During Period 4 of the Financial Accountability Milestones Pursuant to Section 36 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and/or Rule 608(e) of Regulation NMS Thereunder, and Request for Comment
summary: The SEC issued a notice requesting comment on a CAT LLC request for exemptive relief from certain Consolidated Audit Trail plan provisions relating to recovery of costs incurred during Period 4 of the Financial Accountability Milestones. This is a comment solicitation, not a rule change, and no compliance date is set.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15g-9
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection attached to Rule 15g-9 (penny stock suitability disclosures and related broker-dealer paperwork). This does not change the rule itself, but comments are due by 2026-10-05. It affects broker-dealers engaged in penny stock transactions.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE American Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to raise certain manual options fees for Market Makers in non-Penny issues and to add a new rebate for Floor Broker orders trading with Market Maker orders on the trading floor. The SEC notice solicits comments on the filing; the fee change is stated to be effective August 18, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: The SEC is publishing a notice of NYSE Arca’s proposed and immediately effective rule change to revise its options fee schedule for manual transactions. It would raise certain Market Maker manual fees on non-Penny issues and add a $0.20 per-contract rebate for Floor Broker orders trading with Market Maker orders, effective August 18, 2026. Comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; CME Securities Clearing Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 410, Rule 101, the Capped Liquidity Facility Procedure, and the Liquidity Risk Management Policy
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on CME Securities Clearing Inc.’s proposed changes to Rule 410, Rule 101, the Capped Liquidity Facility Procedure and its Liquidity Risk Management Policy. The filing would make the CLF master repurchase agreement rules-based and add related information and calculation requirements for members of the clearing agency. No compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: NYSE filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to correct Rule 7.18 so the Reverse Stock Split Halt uses the original ‘before the end of post-market trading on other markets’ wording rather than ‘Late Trading Session’. The SEC is soliciting comments on the proposal; no firm action date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Referral of the proposed Contracts for Difference for Renewables Allocation Round 8 scheme by DESNZ
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has published its final report on DESNZ’s proposed Contracts for Difference Allocation Round 8 scheme for Great Britain. It evaluates the scheme against the Subsidy Control Act 2022 and describes changes to the AR8 scheme, including eligibility, technology categories and auction mechanics. It is an advisory report, not a binding rule, and no action date is set for firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application to acquire shares in a bank holding company and indirectly its bank subsidiary. Comments must be received by 2026-09-21. The notice concerns the named applicants and institutions in the United States.

title: Publication of Inflation Adjustment Factor and Applicable Amounts for Clean Electricity Production Credit for Calendar Year 2026
summary: The IRS published the 2026 inflation adjustment factor and applicable amounts for the section 45Y clean electricity production tax credit. It is a notice of publication only, giving the figures used for 2026 sales, consumption or storage of electricity; it does not create new obligations for firms. No action deadline is stated in the text.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 9558 of Nasdaq's Disciplinary Code
summary: The SEC published Nasdaq’s proposed rule change to Rule 9558 of its disciplinary code. Nasdaq wants to let its Regulation Department staff, not just FINRA staff, issue written notices starting summary proceedings when authorized by Nasdaq’s Chief Regulatory Officer. The change is immediately effective, but the SEC is seeking comments on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe C2 filed a fee-schedule change, immediately effective, to create an Order Entry Protocol Migration Program that can credit Trading Permit Holders for temporary backup logical ports used during exchange-initiated protocol migrations. The notice seeks SEC comments; no firm-wide compliance deadline is stated, but affected exchange participants should review eligibility and billing impacts.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe Exchange filed an immediately effective rule change to its fee schedule for an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program. Trading Permit Holders can receive fee credits for backup logical ports used only during an exchange-initiated migration, if they notify the exchange, cancel the port within 30 days, and seek the credit within 30 days of cancellation.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe BZX filed and the SEC noticed an immediately effective fee schedule change to create an Order Entry Protocol Migration Program. Eligible members can receive credits for backup logical port fees during an exchange-initiated migration, subject to notification, cancellation, and credit-request conditions. No firm-wide regulatory deadline is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe EDGX filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend its fee schedule and create a program giving members fee credits for backup logical ports used during an exchange-initiated order entry protocol migration. Eligible members must notify the exchange, use the port only for migration-related issues, cancel it within 30 days, and request the credit within 30 days after cancellation.

title: Eldridge Dynamic Income Fund and Eldridge Structured Credit Advisers, LLC
summary: SEC notice of an application by Eldridge Dynamic Income Fund and Eldridge Structured Credit Advisers, LLC for exemptive relief to allow certain closed-end funds to issue multiple share classes and charge distribution, service and early withdrawal fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-28. This is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Supervisory Guidance: Supervisory Review Process of Capital Adequacy (Pillar 2) Related to the Implementation of the Basel II Advanced Capital Framework
summary: The OCC published a notice and request for comment on renewing an information collection tied to its Pillar 2 supervisory guidance for advanced approaches banks. Comments are due by 2026-10-08. The notice does not itself change the underlying guidance or create new requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comment on renewal of two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act: insurance sales consumer protections and reverse mortgage products. Affected institutions are insured state nonmember banks and savings associations. Comments are due by 2026-10-08. The notice says there is no change to the substance of the collections, only burden estimates.

title: Renewal of Agency Information Collection of a Previously Approved Collection; Request for Comments
summary: NCUA is seeking comments on renewal of two previously approved information collections: electronic funds transfer payment details and leasing-related documentation under 12 CFR part 714. Credit unions affected by these collections may comment by 2026-10-08 before OMB considers the renewals.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Frequently Asked Questions Regarding Treatment of Verifiable Digital Credentials Under the Customer Identification Program Rule
summary: FDIC and other US agencies issued FAQs on using state-issued mobile driver’s licences and other government digital credentials to verify natural-person customers under CIP, and updated a prior FAQ’s terminology for verifiable digital credentials. It applies to FDIC-insured financial institutions immediately; no separate compliance date is stated.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced an open Investor Advisory Committee meeting on 2026-09-10, with a public comment deadline of 2026-09-09. The agenda includes disclosure and artificial intelligence, Regulation NMS, subcommittee reports, and an administrative session. This is a meeting notice only and does not itself create new obligations.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for September 10, 2026, including matters on enforcement, litigation claims, and examinations. This is a notice of meeting logistics only and does not create new obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 173
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on extending the existing Rule 173 information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It does not change the rule’s substance, but asks for views on burden, utility and burden reduction by 2026-11-09. Firms subject to Rule 173 should review whether their reporting processes remain accurate and efficient.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 11a-2
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on the Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Rule 11a-2, which permits certain registered insurance company separate accounts to make exchange offers subject to conditions and requires related disclosure. This is a 60-day comment notice, with comments due by 2026-11-09. The notice does not change the rule itself, but it confirms the current burden estimate and mandatory reporting requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Revision: Ombudsman Matter Management System (OMMS) Submission Form
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on a revised OMMS Submission Form for retail investor complaints and inquiries. The form remains voluntary, but the SEC proposes adding a new submitter category and asks for comments on burden, utility and clarity, with comments due by the stated deadline in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change by The Options Clearing Corporation Concerning Amendments to Its Clearing Membership Standards
summary: The SEC has published a notice of OCC’s proposed rule change to amend clearing membership standards. It would tighten onboarding and ongoing risk requirements, raise certain capital-related expectations, expand grounds for denial or suspension, and broaden risk committee delegated authority. This is a consultation stage filing for comments, with no binding change yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Risk Management Model Description for the CDS Clearing Service
summary: The SEC approved ICE Clear Credit’s rule change amending its CDS clearing risk management model description. The update enhances contagion-risk methodology by introducing profit-given-default treatment and other related changes for clearing participants. It is binding on ICE Clear Credit’s CDS clearing service and effective once the approved rule change is implemented.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit the Exchange To Conduct Opening and Closing Auctions in UTP Securities Designated by the Exchange
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a Texas Stock Exchange proposed rule change that would let TXSE run opening and closing auctions in certain UTP securities it designates, rather than only in TXSE-listed securities. The filing also makes conforming changes to auction, price, and fallback rules. No compliance date is set because this is a proposal, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit a New Issue ETPs To Commence Trading at the Beginning of the Pre-Market Session
summary: Texas Stock Exchange proposes a rule change to let new issue ETPs start trading at the beginning of the pre-market session unless the issuer opts for an IPO Auction, and to clean up related auction rule text. This is a proposed SEC notice for exchange members and market participants; comments are being solicited, but no firm compliance deadline is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Implement a Lead Market Maker Program on the Exchange
summary: The SEC published a notice of TXSE’s proposed rule change to add a Lead Market Maker program for exchange-traded products. The filing explains the program’s governance, selection factors, performance standards and withdrawal process, but the detailed incentives and thresholds will be set in a later filing before implementation. Comments are being solicited; no compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 4515.01 (Allocations of Orders Made by Investment Advisers)
summary: The SEC approved a FINRA rule change amending Rule 4515.01 so the principal-approval exception for allocation of investment adviser bulk orders now applies regardless of when allocation instructions are received. It affects FINRA members, including prime brokers handling DVP/RVP arrangements. The change is binding once effective under FINRA/SEC procedures; no separate compliance date is stated in the text.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications for shares of a bank holding company and bank. It invites public comments by 2026-09-24 on whether the proposed control group acquisitions should be approved. This is a procedural notice for affected ownership/control transactions, not a rule change.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Acrylonitrile-butadiene Rubber; x=3,344.33, y=1,335.09, a=2.98
summary: The IRS issued a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add acrylonitrile-butadiene rubber (NBR) to the U.S. list of taxable substances under the Superfund chemical tax rules. This is a public notice only: it does not itself change the tax list. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-11-09.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Solution Styrene Butadiene Rubber; m=5,474.21, n=504.08, a=3.30
summary: The IRS published a notice that a petition has been filed to add solution styrene butadiene rubber (sSBR) to the US taxable substances list under Superfund excise tax rules. It requests comments and hearing requests by 2026-11-09. The notice is not a determination and does not itself change tax obligations.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Vinyl Acetate-dibutyl Maleate Copolymer in a Styrene Solution; x=6.17, y=1, s=10.94
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add vinyl acetate-dibutyl maleate copolymer in a styrene solution to the Superfund chemical taxable substances list. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-11-09. The notice is not a final determination and does not itself change the tax list.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Butadiene-acrylonitrile-methyl Methacrylate-styrene Copolymer; w=124.79, x=424.05, y=129.62, z=72.41
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add Modified SAN Latex to the U.S. Superfund list of taxable substances. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-11-09. The notice itself does not change the tax list, but it signals a potential future excise tax impact for importers and exporters of the substance.

title: Daxor Corporation
summary: The SEC published a notice of Daxor Corporation’s application to deregister as an investment company under section 8(f) of the Investment Company Act of 1940. Interested persons may request a hearing by 5:30 p.m. Eastern time on 2026-09-29. The notice concerns Daxor only and signals a potential change in its regulatory status if the Commission grants the order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE Texas filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to update its connectivity fee schedule and colocation notes so the listed market data feeds are named CTS and CQS instead of CTA and CQ. The change is non-substantive and reflects the upcoming CT Plan transition. Comments are being solicited; the notice itself does not set a firm compliance deadline.

title: AMG BBH Asset-Backed Credit Fund, LLC, et al.
summary: The SEC issued a notice of application, as amended, seeking an exemptive order to allow certain BDCs and open- and closed-end funds to co-invest with affiliates. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-28. This is a notice about requested relief, not a rule or order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rules 0150 (Application of Rules to Exempted Securities Except Municipal Securities), 2165 (Financial Exploitation of Specified Adults) and 4512 (Customer Account Information) and To Adopt FINRA Rule 2166 (Temporary Delays for Suspected Fraud)
summary: The SEC is inviting comments on FINRA’s proposed rule change to amend customer protection rules and add a new rule allowing temporary delays for suspected fraud. It would expand tools around trusted contacts, customer account information and fraud intervention for member firms. No compliance date is set because this is still a proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 4522 (Periodic Security Counts, Verifications and Comparisons) To Simplify Position Statement and Reconciliation Requirements for Certain Alternative Investments
summary: SEC publishes notice that FINRA has filed a proposed rule change to amend FINRA Rule 4522 and simplify position-statement and reconciliation requirements for certain alternative investments. It is a request for comment, not a final rule, so no immediate compliance change applies yet. Broker-dealers and carrying/clearing members offering alternative investments may be affected if the proposal is approved.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing, and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of, a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 5711(d) (Commodity-Based Trust Shares)
summary: The SEC publishes notice of and accelerated approval for Nasdaq Texas’s rule change to its listing standards for Commodity-Based Trust Shares. The amendment would allow up to a 15% NAV buffer of ineligible assets, add a digital commodity definition, and permit actively managed strategies. No firm-specific action date is stated.

title: Notice pursuant to Rule 15c3-3a, Note H(b)(3) Regarding Application of the Customer Protection Rule Reserve Computations With Respect to U.S. Treasury Securities
summary: The SEC published a notice allowing broker-dealers to include certain margin-related debits in customer protection rule reserve computations when posting cash, U.S. Treasury securities or qualified customer securities to meet ICE Clear Credit LLC margin requirements for U.S. Treasury positions. This affects broker-dealers and applies once the notice is published; no new filing deadline is set.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-09-25. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a final approval or rule change.

title: Art Advisory Panel-Notice of Closed Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a closed meeting of the Art Advisory Panel on 2026-09-16 in New York or virtually. The panel will review fair market value appraisals for works of art in federal income, estate, or gift tax returns; no new requirements are created for firms.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Interim Final Rule on Expanded Examination Cycle for Small Insured Depository Institutions
summary: The FDIC, Federal Reserve and OCC issued an interim final rule expanding the exam cycle for qualifying community banks. It applies to FDIC-insured institutions with total assets under $6 billion and takes effect on publication; affected firms should assess whether they qualify for the extended cycle.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form CB-Tender Offer/Rights Offering Notification Form
summary: The SEC proposes to extend the existing information collection for Form CB, used for exempt cross-border business combinations or rights offerings. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments by 2026-11-09; it does not change the filing rule itself. Entities relying on the exemption that would otherwise have a filing obligation are the affected filers.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 425
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on extending the existing Rule 425 information collection used for certain prospectuses and communications in business combination transactions. Comments are due by 2026-11-09. The notice does not change the rule itself or create new substantive obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE filed and immediately made effective a rulebook fee-schedule update to rename two colocation and network data feed references from CTA/CQ to their actual names, CTS and CQS. The change is non-substantive and reflects an upcoming NMS plan transition from April 1, 2027. Interested persons may comment on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to update its colocation connectivity fee schedule so references to certain NMS data feeds use their actual names, CTS and CQS, ahead of an April 1, 2027 transition to the CT Plan. The change is non-substantive and affects exchange users of colocation services.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE Arca filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to make a non-substantive update to its colocation connectivity fee schedule by renaming listed market data feeds from CTA/CQ to CTS/CQS. The change reflects the upcoming CT Plan transition and does not alter the feeds or fees. SEC is soliciting comments; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: SEC notice of NYSE National’s immediately effective proposed rule change to update its colocation connectivity fee schedule. The change is non-substantive and renames data feed references in two notes from “CTA/CQ” to “CTS/CQS” ahead of the 2027 CT Plan transition. No new fees or access rights are created.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; 24X National Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend 24X Rule 13.4(a) To Reflect Name Changes and the Operation of Texas Stock Exchange LLC
summary: The SEC has published a notice of filing and immediate effectiveness for 24X National Exchange LLC’s proposed rule change to update Rule 13.4(a) for Texas Stock Exchange’s exchange status and the renamed Nasdaq Texas and NYSE Texas market centers. The change is conforming and non-substantive. No compliance date is stated beyond immediate effectiveness and the publication’s comment period.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Relating to ICC's Model Validation Framework and Treasury Operations Policies and Procedures
summary: The SEC published a notice of ICE Clear Credit’s immediately effective proposed rule change to revise its model validation framework and treasury operations policies for the CDS clearing service. The changes are clarifying and housekeeping in nature and do not amend the CDS clearing rules. Interested persons may submit comments; no firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing bank holding company formation/acquisition application(s) for public comment. Interested persons may submit views on the applications by 2026-10-13. This is an informational notice only and does not itself approve or impose requirements on firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice updating identifying information for one or more SDN List entries and removing one or more persons whose property and interests in property were unblocked. This affects U.S. sanctions screening and list maintenance immediately for any firm dealing with U.S.-jurisdiction persons or property.

title: Senior Executive Service Performance Review Board Membership
summary: The Treasury Office of Inspector General publishes the membership of its Senior Executive Service Performance Review Board. It is an administrative notice about internal performance appraisal governance, with no direct obligations for regulated firms.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Proposed Interagency Third-Party Risk Management Guidance and Issuance of Joint Statement on Community Banks’ Engagement with Core Service Providers
summary: The FDIC, OCC, FRB and NCUA have issued proposed interagency third-party risk management guidance for public comment, intended to replace existing guidance and emphasize tailoring controls to the level of risk. They also issued a joint statement on community banks’ engagement with core service providers. The proposal applies to FDIC-supervised financial institutions; no binding deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Acknowledgement of Receipt of Notice of Registration as a National Securities Exchange Pursuant to Section 6(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by Bitnomial Exchange, LLC
summary: The SEC acknowledged receipt of Bitnomial Exchange, LLC’s Form 1-N to register as a national securities exchange for trading security futures products under Section 6(g) of the Exchange Act. This is effective on filing and applies to exchanges that meet the statutory conditions for this limited registration. The notice is dated September 8, 2026.

title: Acknowledgement of Receipt of Notice of Registration as a National Securities Exchange Pursuant to Section 6(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by KalshiEX LLC
summary: The SEC acknowledged receipt of KalshiEX LLC’s Form 1-N to register as a national securities exchange under Section 6(g) of the Exchange Act for trading security futures products. The notice confirms the registration became effective upon filing; no new compliance deadline is set, but it is relevant to firms dealing in security futures or exchange registration structures.

title: Acknowledgement of Receipt of Notice of Registration as a National Securities Exchange Pursuant to Section 6(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by Coinbase Derivatives, LLC
summary: The SEC acknowledged receipt of Coinbase Derivatives, LLC’s Form 1-N notice to register as a national securities exchange for trading security futures products only. This is a registration/perimeter notice, not a new rule, and it affects entities seeking or holding this narrow exchange status. No action deadline is stated in the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.23(b)(2) Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt
summary: MEMX has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately, to amend its circuit-breaker rule so that trading after a Level 3 market-wide halt still resumes at 4:00 a.m. when it launches 23/5 trading. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal. It affects MEMX trading participants and market operations, with the intended overnight session start date stated as December 6, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 13.003 Related to Proxy Voting
summary: The SEC has opened proceedings on a Texas Stock Exchange rule change that would require members to vote uninstructed shares and allocate votes proportionally based on instructions received from beneficial owners. The proposal applies to TXSE-listed equity securities held by members on behalf of beneficial owners. This is a proposed exchange rule change, not a final rule, so there is no immediate compliance date.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the paperwork collection for Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1 under the Investment Company Act. It does not change the rule’s substance, but comments on the information collection are due by 2026-10-13. Relevant for separate accounts of life insurers that use the exemption.

title: The RBB Fund Trust and Millburn Ridgefield LLC
summary: SEC notice of an exemptive application by The RBB Fund Trust and Millburn Ridgefield LLC seeking relief to change subadvisory agreements without shareholder approval and to relax related fee disclosures. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-10-05. This is a notice only and does not itself change obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 0-1 Under the Investment Company Act of 1940, Definition of Terms Used in This Part
summary: The SEC seeks OMB approval to extend an information collection tied to Rule 0-1 under the Investment Company Act for funds using exemptive rules. Funds must maintain board minutes and related records supporting independent legal counsel determinations, but this notice itself does not change the rule. Public comments are due by 2026-10-13.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications to engage in or acquire companies conducting permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. It invites public comments by 2026-09-29 on whether the proposal complies with section 4 of the BHC Act. This is a notice of proposals, not a rule or order.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on a bank holding company application by TabaPay, Inc. to become a bank holding company by acquiring Transact Bank, N.A., and to conduct certain data processing and money transmission activities. Interested persons may comment by 2026-10-14. This is a public notice of an authorisation/application process, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application: Dorado Bank Financial Holdings Corp. seeks to become a bank holding company by acquiring Dorado Bank in Puerto Rico. Interested persons may comment by 2026-10-14.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting
summary: The SEC announced a public Sunshine Act roundtable on September 17, 2026 to discuss preparations for 24-hour trading, including market resiliency and possible next steps. It is an open meeting notice only; it does not itself create obligations or deadlines.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for September 17, 2026, covering enforcement actions, administrative proceedings, litigation claims, and other examination/enforcement matters. This is a meeting notice only and does not create any new requirements for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a change to the time of a previously scheduled closed Sunshine Act meeting, moving it from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. on September 10, 2026. This is an informational meeting notice only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed rule change to amend its options fees schedule, adding MX2 LLC to fee code RP and increasing the fee under fee code RO. The SEC is publishing the filing and soliciting comments; the proposal is effective immediately under the exchange filing process, but the Commission notice itself is not a final rule. No compliance date is stated beyond the filing’s effective date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.10E, Clearly Erroneous Executions
summary: NYSE American has filed and made immediately effective a proposed rule change to amend its clearly erroneous executions rule for overnight trading under 23/5 trading. The change would extend existing limits on clearly erroneous review to periods when Overnight Price Bands are in effect, aligning the exchange rule with the SEC-approved LULD Plan changes. No specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Fees To Increase the Floor Market Maker Fee and Floor Broker Breakup Credit for Transactions in Non-Penny Classes
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed and made immediately effective a proposed fee schedule change to raise floor market maker fees and floor broker breakup credits for QFO and cQFO transactions in non-penny classes. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing.
