This affects MIAX Sapphire market participants, especially floor market makers and floor brokers, with no stated compliance date beyond immediate effectiveness.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fees Schedule and Exchange Rule 6.5
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe Exchange’s proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend its fee schedule and Rule 6.5. It would add MX2 to fee code RD, delete a duplicative catastrophic error review fee, and replace the current $5,000 catastrophic error review charge with a $500 fee when the relevant panel upholds the decision. The filing solicits public comments; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 6.5
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Cboe C2 proposed rule change to amend Exchange Rule 6.5. The change would replace a $5,000 catastrophic error review charge with a $500 appeal-stage fee when review decisions are upheld, and pass through any related charges to the relevant Trading Permit Holder. It concerns exchange participants, with no direct compliance deadline stated in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule
summary: The SEC published notice that Cboe EDGX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fees schedule. The change adds MX2 to one routed customer fee code and increases a non-customer routing fee from $1.25 to $1.31 per contract, effective September 1, 2026. The filing also solicits public comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Rules To Permit Trading 23 Hours per Day, Five Days per Week
summary: MEMX has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately as a non-controversial filing, to let equity securities and UTP ETPs trade 23 hours per day, five days per week. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal. This affects exchange participants and trading operations, with no stated compliance date beyond the filing process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the VanEck JitoSOL ETF Under Nasdaq Rule 5711(d) (Commodity-Based Trust Shares)
summary: The SEC extended its review period for Nasdaq’s proposed rule change to list and trade shares of the VanEck JitoSOL ETF under Nasdaq Rule 5711(d). The Commission must now act by 2026-11-15 on whether to approve, disapprove, or further proceed on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the ICE Clear Credit Recovery Plan and ICE Clear Credit Wind-Down Plan
summary: The SEC published notice of ICE Clear Credit LLC’s proposed rule change to revise its recovery and wind-down plans, mainly to reflect its new U.S. Treasury clearing service and update terminology. This is a solicitation of comments on a filing, not a final rule. No direct deadline or new binding obligation is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of “Trading Platform”
summary: Cboe EDGA Exchange filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” to cover additional execution venues, including similar order-matching and decentralized platforms such as blockchain-based or tokenized environments. The SEC notice invites comments on the filing; no specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists, correcting or standardizing records. The change is effective from the listed OFAC action date and affects screening and sanctions controls for any firm using OFAC lists.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. The action was issued on 2026-09-09.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on U.S. Employment Tax Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance
summary: The IRS is seeking comments on a proposed renewal/revision of the information collection for U.S. employment tax returns and related forms, schedules, attachments, and guidance. Employers are affected. Comments are due by 2026-11-13. This notice does not itself change filing rules, but flags potential burden and form changes in the approved collection package.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Add a New Partial Cabinet Solution Bundle as Part of Its Co-Location Services
summary: NYSE Texas filed a proposed rule change to add a new 4 kW Partial Cabinet Solution co-location bundle, relabel the existing bundle options, and tidy a timing-protocol reference in its fee schedule. The change is not yet final; the exchange expects it to become operative by 2026-10-31 and the SEC is soliciting comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Add a New Partial Cabinet Solution Bundle as Part of Its Co-Location Services
summary: NYSE National filed a proposed rule change to add a new 4 kW Partial Cabinet Solution bundle for co-location services, rename the existing bundle options, and update related fee schedule wording. The SEC is soliciting comments, and the exchange expects the change to become operative by October 31, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of “Trading Platform”
summary: The SEC is publishing a Cboe BZX proposed rule change and soliciting comments on a fee schedule update that would broaden the definition of “Trading Platform” to include similar order-matching venues and decentralized platforms, including blockchain- or tokenized environments. This affects venues subject to BZX fees. No compliance date is set in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of “Trading Platform”
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a Cboe EDGX proposed rule change to update its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” so it also covers similar order-matching venues and decentralized or tokenized platforms. This affects entities using EDGX fee schedules and related trading venues. No compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of “Trading Platform”
summary: Cboe BYX Exchange filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” to include similar order-matching execution venues and decentralized platforms, including blockchain-based or tokenized environments. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing. This affects market participants using BYX fee-eligible execution venues; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; BOX Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend SAIL Order Entry Port Fees
summary: BOX Exchange filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend its fee schedule by capping monthly SAIL Order Entry Ports at 200 per participant and clarifying the two SAIL port types. It applies to BOX participants using the exchange’s connectivity services. BOX will announce the implementation date and notify participants separately.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Tender Offer-Regulation 14D and Regulation 14E, Schedule 14D-9
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on a 60-day proposed extension of the existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for tender offer disclosures under Regulation 14D, Regulation 14E and Schedule 14D-9. Comments are due by 2026-11-13. This is a proposed administrative collection notice, not a substantive rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 19a-1
summary: The SEC is seeking public comment on the Paperwork Reduction Act burden estimate for extending Rule 19a-1, which governs written statements accompanying dividend payments by registered investment company management companies. It does not itself change the rule or impose a new deadline. The notice mainly affects funds subject to the rule and is for awareness only.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17Ab2-1 and Form CA-1
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB review of an extension to the information collection tied to Rule 17Ab2-1 and Form CA-1 for clearing agency registration. It does not change the rule, but it signals the ongoing paperwork and filing burden for clearing agencies that register or amend their registrations. No new deadline or compliance date is stated in the notice.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15b9-1
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB review of an information collection tied to amended Rule 15b9-1 for broker-dealers relying on the stock-option order exemption. It does not itself change the rule, but it describes written policy and recordkeeping burdens for affected broker-dealers under the SEC’s existing exemption framework.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form 20-F
summary: The SEC has submitted an OMB extension request for Form 20-F, the annual reporting form for foreign private issuers. The notice invites public comment by 2026-10-15. It does not change the form’s substantive requirements, but it signals continued mandatory annual reporting and associated burden estimates.

title: Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guidance
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC and NCUA have issued proposed interagency third-party risk management guidance and are seeking comments by 2026-11-16. The proposal would update and replace existing guidance for banking organizations, with expectations scaled to size, complexity, risk profile and the nature of third-party relationships.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice of bank holding company application(s) for public comment under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit views on the listed acquisition by 2026-10-15.

title: Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guide for Traditional Community Banking Organizations
summary: The Federal Reserve is seeking comment on a proposed third-party risk management guide for traditional community banking organizations (TCBOs). It would be a companion to the agencies’ broader proposed third-party risk guidance and give smaller community banks practical examples for managing third-party risks. Comments are due by 2026-11-16. The guide is not binding.

title: Order Granting Exemptive Relief, Pursuant to Section 36(a)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, From Inline XBRL Requirements for Portions of Form CA-1 and Form 1 and for Form X-17A-5 Part III, Form 17-H, and Security-Based Swap Entity's Annual Compliance Report
summary: The SEC granted exemptive relief from Inline XBRL filing requirements for parts of Form CA-1 and Form 1, Form X-17A-5 Part III, Form 17-H, and SBS entities’ annual compliance reports. The relief applies to the specified registrants and reports, but they still must file electronically on EDGAR. No exact compliance date is stated in the order.

title: In the Matter of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Order Granting Petitions for Review and Scheduling Filing of Statements Regarding an Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To Adopt a New Continued Listing Requirement
summary: The SEC granted petitions to review an order approving Nasdaq’s proposed continued listing requirement and kept that approval stayed pending further Commission order. Parties or other persons may file statements supporting or opposing the approval order by 2026-10-06. This is a procedural Commission notice, not a new rule or obligation for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Securities Act Rule 192
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on extending the Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Securities Act Rule 192. It affects securitization participants that rely on Rule 192 exceptions and must maintain an internal compliance program and written policies and procedures. Comments on the 60-day notice are due by 2026-11-16.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form N-6F
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on extending the existing Form N-6F information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Companies intending to elect business development company status may need to file the form once before making that election. Comments on the collection notice are due by 2026-11-16.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 12d1-4
summary: The SEC issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on extending the information collection associated with Rule 12d1-4. It describes recordkeeping and voting-related burden estimates for registered funds and BDCs that rely on the rule; it does not change the rule’s requirements or set a new compliance date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Options 10, Section 27
summary: Nasdaq ISE has filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Options 10, Section 27 so it is substantially similar to FINRA Rule 3220 on influencing or rewarding employees of others, plus a technical amendment to Options 10, Section 7. The SEC is soliciting comments, and the change supports a 17d-2 allocation of regulatory responsibility. No firm deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Establish a Guaranty Fund at the Government Securities Division
summary: The SEC notice extends the review period for FICC’s proposed rule change to establish a guaranty fund at the Government Securities Division. The Commission now must act by 2026-11-09. This is a procedural timing notice only; it does not itself approve or impose the rule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Fee Schedule
summary: The SEC published notice of MEMX LLC’s immediately effective rule filing to amend its options fee schedule. The changes adjust rebates and fees for several customer, market maker, professional, firm, away market maker and broker-dealer categories, and add a new customer volume tier. The exchange said it planned to implement the changes on 2026-09-01.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rules 11.1, 11.6, 11.7, and 11.8 To Add a New Time-in-Force Designation Known as “Regular `til Post Market”
summary: Cboe EDGA has filed a proposed rule change to add a new time-in-force order type, “Regular ’til Post Market,” for execution during regular trading hours and the post-closing session, and to make conforming rule updates. This is a proposal, not a final rule. Comments were being solicited when published; no compliance date is stated.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the Options Order Protection and Locked/Crossed Market Plan To Add Investors Exchange LLC as a Participant
summary: The SEC notice says an amendment to the Options Order Protection and Locked/Crossed Market Plan became immediately effective to add IEX as a participant. This affects options exchanges participating in the plan; comments were solicited, but no new firm obligations are created in the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rules 11.1(a), 11.9(b), and 11.23 To Add a New Time-in-Force Designation Known as “Regular til Post Market”
summary: The SEC is publishing a notice of a Cboe BYX Exchange proposed rule change, with immediate effectiveness, to add a new time-in-force order type called “Regular til Post Market” and make conforming rule updates. It affects exchange users and members trading on BYX. No firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Extend the Implementation Timeframe To Permit Trading of Pegged Orders During Pre-Market and Post-Market Sessions
summary: IEX filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to extend by 60 days the deadline for announcing the implementation date of a prior rule change allowing pegged orders during pre- and post-market sessions. The new Trading Alert deadline would move from October 8, 2026 to December 7, 2026, with at least 10 days' notice before implementation.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the Options Order Protection and Locked/Crossed Market Plan To Add MX2 LLC as a Participant
summary: The SEC published notice of an immediate-effective amendment to the Options Order Protection and Locked/Crossed Market Plan adding MX2 LLC as a participant. Interested persons may submit comments, but the filing itself is a technical/ministerial plan amendment and does not impose new operating requirements on banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule Equity 7 Regarding Pricing of Ports for the Night Session
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to amend Exchange Rule Equity 7 to clarify fees for Night Session ports and grant certain fee waivers to support member participation. The SEC is soliciting comments. Nasdaq said it plans to implement the fee changes on 2026-09-01.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 11.29 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe BZX’s proposed rule change, filed as immediately effective and non-controversial, to amend Rule 11.29 on trading halts and resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions. It mainly affects BZX as an exchange and market participants in securities trading. The notice invites comments; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rules 11.1(a), 11.9(b), 11.23, and 11.24 To Add a New Time-in-Force Designation Known as “Regular `til Post Market”
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed exchange rule change to add a new time-in-force order type, “Regular ’til Post Market,” allowing execution during regular and after-hours trading, with unexecuted shares expiring at the end of after-hours trading. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing; it affects exchange users and members and does not yet impose a binding firm obligation.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities (including E.O. 13224 and E.O. 13902). U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Effective September 8, 2026.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List and blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. This takes effect from the listed action date of 2026-09-10 and is immediately relevant for sanctions screening and payment controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List on 2026-09-04 under E.O. 13902, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Sanctions screening and payments controls should be updated immediately for any exposed customers, counterparties, or transactions.

title: Funding Opportunity; Notice of Allocation Availability Inviting Applications for the Calendar Years 2026 Allocation Round of the New Markets Tax Credit Program
summary: The Treasury CDFI Fund announced the 2026 New Markets Tax Credit allocation round and its application deadlines, including certification, registration, application, and post-award reporting dates. It offers up to $5 billion of allocation authority and describes the application process and program terms for certified CDEs seeking awards.

title: Sunshine Act Notice: FDIC Board of Directors Meeting
summary: FDIC announced an open Sunshine Act Board meeting on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET, to be observed by webcast or in person at FDIC Headquarters. No regulatory requirements or policy changes are announced.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend NYSE American Equities Price List and Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective change to its equities price list and fee schedule, adjusting transaction fees and optional monthly credits for eDMMs in assigned securities. The change is effective September 1, 2026. The SEC notice solicits comments on the filing but does not itself impose a new obligation on banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Introduce Conforming Changes to Nasdaq Texas Rules in Connection With the Establishment of Fees for Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus by the Nasdaq Stock Exchange
summary: The SEC published notice of Nasdaq Texas’s immediately effective proposed rule change to make conforming fee-rule updates for new Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus products. The filing adjusts distributor, consolidation and administrative fee references in Nasdaq Texas’s rulebook. It is a market-data exchange filing, not a direct rule imposing obligations on banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Set Fees for Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus
summary: Nasdaq has filed, with immediate effectiveness, a proposed rule change to set fees for its new Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus market data products. The SEC is publishing the notice and seeking comments. The filing concerns exchange members, market data vendors and users of Nasdaq U.S. equity market feeds; no compliance deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Introduce Conforming Changes to Nasdaq Phlx Rules in Connection With the Establishment of Fees for Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Nasdaq PHLX proposed rule change that would make conforming fee-rule updates tied to the launch of Nasdaq TotalView Plus and Nasdaq Basic Plus. The changes affect market data distributor, consolidation and administrative fees for certain PSX data products. No compliance deadline is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Pursuant to IEX Rule 15.110(a) and (c) To Provide That Extranet Providers, in Addition to Data Subscribers, Are also Eligible To Earn the External Distribution Rebate by Enlisting New Data Subscribers of Real-Time IEX Market Data Products
summary: The SEC notice publishes an immediately effective IEX fee-schedule amendment that expands eligibility for the External Distribution Rebate: extranet providers, not just data subscribers, can earn it by bringing in new real-time IEX market data subscribers. The change is operative from 2026-09-01 and affects firms participating in IEX market-data distribution and rebate arrangements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Fee Schedule To Establish Fees for Industry Members Related to Certain Historical Costs of the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail
summary: The SEC published a notice of filing and immediate effectiveness for TXSE’s proposed fee schedule change. TXSE will establish connectivity fees and fees for certain historical CAT costs for industry members, to apply when the exchange begins operations as a national securities exchange. This is a market-structure and reporting-related change affecting exchange participants and connected firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Fee Schedule To Modify the Priority Customer Rebate Program Table for Certain Transactions in Complex Orders
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule and Priority Customer Rebate Program for certain complex-order transactions. It affects MIAX options market members trading complex orders; no filing deadline is stated in the excerpt, but the notice invites comments.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting To Be Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a Board meeting on September 17, 2026. The agenda includes two proposed rulemakings on merger transactions and state bank parity, plus a vote on rescinding a supervisory recommendations statement. This notice itself creates no obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Order Granting Conditional Exemptive Relief Pursuant to Section 36 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Relating to Rule Filing Requirements
summary: The SEC granted LCH SA conditional exemptive relief from certain Exchange Act rule-filing requirements under Section 19(b) and Rule 19b-4 for specified non-U.S. clearing business changes. The order affects how LCH SA must notify the SEC of covered rule changes, rather than imposing a new filing obligation on banks. No firm-wide compliance date is set in the excerpt.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Order Approving the Third Amendment to the National Market System Plan Regarding Consolidated Equity Market Data To Revise the Revenue Allocation Formula
summary: The SEC approved the third amendment to the CT National Market System Plan’s revenue allocation formula for consolidated equity market data. The change caps the share of revenue attributable to quoting activity relative to trading activity among participating exchanges and FINRA. It is now approved and binding for the plan members.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change Relating to the LCH SA CDSClear Trade Registration Fund
summary: The SEC approved LCH SA’s rule change to create a Trade Registration Fund for CDSClear. The new facility changes how clearing members can meet margin requirements to avoid trade rejections, with separate TRF contributions and related forbearance mechanics. It applies to LCH SA clearing members and is effective as approved, with no comment objections noted.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; 24X National Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend 24X Rule 8.1(d) To Clarify Certain Disciplinary Functions by FINRA's Office of Disciplinary Affairs
summary: 24X National Exchange filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately under SEC filing procedures, to clarify that FINRA’s Office of Disciplinary Affairs may perform certain disciplinary functions for the exchange under a regulatory services agreement. The SEC is soliciting comments on the proposal. This affects exchange disciplinary governance rather than imposing a direct new firm obligation.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Sections 1003 and 1009 of the NYSE American Company Guide
summary: The SEC extended the deadline to act on NYSE American’s proposed rule change to amend Company Guide Sections 1003 and 1009, which would require issuers to maintain a minimum market capitalisation to stay listed. The Commission now must approve or disapprove the proposal by 2026-11-15. This is a procedural notice on a pending exchange rule change, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend Rule 7.18E Regarding Initial Listing Regulatory Halts
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective rule change to clarify Rule 7.18E on initial listing regulatory halts. It states the halt does not apply to IPOs and that trading resumes via a Trading Halt Auction after the halt ends. The filing is published for comment and is effective immediately, with no separate compliance date stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the NYSE Arca Equities Fees and Charges
summary: NYSE Arca filed a proposed rule change to amend its equities fee schedule for retail tiers, including reinstating a modifier for certain retail orders and excluding certain order types from a retail liquidity-removal fee. The SEC is soliciting comments, and the exchange says the fee changes were effective September 1, 2026.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form 2-E, Report Pursuant to Rule 609 and Regulation E
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB extension of the existing mandatory Form 2-E information collection under Rule 609 and Regulation E for exempt securities offerings. Small business investment companies and business development companies that use Regulation E must continue semi-annual reporting, and the public comment period closes on 2026-10-19.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form 15F
summary: The SEC has submitted an OMB extension request for the information collection tied to Form 15F, used by foreign private issuers that terminate or suspend Exchange Act reporting. Public comments are invited within 30 days after publication, by 2026-10-19. No substantive rule change is made, but firms using Form 15F should note the ongoing reporting burden and comment deadline.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 30b1-10, Form N-RN
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB approval to extend the existing information collection for Rule 30b1-10 and Form N-RN. Registered open-end funds, closed-end funds and BDCs must continue filing a current, non-public report within one business day after specified liquidity or VaR-breach events. This is a paperwork-collection notice rather than a new rule, but the filing obligation remains mandatory.

title: FDIC Board of Directors Meeting
summary: FDIC published a Board meeting notice summarizing items discussed in open session, including proposed rules on merger transactions and state bank parity, and rescission of a 2016 supervisory recommendations statement. The notice itself does not create new requirements or deadlines.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation and acquisition applications and invited public comments by 2026-10-19. It describes proposed conversions, mergers, and share acquisitions involving named bank groups in Massachusetts and North Dakota. This is an informational notice only; it does not itself approve the transactions or create new requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on a pending Change in Bank Control Act application for a family trust to join a control group and acquire shares of a bank holding company, indirectly acquiring a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-10-05. This is an authorisation/perimeter notice, not a rule change.

title: Public Company Accounting Oversight Board; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rules on Amendments to QC 1000, A Firm's System of Quality Control, and Related Rule and Forms
summary: The SEC published notice of PCAOB proposed amendments to QC 1000, related PCAOB rules and forms, and technical amendments to AS 2101, and is soliciting public comments. The changes would narrow and simplify some quality-control requirements for registered public accounting firms and related audits, including EGC audits. This is not yet binding; firms should track the proposal and comment period.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit the Listing of Binary KPI Options
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on NYSE Arca’s proposed rule change to allow listing of binary KPI options tied to issuer-reported performance metrics. This is a proposed exchange rule change, so firms involved in options trading or product governance should review the proposal and comment if relevant; no compliance deadline applies yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Introduce a Data Vendor Program
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to create a Data Vendor Program and related definitions in its fee schedule. The program would grant fee waivers for certain external distributors of Cboe market data if they meet specified eligibility criteria and provide attestations. No firm action date is stated beyond the filing and comment process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit the Listing of Binary KPI Options
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on NYSE American’s proposed rule change to allow listing of binary KPI options tied to issuer-reported performance metrics. This is a proposal only, not a final rule; market participants should review the filing and comment if affected. No compliance date is set yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: NYSE has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately pending SEC review, to amend Rule 7.18 on trading halts and resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions. It aims to align with other markets ahead of 23/5 trading and to provide clearer halt/resume procedures. No firm deadline is stated, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq MRX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Options 2, Section 3, Appointment of Market Makers
summary: Nasdaq MRX filed a proposed rule change that would make appointment of a Primary Market Maker in each options class permissive rather than mandatory. The change affects options market structure on MRX and would not alter a PMM’s duties once appointed. SEC published the notice and invited comments; no closing date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Options 2, Section 3, Appointment of Market Makers
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change to make appointment of a Primary Market Maker permissive rather than mandatory for each options class. The SEC is publishing the filing for comment; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt. If adopted, the change would affect exchange members and options market-making arrangements on GEMX.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rules 11.1, 11.6, 11.7, and 11.8 To Add a New Time-in-Force Designation Known as “Regular `til Post Market”
summary: The SEC published a notice of a Cboe EDGX proposed rule change to add a new time-in-force order type, “Regular ’til Post Market,” and make related conforming edits to order-handling rules. It would let eligible limit orders execute during regular trading hours and the post-closing session, with any remainder expiring at the end of the post-closing session. No firm deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Introduce a Data Vendor Program
summary: The SEC is publishing a Cboe EDGX Exchange proposal to add a Data Vendor Program and related fee waivers for certain market data products. The exchange also proposes to define “Data Vendor,” codify existing definitions and practices, and set eligibility criteria and attestations. This is a proposed rule change, so it is open for comment rather than yet binding.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Adopt FINRA Rule 3290 (Outside Activities Requirements)
summary: The SEC approved FINRA’s new Rule 3290 on outside activities, replacing FINRA Rules 3270 and 3280 for associated persons of FINRA member firms. The approval order makes the rule change effective for covered firms once FINRA implements it, so member firms should review outside business and private securities transaction controls and related disclosures and records.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.12 Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt in Connection With the Industry's Expansion of Trading Hours to 23 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week
summary: The SEC published NYSE’s proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.12 on reopening trading after a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt, to align with expanded 23/5 trading hours. This is a solicitation of comments, not a final rule. No immediate operational change is stated for NYSE itself; the notice explains the rule change in the context of planned overnight trading from December 6, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.12-E Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt in Connection With the Expansion of Trading Hours to 23 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week
summary: NYSE Arca has filed a proposed rule change to keep its current 4:00 a.m. ET reopening time after a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt, even when it expands trading to 23 hours a day, 5 days a week. This is a proposal for comment under SEC Section 19(b)(1); no immediate obligation applies unless and until approved.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 2628 Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt in Connection With the Industry's Expansion of Trading Hours to 23 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX PEARL’s proposed rule change to amend its market-wide circuit breaker halt rule for the industry’s move to 23-hours-a-day, 5-days-a-week trading. The change would alter when trading resumes after a Level 3 halt for affected U.S. equity exchange activity. Comments are being solicited; no binding rule is in force yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Rules at Options 7, Sections 1 and 2
summary: The SEC published Nasdaq’s proposed immediate-effective rule change to amend NOM Options 7 fee and rebate schedules and add a defined term. It affects options market participants using Nasdaq options pricing, with no stated compliance date in the excerpt. Interested persons are invited to comment on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Introduce a Data Vendor Program
summary: The SEC is publishing Cboe EDGA Exchange’s proposed rule change to add a Data Vendor program and related definitions to its fee schedule, with fee waivers for eligible data vendors distributing Cboe One feeds. This is a market-data/exchange rule filing rather than a final rule. Firms using or redistributing the affected feeds should review the proposed eligibility criteria and comment process; no implementation date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MX2 LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt the Framework of the Exchange's Initial Fee Schedule and Establish an Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on MX2 LLC’s proposed fee filing for its new options market. The exchange would adopt an initial fee schedule framework and impose an options regulatory fee of $0.0200 per contract side, effective when operations begin on 2026-09-14. Relevant for firms trading or clearing on the exchange; comments are invited under the SEC notice process.

title: OneAscent Capital Opportunities Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application seeking exemptive relief for certain BDCs and closed-end and open-end funds to co-invest in portfolio companies with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-10-13. This is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order.

title: Commission on Social Impact Partnerships; Public Meeting
summary: Treasury announced a public meeting of the Commission on Social Impact Partnerships on September 22, 2026. The notice gives attendance and written-comment logistics and says the meeting will include updates on SIPPRA program structure, a forthcoming NOFO, and current awardees. It does not create new obligations.

title: Renewal of Agency Information Collection of a Previously Approved Collection; Request for Comments
summary: NCUA is seeking comments on renewal and revision of several Paperwork Reduction Act information collections for federally insured credit unions, including excess insurance advertising, AML/CFT programs, low-income designation, Truth in Savings disclosures, and prompt corrective action. The notice does not itself change substantive rules; comments are due by 2026-10-21.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for September 24, 2026, and listed general subjects to be discussed, including enforcement, litigation, examinations, and other regulatory matters. No new rules, obligations, or deadlines are created.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail To Add MX2 LLC as a Participant
summary: The SEC published notice that an amendment to the CAT NMS Plan became immediately effective to add MX2 LLC as a participant. Interested persons may submit comments, and the Commission can abrogate the amendment within 60 days. This is mainly an operational market-structure notice for exchange participants, not a new substantive rule for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposal To Amend the Exchange's Rules at Equity 1 and Equity 4 To Enable the Exchange To Become a Primary Listing Venue
summary: The SEC published a notice of Nasdaq Texas’s immediately effective rule filing to amend Equity 1 and Equity 4, aligning its rules with Nasdaq so it can become a primary listing venue. The changes update definitions and replace the trading-halt rule framework. This is relevant now for the exchange and any firms using or listing on Nasdaq Texas.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Address Internal Inconsistencies in Rule 22.260 in Advance of the Launch of IEX Options
summary: The SEC published notice of IEX’s proposed immediate-effective rule change to fix internal inconsistencies in Rule 22.260 before IEX Options launches on 2026-10-02. It would delete Rule 22.260(b) and expand the orders exempted from Rule 22.260(e). The notice invites comments; it does not itself impose a new requirement on market participants.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Partial Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Change as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, by the Options Clearing Corporation Concerning the Payment of Interest on Margin Cash
summary: The SEC approved, with modification, an OCC rule change that would let OCC pay interest on certain margin cash and use Federal Reserve Bank subaccounts for securities customer margin. The change affects OCC clearing members and clearing arrangements in the US. The notice also seeks comments on the partial amendment, but the approval is already granted.

title: Acknowledgement of Receipt of Notice of Registration as a National Securities Exchange Pursuant to Section 6(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc.
summary: The SEC acknowledged receipt of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc.’s Form 1-N notice to register as a national securities exchange for trading security futures products under Section 6(g) of the Exchange Act. This is relevant to exchanges or firms seeking similar registration, and the registration becomes effective on filing. No new deadline is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board; Order Granting Approval of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend MSRB Rule G-27 to Exclude Certain Public Finance Activities From the Term “Structuring of Public Offerings or Private Placements,” Extend the Length of the Exclusion for Non-Primary Residences From Municipal Branch Office Designation, and Make a Technical Update to the Rule's Title
summary: The SEC approved an MSRB rule change to Rule G-27 for municipal securities dealers. The change narrows certain public finance activities excluded from “structuring” supervision, extends the non-primary residence branch-office exclusion, and makes a technical title update. The MSRB will publish the operative date; compliance will be no earlier than 90 days and no later than 180 days after SEC approval.

title: Wasatch Funds Trust and Wasatch Advisors LP
summary: The SEC published a notice of an exemptive application from Wasatch Funds Trust and Wasatch Advisors LP seeking relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure combining an ETF class with mutual fund classes. It is a notice only, not a rule or order, and sets a hearing request deadline of 2026-10-13.

title: Cybersecurity: Cybersecurity Supervision Work Program
summary: The OCC published a cybersecurity supervision work program for banks. It signals supervisory expectations and focus areas for cybersecurity oversight, but the excerpt does not show new binding rules or deadlines.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a closed Board meeting held on September 17, 2026. It describes the meeting time, place, and the broad topics considered, but it does not create or change any requirements for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held with Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: The FDIC published a Sunshine Act notice reporting an open Board meeting held on September 17, 2026, including items discussed and a board vote on a rescission. It does not itself create or change requirements for firms.

title: Order Granting Temporary Conditional Exemptive Relief, Pursuant to Section 36(a)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, From the Definition of “Exchange” in Section 3(a)(1) of the Exchange Act for the Use of Certain Distributed Ledger Trading Venues for Tokenized NMS Stocks and From the Definition of “Dealer” in Section 3(a)(5) of the Exchange Act for Certain Liquidity Providers for Tokenized NMS Stocks, and Request for Comment
summary: The SEC granted temporary conditional exemptive relief for certain distributed ledger trading venues to facilitate trading of tokenized NMS stocks, and for certain liquidity providers in tokenized stock liquidity pools. The order also requests comment. It affects SEC-regulated market participants that want to operate these venues or provide liquidity, with conditions applying immediately under the order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule for Step Up Mechanism Auctions
summary: The SEC has published a Cboe C2 proposed rule change, effective immediately under exchange filing procedures, to amend its fee schedule for Step Up Mechanism (SUM) auctions. The change would reverse how add/remove fees are applied in SUM executions, affecting exchange users trading options on Cboe C2. No filing deadline is given, but the notice is open for public comment.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Options 10, Section 27, Influencing or Rewarding Employees of Others
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed a proposed rule change to add Options 10, Section 27 on influencing or rewarding employees of others, largely mirroring FINRA Rule 3220. It would cap gifts/gratuities at $300 per person per year, require written agreements and records for certain employment-related payments, and allow exemptive relief. This is a proposal, so firms may comment before any further action.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.10 Clearly Erroneous Executions
summary: NYSE has filed a proposed rule change to extend its clearly erroneous execution protections under Rule 7.10 to periods when overnight price bands apply for 23/5 trading. It is a consultation notice, not a final rule. Interested persons may submit comments; no compliance date is set in the text.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Extend
summary: The CFTC is seeking 60 days of public comment on extending OMB Control No. 3038-0062 for off-exchange foreign currency transaction information collection under Part 5 of its rules. The notice affects RFEDs, FCMs, IBs, CTAs and CPOs engaged in these activities. Comments are due by 2026-11-23.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The designation was issued on 2026-09-17 and is effective immediately for U.S. sanctions screening and transaction blocking.

title: CFTC Releases Staff Advisory on Mention Markets
summary: The CFTC Division of Market Oversight issued staff advisory guidance on “mention market” event contracts for designated contract markets. It explains when such contracts may be listed under CEA/Commission rules and reminds DCMs of their anti-manipulation obligations and need for complete Part 40 submissions. No fixed deadline is set; the advisory applies immediately as supervisory guidance.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company application and merger activity, inviting public comments by 2026-10-23 on Security Bancshares Corporation’s proposal to acquire The State Bank of Wynnewood. This is a notice of application, not a rule or approval, and does not itself create obligations.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications by companies to engage in or acquire permissible nonbanking activities under HOLA and Regulation LL. Affected parties may submit comments by 2026-10-23. This is an application/public notice rather than a rule change, and it is relevant mainly to savings and loan holding companies and related applicants in the United States.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on applications under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for certain parties to acquire or retain voting shares of Pioneer Development Company and indirectly Pioneer Bank. Interested persons may comment by 2026-10-08. This is a public notice of pending ownership-change applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; KalshiEX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Listing Standards for Security Futures Products
summary: SEC notice solicits comments on KalshiEX’s proposed rule change to add Chapter 14 and list perpetual security futures products tied to equity securities. The filing says the change would allow the exchange to offer these contracts and have them cleared by Kalshi Klear, subject to applicable eligibility and settlement rules. No compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Bitnomial Exchange, LLC; Notice of a Filing of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Security Futures Product Listing Standards, Customer Margin and Related Rules
summary: The SEC published notice of Bitnomial Exchange’s proposed rule change for comment. The proposal would create listing, margin, settlement, trading-halt and membership rules for cash-settled security futures products, including perpetual contracts, for exchange participants and clearing members. No compliance date is set yet; this is a proposal, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Coinbase Derivatives, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Adoption of Coinbase Derivatives, LLC's Rules Governing Cash Settled Futures on Individual Equity Securities and Exchange-Traded Fund Shares, Including Perpetual Single-Stock Futures
summary: The SEC published notice of Coinbase Derivatives, LLC’s immediately effective proposed rule change to add Chapter 12 rules for cash-settled futures on individual equities and ETF shares, including perpetual single-stock futures. It solicits comments on the filing; no firm compliance deadline is stated in the excerpt. The rules would govern listing standards, contract terms, trading, clearing and settlement for these products.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.10-E Clearly Erroneous Executions
summary: NYSE Arca filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its clearly erroneous execution rule, mainly to align it with overnight price-band protections approved for 23/5 trading. The change affects exchange trading participants and market participants using NYSE Arca rules; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.13(a) To Replace the Term “Registered Clearing Agency” With “Qualified Clearing Agency” and Clarify That a Non-Member May Act as a Clearing Firm
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a Cboe EDGA Exchange proposed rule change that would update Rule 11.13(a) to replace “registered clearing agency” with “Qualified Clearing Agency” and clarify that a non-member may act as a clearing firm. It affects exchange members and clearing arrangements, but no new binding rule is in force yet. Comments are due on the proposal filing timeline; no separate compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.15(a) To Clarify That a Non-Member May Act as a Clearing Firm
summary: Cboe BZX filed an immediately effective rule change clarifying that a non-member firm may act as a clearing firm under Rule 11.15(a). The change affects exchange members using clearing arrangements and is already effective upon filing, with SEC comment solicitation continuing after publication.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.13(a) To Replace the Term “registered clearing agency” With “Qualified Clearing Agency;” Clarify That a Non-Member May Act as a Clearing Firm; and Require That a Member Seeking To Participate in the Exchange's Overnight Trading Session Maintain a Separate, Effective Letter of Guarantee or Authorization From a Clearing Firm
summary: The SEC published notice of an immediate-effective proposed rule change by Cboe EDGX. The exchange would update Rule 11.13(a) to replace “registered clearing agency” with “Qualified Clearing Agency,” clarify that non-members may act as clearing firms, and require members using the overnight trading session to maintain a separate, effective letter of guarantee or authorization from an approved clearing firm.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Relating To Amend Rule 11.15(a) To Clarify That a Non-Member May Act as a Clearing Firm
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Cboe BYX proposed rule change that would clarify Rule 11.15(a) to allow a non-member firm to act as a clearing firm for exchange members. No immediate compliance date is set in this notice, but the filing is effective on submission and may affect clearing arrangements for broker-dealers and clearing firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the Implementation Schedule of Amendments To Schedule A to the FINRA By-Laws Adopted in SR-FINRA-2024-019 as Modified in SR-FINRA-2025-007
summary: FINRA filed a rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to modify the implementation schedule for previously adopted fee-related amendments to Schedule A of the FINRA By-Laws. The change affects the timing of certain Corporate Financing review fees for private placements and public offerings, which were postponed to January 1, 2027. FINRA also solicits comments on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change to Temporarily Pause Assessment of the Trading Activity Fee
summary: FINRA filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to pause assessment of the Trading Activity Fee for three months, covering transactions from 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31. The SEC is soliciting comments, but the fee pause is effective upon filing. Broker-dealers and other FINRA members should review billing and pass-through arrangements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 13902, blocking their property and interests in property within U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-09-14 and published on 2026-09-23.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC removed several persons and entities from the SDN List after the Ethiopia sanctions emergency under Executive Order 14046 expired on 2026-09-17. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of those names are no longer blocked. This is effective immediately on the notice date.

title: Renewal of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Committee
summary: The Treasury Department renewed the IRS Advisory Committee under the Federal Advisory Committee Act. This is a notice of committee renewal, not a rule or enforcement action, and it does not create new obligations for firms. The committee may continue advising the IRS after the charter is filed with Congress no earlier than seven days after publication.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisition/retention of voting shares in a bank holding company and related bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-10-09. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comment on renewal of the existing Summary of Deposits information collection for FDIC-insured depository institutions and insured U.S. branches of foreign banks. The collection itself is unchanged, but the estimated annual burden is revised. Comments are due by 2026-10-26.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17a-4(b)(17)
summary: The SEC seeks OMB renewal of the information collection under Rule 17a-4(b)(17) for broker-dealers that rely on specified exceptions for nonconvertible securities. The notice does not change the rule, but invites public comment by 2026-10-26 and reiterates the record-preservation burden and retention expectations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 101 of Regulation M
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB approval to extend the information collection associated with Rule 101 of Regulation M. Market participants covered by the rule may comment by 2026-10-26; this notice does not change the substantive rule itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the Processing of Orders During a Regulatory Halt and Certain Aspects of the Exchange's IPO Auctions, Halt Auctions, and Volatility Closing Auctions
summary: The SEC has published notice of TXSE’s proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing but open to comments, to change order handling during regulatory halts and to adjust IPO, halt and volatility closing auction mechanics. The proposal affects which orders are cancelled, rejected or carried into auctions, and how auction information and price selection work. No firm deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Criteria for Underlying Securities
summary: The SEC extended its review period for Nasdaq ISE’s proposed rule change on options listing criteria for commodity-based trusts holding digital commodities. The Commission now has until 2026-11-11 to approve, disapprove, or institute proceedings; this is a procedural notice, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To Accommodate Stop-Limit Complex Orders and To Establish Stop Complex Order Auctions as a New Type of Auction Mechanism
summary: The SEC published a notice extending its deadline to act on Cboe Exchange’s proposed rule change for stop-limit complex orders and a new auction mechanism. The Commission now has until 2026-11-21 to approve or disapprove the proposal. This is procedural and does not itself change requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Coinbase Derivatives, LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Customer Margin Requirements for Security Futures Products
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on Coinbase Derivatives’ proposed rule change to set customer margin requirements for security futures products. The filing would govern margin rates, eligible collateral, and liquidation requirements for Participant Firms and Clearing Firms. No compliance deadline is set in this notice; comments are invited on the proposed exchange rule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.10 Clearly Erroneous Executions
summary: The SEC published a notice of NYSE National’s immediately effective proposed rule change to Rule 7.10 on clearly erroneous executions. The change would extend the existing restrictions on clearly erroneous review to overnight trading when Overnight Price Bands are in place under the LULD Plan. This is a comment-solicitation filing, not a final rule, so firms should monitor but no immediate compliance date is set.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Tax Return Preparer Complaint Process and Fraud or Misconduct Affidavit
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an extension of an existing information collection for tax return preparer complaints and fraud or misconduct affidavits. It does not change the forms or create new requirements; comments are due by 2026-11-23.

title: Notification of Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee Public Meeting-October 6, 2026
summary: The U.S. Mint announced a public meeting of the Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee for October 6, 2026. The notice gives the agenda, remote access details, and a deadline of September 29, 2026 for accommodation requests. It is informational only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Notice of Proposals to Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of two section 4 Bank Holding Company Act proposals by bank holding companies to engage in or acquire permissible nonbanking activities. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-10-13. The notice is informational and does not itself change requirements.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application to acquire shares of a bank holding company and indirectly retain voting shares of a bank. Comments are due by 2026-10-13. This affects the named bank group and potential controllers, not a general rule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend NYSE Arca Rule 2.1210
summary: NYSE Arca has filed a proposed rule change to shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed qualification exams for ETP Holders, OTP Holders and OTP Firms, aligning with recent FINRA changes. The filing is for comment and is not yet binding. No exact compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule To Modify the Broker QCC Credit and Manual Billable Rebate Program
summary: NYSE Arca is immediately amending its options fee schedule, effective September 14, 2026, to lower volume thresholds for broker QCC credits and adjust the manual billable rebate program for floor brokers. This affects exchange participants trading NYSE Arca options and has already taken effect, though the SEC notice is also soliciting comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend NYSE American Rule 2.1210
summary: NYSE American filed and immediately made effective a rule change amending Rule 2.1210 to shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed FINRA qualification exams, aligning with FINRA’s recent exam-rule amendment. The change applies to member organizations, ETP Holders and ATP Holders. The notice solicits comments, but the exchange rule change is already effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend NYSE Rule 1210
summary: NYSE filed a proposed rule change to shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed qualification exams under NYSE Rule 1210, aligning with a recent FINRA amendment. The change would affect member organizations and associated persons who take NYSE/FINRA qualification exams; the SEC is soliciting comments. No compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend NYSE National Rule 2.1210
summary: NYSE National filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing but still open for SEC comment, to shorten the retake waiting periods for failed qualification exams for ETP Holders and associated registered persons. The change aligns NYSE National Rule 2.1210 with a recent FINRA amendment, reducing delays from 30 to 15 days for the first two failures and from 180 to 60 days after subsequent failures within two years.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend NYSE Texas Article 6, Rule 13
summary: The SEC published notice of NYSE Texas’s proposed rule change to shorten waiting periods for retaking failed qualification exams, aligning with FINRA’s amended Rule 1210. It affects Participants and registered persons at NYSE Texas. The publication solicits comments; no compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18
summary: NYSE filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to clarify its trading-halt rules for initial listings. It would state that the Initial Listing Regulatory Halt does not apply to IPOs and would explicitly say trading resumes with a Trading Halt Auction. The notice solicits comments; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15c6-2
summary: The SEC issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking OMB approval to extend the information collection associated with Rule 15c6-2, which supports T+1 settlement for broker-dealers handling institutional trades. It does not itself change the rule, but reminds affected broker-dealers of the existing written policies/procedures and recordkeeping burden. No new compliance date is set.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 613 of Regulation NMS
summary: The SEC seeks OMB renewal of the information collection associated with Rule 613 of Regulation NMS and the CAT NMS Plan. This is an administrative paperwork notice about existing consolidated audit trail reporting/recordkeeping arrangements for SRO participants, not a new rule. No new compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 608
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB approval to extend the Rule 608 information collection for national market system plans. Self-regulatory organizations that create or amend NMS plans, and any plan participants or sponsors, must submit specified materials and keep plan websites current; the notice also covers plan processor selection filings. No new rule is proposed, but the paperwork burden remains mandatory.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15c3-3
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the Paperwork Reduction Act approval for Rule 15c3-3 (customer protection for broker-dealers), with a 30-day comment period ending 2026-10-26. The notice does not change the rule itself, but flags existing and amended reporting, notification, and recordkeeping burdens, including the 2024 daily reserve computation amendment for certain carrying broker-dealers.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17a-10
summary: The SEC seeks OMB renewal of the information collection under Rule 17a-10 for broker-dealers. The notice restates existing annual and quarterly FOCUS Report filing requirements and invites comments by 2026-10-26. No substantive rule change is made.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 31a-2
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection tied to Rule 31a-2 on record retention for funds and certain related entities. The rule’s existing retention periods and recordkeeping requirements are reiterated; the notice does not itself change the rule but confirms compliance is mandatory under the Investment Company Act. No specific implementation date is given.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17Ac3-1 and Form TA-W
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection for Rule 17Ac3-1 and Form TA-W, which governs how transfer agents file notices of withdrawal from registration. This is a comment request, not a new rule. Comments are due by 2026-10-26. It affects transfer agents and the filing process on EDGAR.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17f-2(e)
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB renewal of the information collection tied to Rule 17f-2(e), which requires covered entities claiming a fingerprinting exemption to prepare and retain a Notice Pursuant to Rule 17f-2. Public comments are due by 2026-10-26. Applicable to members of national securities exchanges, brokers, dealers, registered transfer agents and registered clearing agencies.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee
summary: The IRS announced an open virtual meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee on 21 October 2026. The public may attend and submit comments, with advance registration required by 16 October 2026. The notice is for information and participation only and does not create regulatory obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on applications by 1870 Holdings, Inc. to merge with Rushville Bancshares, Inc. and indirectly acquire Rushville State Bank. Comments must be received by 2026-10-28.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Investment Company Act Form N-17f-1, Certificate of Accounting of Securities and Similar Investments of a Management Investment Company in the Custody of Members of National Securities Exchanges
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on the extension of an existing information collection for Form N-17f-1, which registered management investment companies use when holding securities with members of national securities exchanges. The notice explains the filing frequency and estimated burden, but does not change the underlying rule or form. Comments are requested on the collection extension itself.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 30b2-1
summary: The SEC requests comment on extending the existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Rule 30b2-1. Registered management investment companies must continue filing Form N-CSR and related shareholder reports within 10 days of transmission. Comments on the 60-day notice are due by 2026-11-27.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting
summary: The SEC announced an open Sunshine Act meeting for September 30, 2026. Commissioners will discuss possible future proposals on adviser performance-based compensation, closed-end fund repurchase offers and share classes, and possible accredited-investor credential designations. This is only a meeting notice; it creates no immediate obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule To Amend the Exchange's Port Fees
summary: NYSE Arca filed a proposed rule change that became immediately effective to revise its Options Fee Schedule port fees. The new tiered monthly charges apply to OTP Holders and OTP Firms, with higher fees for ports 301 and above, effective September 17, 2026.
