summary: The CFPB requests public comment on extending approval for its Consumer Response Intake Form under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments on necessity, burden and ways to improve the collection are due by 2022-11-04. This is a notice, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: The NCUA Staff Draft 2023-2024 Budget Justification
summary: The NCUA published its staff draft 2023-2024 budget justification for public review and comment. It is a draft agency budget document, not a rule, and it does not create obligations for credit unions. Public comments and presentation requests were due in October 2022, with a budget briefing scheduled for 19 October 2022.

title: FDIC Advisory Committee of State Regulators; Notice of Meeting
summary: FDIC notice announcing an open meeting of the Advisory Committee of State Regulators. It is informational only and provides meeting logistics, webcast details, and contact information; it does not create or change regulatory requirements.

title: Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request
summary: NCUA published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act. It covers credit union fidelity bond/insurance reporting and NCUA personnel security forms, with comments due 2022-11-10. This is a comment request only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting
summary: FDIC notice announcing an open Board meeting on October 18, 2022. The agenda says the Board may consider final assessment rules, the 2023 designated reserve ratio, and proposed amendments to appeals guidelines, but the notice itself does not create requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions list immediately and stop any prohibited activity.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC updated the identifying information for one SDN List entity blocked under Executive Order 13224. Firms that screen sanctions lists should use the revised name and address details immediately when checking customers, counterparties and payments.

title: Sunshine Act Meeting; Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days Advance Notice
summary: FDIC notice of a Board meeting held on short notice, listing agenda items including a final rule on deposit insurance assessments, a final rule on revised assessment rates, an ANPR on resolution-related resource requirements for large banking organizations, and proposed changes to appeals guidelines. This is a meeting notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Designated Reserve Ratio for 2023
summary: The FDIC published its annual notice that the Designated Reserve Ratio for the Deposit Insurance Fund will remain at 2% for 2023. This applies to FDIC-insured banks and affects deposit insurance fund assessment settings, with no amendment needed to the existing regulation.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added several individuals and entities to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059 for illicit drug trafficking activity. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective as of the designation date, 2022-10-19.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection on cross-border margin requirements for uncleared swaps has been sent to OMB for 30-day review and public comment. It concerns swap dealers and major swap participants, with comments due by 2022-11-25. This is a request for comment, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
summary: The CFPB issued a 30-day public comment notice seeking comments on extending OMB approval for its ‘Survey Screening Question List’ information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2022-11-28. This is a request for comment on a research-related information collection, not a rule or binding requirement.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; OCC Supplier Registration Form
summary: The OCC published a notice seeking comments on renewal of its Supplier Registration Form information collection and sent it to OMB for review. Comments are due by 2022-11-28. The notice explains the PRA basis and the estimated burden, but it does not itself change requirements for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one individual and one Nicaraguan state-owned entity to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions list immediately; no future consultation or compliance date is stated.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC published a notice modifying its Privacy Act system of records FDIC-013, renaming it Financial Institution Resolution and Receivership Records, adding a new routine use, and updating retention and disposal practices. Comments were due by 2022-12-02, and the routine uses were set to become effective on 2022-12-02 unless changed after comment review. This mainly affects privacy and legal teams.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC announced termination of receiverships for nine failed insured depository institutions, effective 2022-11-01. The receiverships have been discharged and ceased to exist as legal entities. This is informational for US bank operations, legal and resolution teams; no ongoing filing or conduct obligation is created for firms.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The CFTC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting on November 15, 2022 to consider enforcement matters. This is a meeting notice only and does not create new requirements or deadlines.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Revision of Information Collection; FDIC National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households; Comment Request (3064-0215)
summary: The FDIC requests public comment on a proposed revision to its information collection for the National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households. Comments are due by 2023-01-13. The notice explains the survey’s purpose, burden estimate, and statutory basis under the Paperwork Reduction Act and a 2005 congressional mandate.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action removing Tornado Cash from the SDN List and unblocking its property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. This is an immediate sanctions list change relevant to firms screening customers, counterparties and digital asset addresses. No compliance deadline is stated, but list updates take effect immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added Tornado Cash and associated Ethereum addresses to the SDN List, blocking U.S.-jurisdiction property interests and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from transacting with the listed entity. This is effective immediately and affects sanctions screening, payments, and asset controls for any business dealing with crypto or cross-border counterparties.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals and an entity to the SDN List under Executive Order 14059 for illicit-drug-related activity. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and any property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective on the date of designation; firms should screen and block any matches immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice identifying one or more persons added to the SDN List and subject to U.S. blocking sanctions. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, and property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. Effective dates are referenced in the supplementary information, not stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Revision of an Approved Information Collection; Comment Request; Company-Run Annual Stress Test Reporting Template and Documentation for Covered Institutions With Total Consolidated Assets of $250 Billion or More Under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
summary: The OCC issued a notice seeking comments on a proposed revision to the approved information collection for company-run annual stress test reporting by covered institutions with $250 billion or more in assets. Comments are due by 2023-02-03. This is a PRA notice about reporting templates and paperwork burden, not a new stress test rule.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company proposal to acquire a savings association and engage in a permissible nonbanking activity under Regulation Y. summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquiring shares of a bank or bank holding company. summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Fulton Financial Corporation has applied to merge with Blue Foundry Bancorp and indirectly acquire Blue Foundry Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-01-21. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or approval.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Comment Request; OCC Supplier Registration Form
summary: The OCC is seeking comment on a revised OCC Supplier Registration Form under the Paperwork Reduction Act. The change updates the format of business classification information, but does not change the ability of suppliers to register. Comments are due by 2026-02-23.

title: Art Advisory Panel-Notice of Closed Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a closed Art Advisory Panel meeting on January 13, 2026 to review fair market value appraisals for art in federal income, estate, and gift tax returns. It is a notice of a meeting only and does not create or change any requirements for firms.

title: Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee; Request for Nominations
summary: The IRS is seeking nominations and applications for volunteer members of ETAAC, which advises on electronic tax administration and related issues. Applications are due by 2026-01-31. This is a request for candidates and committee formation notice only; it does not create new obligations for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and entities to the SDN List and identified related vessels as blocked property. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and any property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, effective from the December 11, 2025 designation date.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC announced that one or more persons have been removed from the SDN List and their property and interests in property are unblocked. This is effective for the listed persons as of December 30, 2025 and affects U.S.-jurisdiction dealings with those parties.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List to add several persons and vessels linked to Venezuela sanctions, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective as of the December 31, 2025 designation date and requires immediate sanctions screening and payment/transaction controls.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment on TD 7918, Creditability of Foreign Taxes
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection under TD 7918 on the creditability of foreign taxes. There is no substantive rule change; comments are due by 2026-03-10.

title: Debt Management Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a closed Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee meeting on 3 February 2026 to discuss the economy, financial markets, Treasury financing and debt management, and to provide recommendations to the Secretary. It is a notice only and does not create new requirements for firms.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Savings and Loan Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications for formations, acquisitions, and mergers of savings and loan holding companies under HOLA, Regulation LL, and Regulation MM. It invites public comments on whether the proposed transaction meets statutory standards, with comments due by 2026-02-09. This is an authorisation/perimeter notice for affected holding companies and savings associations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment on Return of Excise Taxes Related to Employee Benefit Plans
summary: The IRS issued a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comments on the existing information collection for Form 5330 and Form 8868, used to report and pay excise taxes related to employee benefit plans. There is no change to the approved collection. Comments are due by 2026-03-13.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on TD 8649, Netting Rule for Certain Conversion Transactions
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for TD 8649, the netting rule for certain conversion transactions. There is no change to the collection requirements. Comments are due by 2026-03-13.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company merger applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-02-11 on the listed transaction, including Associated Banc-Corp’s proposed merger with American National Corporation and indirect acquisition of American National Bank.

title: Interest Rate Paid on Cash Deposited To Secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Immigration Bonds
summary: Treasury published a notice setting the U.S. ICE immigration bond interest rate at 3% per annum for the quarter from 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31. It is an informational rate update under existing law, not a new rule. No action is required unless the firm handles these specific bonds.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is giving notice of a bank holding company merger application by Rhineland Bancshares, Inc. and inviting public comments by 2026-02-13. This is an application notice, not a rule change, and it concerns bank holding companies and related acquisitions in the US.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Poly(styrene-divinylbenzene-ethylvinylbenzene), With Styrene Content of Less Than 50% (x=7.64x1016, y=1.03x1017, z=2.28x1016)
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add Styrene-DVB-EVB (Styrene <50%) to the US Superfund list of taxable substances. This is not a final determination. Comments or hearing requests are due by 2026-03-16.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The IRS issued a notice establishing a new Privacy Act computer matching program to share tax return information with federal, state and local agencies for benefit eligibility and payment checks. Public comments are due within 30 days of Federal Register publication. If no comments are received, the re-established agreement is effective on 2026-01-15 and is expected to run through 2027-07-16.

title: Joint Report to Congressional Committees: Differences in Accounting and Capital Standards Among the Federal Banking Agencies as of September 30, 2025; Report to Congressional Committees
summary: The OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC published their annual report to Congress on differences in accounting and capital standards as of 2025-09-30. The report says no material differences were identified for insured depository institutions. It is informational only and creates no new requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment on Buildings Qualifying for Carryover Allocations
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for buildings qualifying for carryover allocations under low-income housing credit reporting. There is no change to the approved burden. Comments are due by 2026-03-23.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. This is effective from the action date of 2026-01-15.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Retirement Plans; Cash or Deferred Arrangements and Matching Contributions or Employee Contributions and Guidance With Respect to Matching Contributions Made on Account of Qualified Student Loan Payments
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an information collection related to retirement plans, including cash-or-deferred arrangements, matching contributions, and student-loan-related matching contributions. Comments are due by 2026-03-24. This notice does not itself change requirements; it supports a PRA submission tied to existing tax-qualification rules.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company acquisition/merger applications and invited public comments. FirstBanc of Alabama, Inc. proposed merging with FBDC Financial Corp. and indirectly acquiring First Fidelity Bank. Comments are due by 2026-02-23.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury published a notice seeking OMB review and public comment on several IRS information collection requests, including withholding tax, debt instruments, timely filing, and golden parachute payment forms/rules. Comments are due by 2026-03-04. It does not itself change any tax obligations.

title: Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee; Request for Nominations-Correction of Application Deadline Date
summary: The IRS corrected the application deadline for nominations to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee. The new deadline is February 28, 2026, replacing January 31, 2026. This is a public notice about advisory committee membership, not a rule or requirement for firms.

title: Meeting
summary: The U.S. Mint announced a public Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee meeting on February 24, 2026 to review coin and medal design portfolios and related commemorative recommendations. It is for public observation only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Notice of Termination of Receiverships
summary: The FDIC published a notice stating that receivership for The First State Bank (Barboursville, West Virginia) was terminated effective 2026-02-01 after the Receiver completed required asset liquidation and distributions. This is a point-in-time status notice with no new compliance deadline or rulemaking.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists to improve data standardization and correct minor errors. This affects screening and sanctions operations immediately for any parties using OFAC lists. No new sanctions are imposed, but list data has been amended.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC has published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries already on its sanctions lists, to improve standardisation or correct minor errors. This affects screening and sanctions controls immediately on publication; no new sanctions target or deadline is created.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists, mainly to improve standardization or correct minor errors. Firms should check screening and sanctions controls against the updated names and relevant authorities. No new sanctions program or separate compliance deadline is stated in the notice.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and vessels to the SDN List, blocking property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This takes effect immediately on the dates stated in the notice and is relevant for sanctions screening, customer/vessel onboarding, payments and asset freezes.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: Treasury TIGTA is updating several Privacy Act systems of records notices, including personnel, payroll, medical, correspondence, training and investigative files. The changes are effective on publication, with new routine uses applicable 30 days after publication, and comments are due by 2026-03-19. This is a federal privacy notice affecting Treasury records, not a bank rule.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for the White Family Control Group to retain voting shares in Peoples Bancorp, Inc. and indirectly Peoples State Bank. Comments on the application are due by 2026-03-05. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on Burden Related to Capitalization of Interest
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an information collection tied to the capitalization of interest rules under Internal Revenue Code section 263A(f). It does not change the rules or impose new requirements; comments are due by 2026-04-20.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on TD 9035, Constructive Transfers and Transfers of Property to a Third Party on Behalf of a Spouse
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments by 2026-04-21 on an existing information collection under Treasury Regulation section 1.1041-2. It does not change the underlying tax rule and says there is no change to the previously approved collection.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Distributions From Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc.
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on a revised information collection for Form 1099-R, used to report distributions from pensions, annuities, retirement plans, IRAs and insurance contracts. The form is being updated to capture distributions from a Trump account. Comments are due by 2026-04-21.

title: Corporation To Do Business Under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act
summary: The FRB published a notice of an application under Section 25A of the Federal Reserve Act for GreatAmerica Holdings, Inc. to establish an Edge Corporation. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-10. This is a notice of a pending authorisation/perimeter matter, not a rule change.

title: Privacy Act of 1974
summary: The IRS issued a Privacy Act notice for a new computer matching program to detect and deter insecure electronic communications by IRS employees, contractors and others with access to IRS information. Public comments are due within 30 days of publication; if no comments are received, the re-established agreement becomes effective on 2026-03-24 and is expected to run until 2027-09-23.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on proposed change-in-bank-control applications for shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-12. It affects entities involved in bank ownership/control transactions, rather than setting new rules.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Employer-Designed Tip Reporting Program (EmTRAC) for the Food and Beverage Industry
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for the Employer-Designed Tip Reporting Program (EmTRAC) used by food and beverage businesses. It does not change the underlying tax requirement and has a comment deadline of 2026-04-27.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of Change in Bank Control Act applications for proposed acquisitions of shares in two bank holding company/bank groups. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-13. This is a notice of pending ownership-change filings, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Information Collection Renewal; Submission for OMB Review; Appraisals for Higher-Priced Mortgage Loans
summary: The OCC published a notice seeking comment on renewal of an existing OMB information collection for higher-priced mortgage loan appraisals. It does not itself change the underlying appraisal rules, but notes the collection supports mandatory disclosure and appraisal requirements for covered creditors. Comments are due by 2026-03-30.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 14059 and E.O. 13224, with property and interests in property blocked under U.S. jurisdiction and U.S. persons generally prohibited from dealing with them. Firms must screen and freeze any affected assets immediately upon designation.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comment on a bank holding company merger application by Olmsted Holding Corporation to acquire Riverland Bancorporation and indirectly acquire Riverland Bank. Comments are due by 2026-04-01.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of a bank control application under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for persons seeking to retain voting shares of Dawson Bancshares Inc. and indirectly Bank of Dawson. Interested persons may comment by 2026-03-19.

title: Notice of Rescission of Guidance to Federal Financial Assistance Recipients Regarding Title VI Prohibition Against National Origin Discrimination Affecting Limited English Proficient Persons
summary: The Treasury Department announced it has rescinded its 2005 guidance on language access for recipients of federal financial assistance under Title VI, effective March 4, 2026. The notice does not itself impose new requirements, but reminds recipients they still must comply with Title VI, implementing regulations, civil rights laws and the Rehabilitation Act, and says updated guidance may be issued later.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Comment Request on Notice 99-43, Nonrecognition Exchanges Under Section 897.
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act for Notice 99-43, covering nonrecognition exchanges under Section 897. Comments are due by 2026-05-04. This is a paperwork/burden notice only and does not change substantive tax rules.

title: Reestablishment of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel
summary: The IRS announced the reestablishment of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel for another two years once its charter is filed, at least 7 days after publication. The notice explains the panel’s purpose and membership, but it does not create obligations for firms or taxpayers.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Notice of Intent To Renew Collection 3038-0119: Qualification Information for Candidates to Advisory Committees and Subcommittees
summary: The CFTC issued a notice seeking 60 days of public comment on renewing an existing information collection for qualification information for advisory committee and subcommittee candidates. Comments are due by 2026-05-04. The notice concerns PRA/O​MB clearance only and does not itself change market or firm obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve has published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company application by CMG Bancorp to acquire Farmers Savings Bank. Interested persons may submit views by 2026-04-08. This is a notice of a pending authorisation application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Reestablishment of the Federal Advisory Committee on Insurance
summary: Treasury is reestablishing the Federal Advisory Committee on Insurance to advise the Federal Insurance Office on insurance-market issues. The committee’s charter will be filed with Congress at least seven days after publication, and future membership nominations will be sought in a later notice. This is informational and does not itself impose obligations on firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Social Impact Partnerships To Pay for Results Act (SIPPRA) Program Review
summary: Treasury is seeking public comments on a proposed revision to the SIPPRA program information collection and FY26 NOFO materials, including application, reporting and records-retention requirements. Comments are due by 2026-05-11. This is a notice about paperwork burden and grant-process administration, not a binding rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on IRS Taxpayer Burden Surveys
summary: The IRS is requesting public comment on a revised information collection for IRS Taxpayer Burden Surveys under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-05-11. The notice concerns survey burden estimates and OMB approval, not a new substantive rule.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting To Be Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC issued notice of an open Board meeting to be held on March 19, 2026, with public webcast access. The agenda includes proposed capital rulemakings, a final rule on deposit insurance coverage for certain Pacific island branches, and rescission of a policy statement, but this notice itself creates no obligations.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing a bank holding company merger application and inviting public comments by 2026-04-16. It does not itself approve the transaction or impose new requirements; it simply announces the filing and comment process for interested persons.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The Federal Reserve Board proposes to modify a Privacy Act system of records for Reserve Bank and Branch directors and candidates. It expands the system’s purpose, covered individuals and records, source categories, and routine use, and updates system manager and storage details. Comments are due by 2026-04-16, and the revised system becomes effective on that date unless comments change the proposal.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC updated the SDN List by designating additional persons and updating one existing entry. U.S. persons generally must not deal with the listed parties, and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. This is effective from the March 12, 2026 action date and is immediately relevant to sanctions screening and transaction controls.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of Change in Bank Control Act applications for specific trusts and individuals seeking to retain or join control positions in named bank holding companies and banks. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-02. This is a notice of pending control-change applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published new sanctions designations to the SDN List. The named persons’ U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them. Effective from the action date stated in the notice; no filing deadline is given.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a correction to a prior notice on agency information collection activities under OMB review, changing the date in the DATES section from June 24, 2026 to March 27, 2026. This is a notice correction only and does not create new substantive requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company application: Bank of Nova Scotia seeks approval to acquire up to 19.99% of KeyCorp and indirectly KeyBank National Association. Comments must be submitted by 2026-04-20.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings; Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a Board meeting held on March 19, 2026. The notice records that the Board discussed proposed capital rulemaking and approved a final rule on deposit insurance coverage for certain U.S. bank branches, plus a rescission of a policy statement, but the notice itself imposes no requirements.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve is inviting public comments on an application by Rhinebeck Bancorp MHC to convert from mutual to stock form and merge with its subsidiary as part of a bank holding company transaction. Comments are due by 2026-04-22. This is a notice of application and comment period, not a rule or approval.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: FDIC announced a closed Sunshine Act Board meeting held on March 19, 2026 to discuss resolution, supervision, and corporate activities. This is informational only and does not create new requirements or deadlines for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Electronic Payee Statements
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an extension of its Paperwork Reduction Act approval for electronic payee statements under existing final regulations. It covers voluntary electronic furnishing of Forms W-2, 1098-T and 1098-E for businesses and educational institutions. Comments are due by 2026-05-26. No regulatory requirements are changed.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a bank holding company application under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. It concerns North Salem State Bancorporation’s proposed acquisition of voting shares in Tri-County Bancorp. Comments must be submitted by 2026-04-29.

title: Notification of Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee Public Meeting-April 21, 2026
summary: The U.S. Mint announced a public Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee meeting for April 21, 2026 to review candidate designs for 2027 American Innovation $1 coins. It is an informational meeting notice only, with public attendance instructions and an April 14, 2026 contact deadline for in-person access/accommodation requests.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y for two control-group/ownership retention transactions involving bank holding companies and banks in Pennsylvania and Oklahoma. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-04-20. This is a notice of pending approvals, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications for formations, acquisitions and mergers under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-06. This is a public notice of pending approvals, not a final decision or new rule.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company; Correction
summary: The Federal Reserve issued a correction to a previously published change-in-bank-control notice, updating the entry for James N. Carson’s retention of voting shares in Carson Financial Holding Company and indirectly Carson Community Bank. This is an informational correction only and does not itself create new requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Treatment of Distributions to Foreign Persons
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-06-08 on an existing information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act relating to treatment of distributions to foreign persons and related reporting for certain property transfers. No form changes are being made.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Long-Term Care Premiums Paid Statement
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on a new information collection for Form 1099-LPS, the Long-Term Care Premiums Paid Statement. Comments are due by 2026-06-08. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice only and does not itself impose new requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for an open Board meeting held on 7 April 2026 with less than seven days’ notice. The notice lists agenda items including proposed rules on payment stablecoin issuers, AML/CFT programs, and a final rule prohibiting use of reputation risk by regulators, but the notice itself creates no obligations.

title: Debt Management Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a closed meeting of the Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee on May 5, 2026 to discuss the economy, financial markets, Treasury financing and debt management, and to produce recommendations. No new obligations are created for firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a proposed change in bank control application for Nir Zuk to acquire voting shares of DMG Bancshares and indirectly Liberty Bank N.A. Interested persons may comment by 2026-04-30. This is an authorisation/perimeter notice, not a rule change, and it affects banks and bank holding companies.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Application for Extension of Time To Furnish Recipient Statements
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an extension of an existing information collection for Form 15397, used to request more time to furnish recipient statements. Comments are due by 2026-06-16. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice and does not itself change filing obligations.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The U.S. Treasury is establishing a new Privacy Act system of records for the Trump Accounts Program, effective on publication, with comments due by 2026-05-18. The notice describes how Treasury will collect, use and share personal data to administer accounts, verify eligibility, process payments, and support compliance, oversight and fraud detection.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and related bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-05-06. This is a public notice of pending ownership control applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The FDIC is modifying its Privacy Act system of records notice for FDIC-012, Financial Information Management Records, including updated routine uses, record categories, retention, access, and notification procedures. The notice is effective April 23, 2026, with proposed routine uses effective May 26, 2026 unless changed after comments. Comments are due by May 26, 2026. This mainly affects privacy governance and legal review rather than bank obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added several individuals and entities to the SDN List under Executive Order 14098 relating to Sudan. U.S. property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date. Sanctions screening and interdiction controls should be updated immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added multiple persons and aircraft to the SDN List, blocking their U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the April 21, 2026 action date and requires sanctions screening and blocking controls to be updated immediately for any exposed counterparties, assets or transactions.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act application for a group acting in concert to retain voting shares of First Illinois Corporation and indirectly its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may comment by 2026-05-12. This is a notice and comment opportunity, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of pending applications for bank holding company formations, acquisitions and mergers under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. It invites public comments by 2026-05-28 on the listed transactions, including several cross-border structures involving Chilean groups and U.S. bank interests.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Bureau of the Fiscal Service Information Collection Requests
summary: Treasury is seeking OMB approval to extend several existing Fiscal Service information collections, including direct deposit sign-up forms, federal disbursement EFT requirements, EFT market research, and stored value card program forms. This is a comment request under the Paperwork Reduction Act, with comments due by 2026-06-01. It does not itself create new obligations for firms.

title: Review of the Commitments of Traders Reporting Program
summary: The CFTC is seeking public comment on possible changes to the Commitments of Traders reporting program, including the frequency and content of the reports. Comments are due by 2026-06-04. This is an information-gathering request for input only and does not itself change reporting requirements.

title: Low Income Taxpayer Clinic Grant Program; Availability of 2027 Grant Application Package
summary: The IRS announced the 2027 Low Income Taxpayer Clinic grant application package and invited eligible organizations to apply by July 6, 2026. It also set grant parameters, funding limits, eligibility criteria, and webinar dates for applicants. This is an informational solicitation for grant applications, not a rule change for regulated firms.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: The CFTC is creating a new Privacy Act system of records, CFTC-59 Insider Risk Program Records, for information used to run its Insider Risk Program. The system becomes effective on 2026-06-15; public comments are due by 2026-06-05. It mainly affects privacy, cyber/security and operational resilience controls for CFTC handling of personal and workplace-monitoring data.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications and invited public comments by 2026-06-08. It concerns Carpenter Bank Holdings LLC’s proposed acquisition of Security State Bank in Texas. This is informational only and does not itself approve or impose requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under Executive Order 13902, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the issuance date, 2026-05-01.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications for formation, acquisitions and mergers. Interested persons may comment on the applications by 2026-06-11. This is a notice of pending authorisation activity for named US bank holding companies, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Opportunity Zones Nomination Tool
summary: Treasury is seeking public comment on reinstating an information collection tool used by states to nominate census tracts for Qualified Opportunity Zone designation. Comments are due by 2026-06-11. The notice reflects the new statutory nomination timetable under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, but it does not itself impose operating requirements on banks.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-05-07 and is immediately relevant to sanctions screening and transaction controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added or revised one or more persons on the SDN List and blocked their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, so sanctions screening and controls should be updated immediately. The notice reflects actions issued on 2026-05-08 and 2026-05-11.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank control application under the Change in Bank Control Act for an individual to join a control group and retain shares in a bank holding company, indirectly affecting a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-06-02.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
summary: The Treasury published notice of a new Privacy Act computer matching program using the Do Not Pay system to check Treasury benefits-program records for improper payments and eligibility. Comments are due by 2026-06-17, and the program becomes effective 30 days after publication and runs through 2029-09-10. This is a notice, not a rule, and is mainly informational for affected US Treasury benefit programs.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company formation and acquisition applications and invited public comments by 2026-06-22. It lists specific applicants seeking to become bank holding companies or acquire a US bank. This is informational and does not itself approve or change any requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-05-21 and is effective immediately for U.S.-related dealings.

title: Proposed Revisions to the Federal Reserve Policy on Payment System Risk and the Guidelines for Account and Services Requests
summary: The Federal Reserve is consulting on revisions to its payment system risk policy and account access guidelines to support new special-purpose Payment Accounts at Reserve Banks, and to add timing expectations for certain account requests. Comments are due by 2026-07-27. The proposal affects institutions seeking Reserve Bank accounts and services, especially those under the Account Access Guidelines.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application for certain parties to acquire/retain voting shares in Reeves Bancshares and indirectly Cattlemens Bank. Comments are due by 2026-06-12. This is an application notice, not a rule or decision.

title: Credit for Renewable Electricity Production and Publication of Inflation Adjustment Factor and Reference Price for Calendar Year 2026
summary: The IRS published the 2026 inflation adjustment factor and reference price used to determine the section 45 renewable electricity production tax credit for 2026 sales. It confirms the wind and other listed resource phaseout does not apply for calendar year 2026 and explains related Inflation Reduction Act changes. No new compliance action or deadline is created by the notice itself.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on Information Regarding Request for Refund of Social Security Tax Erroneously Withheld on Wages Recovered by a Nonresident Alien on an F, J, or M Type Visa
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for Form 8316, used by nonresident aliens on F, J or M visas to request refunds of Social Security tax withheld in error. There is no change to the approved collection. Comments are due by 2026-08-03.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of applications for bank holding company formation and acquisition approval under the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-02. This affects proposed bank holding company transactions, not existing obligations.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a sanctions notice removing one or more persons from the SDN List and unblocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction. Firms should check sanctions screening and customer/transaction monitoring against the updated list immediately.

title: Policy Statement Concerning the Listing of Perpetual Contracts
summary: The CFTC issued a policy statement expressing its views on listing perpetual contracts, and says non-bitcoin perpetual contracts should be submitted for case-by-case review under CFTC Regulation 40.3. It does not itself create new obligations or change the rulebook. The statement was adopted on 2026-05-29 and published on 2026-06-03.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on TD 9981, Requirements for Type I and Type III Supporting Organizations
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act for TD 9981 on Type I and Type III supporting organizations. There is no change to the approved collection and no new compliance deadline beyond comments due by 2026-08-03. The notice applies to not-for-profit institutions.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on IRS E-File Provider Participation and Compliance Collections
summary: The IRS published a notice seeking public comments on its Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for IRS e-file provider participation and compliance requirements. It does not change the underlying requirements; it only renews OMB approval and makes an administrative clarification. Comments are due by 2026-08-07.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Methyl Methacrylate-ethyl Methacrylate-methacrylic Acid Copolymer in a Styrene Solution (x=75.76, y=8.46, z=1, s=168.4); Hearing Cancellation
summary: The IRS announces it is cancelling a public hearing on a notice of filing about adding a chemical substance to the Superfund taxable substances list. The hearing scheduled for 2026-06-18 is cancelled because no one requested to testify. No new obligations are created by this notice.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection for registration under the Commodity Exchange Act has been sent to OMB for 30-day review and public comment. It concerns registration forms for swap dealers and major swap participants and related cross-border comparability and fingerprint-card processes. Comments are due by 2026-07-13.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities Under OMB Review
summary: The CFTC published a notice that an existing information collection under Part 162 (consumer information protections under the FCRA) has been sent to OMB for review under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-07-17. This is a request for comments on a reinstatement without change, not a new rule or obligation.

title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
summary: Treasury announces a new Privacy Act system of records for intake and referral of public tips about suspected waste, fraud, abuse, improper payments and other misconduct affecting federal programs. The system is effective on publication, with comments due by 2026-07-17; routine uses become effective the same day unless changed after comments.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve is publishing notices of Change in Bank Control Act applications for acquisitions of shares of a bank or bank holding company. Interested persons may submit written comments by 2026-07-03. This affects parties seeking control of US banks or bank holding companies and the firms reviewing ownership/control changes.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage In or To Acquire Companies Engaged In Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of proposals from bank holding companies to engage in, or acquire companies engaged in, permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-03. The notice covers proposed bullion buying and selling activity for Frontier Community Bancshares, Inc. and other listed proposals.

title: OCC Policy Statement on Minority Depository Institutions
summary: The OCC revised its policy statement on Minority Depository Institutions to align more closely with FIRREA and remove obsolete material. The update keeps current MDI designations in place and describes how the OCC will maintain those designations going forward. It applies to national banks and federal savings associations. No separate compliance deadline is stated; the statement is effective as issued on 2026-06-16.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve has published notices of proposed changes in bank control for two US bank-related groups, inviting public comments by 2026-07-09. The notices describe applications to acquire voting shares of specified bank holding companies and indirectly their banks.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comments on renewal of two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act: bank services notifications for insured state nonmember banks and state savings associations, and disclosure/recordkeeping requirements for certain securitization and participation transactions by insured depository institutions. Comments are due by 2026-07-24. No substantive rule change is announced.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them, effective from the action date of 2026-06-18.

title: Debt Management Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a closed meeting of the Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee on August 4, 2026 to discuss the economy, financial markets, Treasury financing and debt management. It is an advisory notice only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Certifications for Exceptions to the 10% Additional Tax
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for certifications supporting exceptions to the 10% additional tax on certain retirement plan distributions. The notice adds collection requirements from IRS Notice 2026-33 and asks for comments by 2026-08-24. It does not itself change substantive tax rules.

title: Designation of OpenCorporates Dataset Into DNP Working System
summary: Treasury is proposing to add OpenCorporates’ U.S. legal entity dataset to the Do Not Pay Working System. Comments are due by 2026-07-10. If finalized, federal agencies and federally funded state programs could use the dataset to verify entity status and help prevent improper payments and fraud.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices for proposed acquisitions of shares in a bank holding company and its subsidiary bank under the Change in Bank Control Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-13. This is a notice of filings and comment opportunity, not a rule change or enforcement action.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a bank holding company application: BancFirst Corporation seeks approval to acquire Spirit Bankcorp, Inc. and indirectly SpiritBank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of an application, not an approval or rule change.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting To Be Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice announcing a Board meeting and listing proposed rulemakings to be considered, including resolution submissions for covered insured depository institutions, assessment thresholds and rate schedules, and disclosure of information. This is a notice of meeting only; it does not itself change requirements.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List and updating the identifying details of one listed person. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked. Effective date of the action was June 23, 2026.

title: Open Meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee
summary: The IRS is holding a public virtual meeting of the Taxpayer Advocacy Panel Joint Committee on July 15, 2026, and inviting comments and suggestions on improving IRS customer service. Registration is required by July 10, 2026. This is an informational notice only and does not impose obligations on firms.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notice of Change in Bank Control Act applications to acquire shares of specific banks and bank holding companies, and invited public comments by 2026-07-14. This is a notice about pending ownership-control filings, not a rule change. It is relevant to acquisition/control due diligence for affected banking groups.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting Held With Less Than Seven Days' Advance Notice
summary: The FDIC published a Sunshine Act meeting notice for a Board meeting held on June 25, 2026, open to public observation via webcast. The notice lists proposed rulemakings discussed, including resolution submissions for covered insured depository institutions, assessment thresholds and rate schedules, and disclosure of information. It is informational only and creates no direct obligations.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The FDIC announced a closed Board meeting under the Government in the Sunshine Act to consider resolution, supervision and corporate matters. It is an informational notice only and does not create requirements for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property under U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms with U.S. nexus must screen and update sanctions controls immediately. The action was issued on 2026-05-19 and published on 2026-06-29.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-06-22 and is immediately relevant for sanctions screening and blocking controls.

title: Funding Opportunities: Small Dollar Loan Program: FY 2026 Funding Round
summary: Treasury’s CDFI Fund issued a notice inviting applications for FY 2026 Small Dollar Loan Program grants. Eligible certified CDFIs may apply for loan loss reserve and technical assistance awards by 2026-07-30, with several earlier system and registration deadlines in late July 2026. This is a funding opportunity notice, not a rulemaking.

title: Funding Opportunities: Bank Enterprise Award Program (BEA) Program: FY 2026 Funding Round
summary: The U.S. Treasury CDFI Fund issued a FY 2026 Notice of Funds Availability for the Bank Enterprise Award Program, inviting applications from FDIC-insured banks and thrifts. It sets application steps and deadlines in July 2026, and describes award ranges and eligibility conditions for the grant program.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Multiple Internal Revenue Service Information Collection Requests
summary: The Treasury Department is requesting public comments and OMB review for several IRS information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act, including forms and recordkeeping relating to tax reporting, electronic records, housing credits, REMICs, and tip reporting. Comments are due by 2026-07-30. This is a notice of proposed information collection, not a rule change.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Offering of U.S. Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Company Tax and Loss Bonds
summary: Treasury is seeking public comments on extending an existing information collection for U.S. Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Company Tax and Loss Bonds before OMB review. Comments are due by 2026-07-30. The notice does not itself change any requirements; it only solicits input on an existing collection.

title: Funding Opportunities: Bond Guarantee Program, FY 2026; Notice of Guarantee Availability
summary: The U.S. Treasury CDFI Fund announced FY 2026 availability of up to $500 million of Bond Guarantee authority and invited Qualified Issuer and Guarantee Applications. Applications open on publication, with deadlines of 2026-07-07 for Qualified Issuer Applications, 2026-07-08 for Guarantee Applications, and 2026-07-02 for any CDFI Certification Application. It is an application notice, not a rule change.

title: Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council; Public Meeting
summary: The IRS announced a public meeting of the Internal Revenue Service Advisory Council on July 15, 2026. The meeting will discuss potential future recommendations on IRS operations, taxpayer service, compliance, tax administration, information reporting, and tax-exempt/government entities. Public attendees should register by July 13, 2026, and written statements for the Council are due by July 13, 2026.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Tax-Exempt Organization Complaint (Referral)
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection for Form 13909, Tax-Exempt Organization Complaint (Referral). There are no form changes affecting burden; comments are due by 2026-08-28. This is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published notices of proposed change-in-bank-control filings for several Texas bank and bank holding company acquisitions. Interested persons may comment by 2026-07-16. This is an informational notice of applications, not a new rule or approval.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC updated and removed certain names and property entries on the SDN List, including a vessel removal and changes to identifying information for listed persons. U.S. persons and firms dealing with blocked property or screening/ sanctions controls should reflect the changes immediately. No separate filing deadline is given.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added named individuals to the SDN List under Executive Order 14098 for Sudan-related sanctions. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with them and any U.S.-jurisdiction property is blocked, effective from the action date of 2026-06-26.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen against the updated sanctions targets immediately and ensure any existing exposure is identified and blocked.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Statement of Payments Received
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-08-31 on an unchanged extension of the Form 4669 information collection used to request relief from certain withholding taxes. It is a Paperwork Reduction Act notice, not a new rule, and applies to payors who use the form.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Relief for Certain Spouses of Military Personnel
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an extension of an existing information collection for relief claims by certain spouses of military personnel under MSRRA. There is no change to the approved collection, and comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: The FDIC is seeking comment on renewal of two existing information collections under the Paperwork Reduction Act: reverse mortgage products and insurance sales consumer protections. The notice does not change the underlying substantive requirements; comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a sanctions action adding one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 13224. U.S.-jurisdiction property and interests in property of the listed persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. Firms should screen immediately against the updated list and apply any required blocking or escalation procedures.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons and vessels to the SDN List under E.O. 13902, blocking U.S.-jurisdiction property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This is effective from the June 5, 2026 action date and is relevant immediately for sanctions screening, payments, onboarding and exposure controls.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one person to the SDN List, blocking any property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. This takes effect from the action date of 2026-05-27, with publication on 2026-07-02. Sanctions screening and payment controls should be updated immediately.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC published a notice updating identifying information for one or more entries on its sanctions lists to correct or standardize records. The change affects parties subject to OFAC sanctions screening and watchlist maintenance, effective from the underlying update date of 2026-06-25.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment Tax Information Security Guidelines for Federal, State, and Local Agencies
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection under Paperwork Reduction Act procedures for Publication 1075, which concerns safeguards for federal tax information held by government agencies and their contractors. No substantive rule change is proposed; comments are due by 2026-08-31.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 147A(f)(1)(iii) Written Representation as to Purchaser Residency
summary: The SEC published a Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking OMB review and public comments on extending the existing information collection under Rule 147A(f)(1)(iii), which requires issuers relying on the intrastate offering exemption to obtain written purchaser residency representations. Comments are due by 2026-08-03. This is an administrative notice, not a rule change.

title: Request for Comment on Novel ETFs
summary: The SEC is seeking public comment on ETFs that invest in innovative asset classes or use novel strategies. It asks funds, advisers, investors and other market participants whether further action is needed to protect investors and support orderly markets. Comments are due within 60 days after Federal Register publication on 2026-07-02.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Amend the Redemptions Service Guide and the Operational Arrangements (Necessary for Securities To Become and Remain Eligible for DTC Services)
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a DTC proposed rule change that would update the Redemptions Service Guide and Operational Arrangements for payment without presentation. It would remove certain physical document requirements, make automated notifications part of the process, and impose retention/destruction protocols for eligible redemption and maturity events affecting DTC participants and agents.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Short Term Option Series Program Related to Qualifying Securities
summary: Nasdaq ISE has filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to expand and rename categories of short-term option series for certain exchange-traded funds, including new Tuesday/Thursday expirations for some products and new Monday/Wednesday expirations for others. The SEC is seeking public comments; no compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.31. Orders and Modifiers
summary: The NYSE proposes changes to Rule 7.31 so routable Limit Orders would operate as Inside Limit Orders, and all Discretionary Orders would be non-routable. The SEC is publishing the notice and seeking comments; this is relevant to trading and market-structure teams, with no immediate binding change unless the proposal is later approved.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend Rule 7.31E, Orders and Modifiers
summary: NYSE American proposed amending Rule 7.31E so routable Limit Orders would function as Inside Limit Orders by default, routing price by price to away markets unless otherwise specified. The SEC notice solicits comments on the proposal; no binding change is yet in effect. Market participants using NYSE American order types should assess the operational and trading impact.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice on bank control applications under the Change in Bank Control Act. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-21 on a proposed acquisition/retention of voting shares involving Sterling City Bancshares and The First National Bank of Sterling City.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Actions
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List under E.O. 14059 and E.O. 13224, blocking their property and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. Firms must screen for these names and stop any prohibited activity immediately. The notice was issued on 2026-06-30 and published on 2026-07-06.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Certificate of Identity
summary: The Treasury’s Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on an extension of the approved Certificate of Identity information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. The notice concerns a form used by individuals claiming U.S. savings and retirement securities.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: TreasuryDirect System
summary: Treasury published a notice seeking comments on extending the approved TreasuryDirect System information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. The notice concerns account-opening and transaction-processing data collection for individuals and households, not a new substantive rule.

title: Extension of a Currently Approved Information Collection: Special Form of Request for Payment of US Savings and Retirement Securities Where Use of a Detached Request Is Authorized
summary: The Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service is seeking public comments on extending an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form FS 1522, used to request payment of U.S. savings and retirement securities. Comments are due by 2026-09-04. This is a notice only and does not itself change any filing or payment requirements.

title: Manulife Investment Management Private Markets (US) LLC; Manulife Employee Securities Company 2025, L.P.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief for Manulife Investment Management Private Markets (US) LLC and Manulife Employee Securities Company 2025, L.P. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice only and does not itself change requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: NYSE Arca filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to increase certain manual options fees for market makers in non-Penny issues and add a $0.20 rebate for floor broker orders trading with market maker orders. It is open for SEC comment, and the fee schedule change applies to NYSE Arca options market participants from June 22, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the NYSE American Options Fee Schedule Regarding Fees and Rebates Applicable to Manual Transactions
summary: NYSE American filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to raise certain manual options transaction fees for market makers from $0.50 to $1.00 per contract and add a $0.20 per contract rebate for floor broker orders trading with market maker orders on the trading floor. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing; market participants should review the fee schedule change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE Texas filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to update its connectivity fee schedule for third-party data feeds. The change renames and reorganizes certain Cboe feeds, adds an IEX feed, and is expected to be operative by 2026-08-31. The SEC published the notice to solicit comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt FINRA Rule 4321 (Allocations of Fail To Deliver Positions) and Amend FINRA Rule 4560 (Short-Interest Reporting)
summary: The SEC extended its review period for FINRA’s proposed rule change to create FINRA Rule 4321 on allocations of fail-to-deliver positions and to amend FINRA Rule 4560 on short-interest reporting. This is not yet a final rule. The Commission must act by 2026-08-14 on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend a Continued Listing Standard Relating to Beneficial Holders Applicable to ETF Shares Listed on the Exchange Under Rule 17.104(b)(2)(B)
summary: The SEC is inviting comments on a Texas Stock Exchange proposal to amend its ETF continued-listing standard by eliminating the beneficial-holders test and renumbering the rule. This affects ETF Shares listed on TXSE, but it is not yet binding. No closing date is stated in the excerpt provided.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain Initial and Continued Listing Standards
summary: NYSE Texas filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its initial and continued listing standards, including definitions and quantitative thresholds for listed securities. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing. This affects issuers seeking or maintaining a listing on NYSE Texas; no direct obligation applies yet beyond the filing and comment process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; BOX Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Review of Professional Orders
summary: BOX Exchange filed a proposed rule change that would shorten the review and reclassification of “Professional” options orders from quarterly to monthly. Participants would need to represent eligible customers as Professional orders for the next calendar month, with related review and designation timing codified in the exchange rulebook. No specific compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; National Securities Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Enhance the Supplemental Liquidity Deposit Rules, Methodology and Processes
