summary: The SEC is seeking comment on an NSCC proposed rule change to enhance supplemental liquidity deposit rules, methodology and processes. The proposal would standardize intraday liquidity calculations, add more detail on factors used to set obligations, and codify member reporting/information duties. It is not yet binding; comments are invited on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the By-Laws To Establish the Role of Observers
summary: MIAX filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to amend its by-laws to create a new Observer role on the board, including Observer rights and nomination process, and to remove outdated ERP and initial committee text. It is a notice and proposal, not a final rule. Comments are being solicited; no in-force date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt a Policy Relating to the Exchange's Treatment of Trade Reports
summary: NYSE Texas filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to adopt a policy for marking trade reports that it deems inconsistent with the prevailing market, using an Aberrant Report Indicator. The SEC is soliciting comments, but the filing is already effective under exchange rule procedures. The change affects market participants and data recipients for trade reporting and price metrics.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change by To Amend the By-Laws To Establish the Role of Observers
summary: MIAX PEARL filed an immediately effective proposed rule change with the SEC to amend its By-Laws, creating a new Observer role for the Board and removing obsolete ERP-related text. The notice solicits public comments on the filing. No firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on extending the information collection for Rule 6e-2 and Form N-6EI-1. It asks for comments by 2026-09-04 but does not change substantive obligations or filing requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 0-1 Under the Investment Company Act of 1940, Definition of Terms Used in This Part
summary: The SEC is requesting comments on the Paperwork Reduction Act extension for Rule 0-1 under the Investment Company Act. The notice concerns existing recordkeeping and board-minute requirements tied to independent legal counsel determinations for funds; it does not itself change the rule. No compliance date is set, but funds and their boards may wish to comment.

title: Blue Tractor ETF Trust, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Blue Tractor ETF Trust and Blue Tractor Group, LLC to amend a prior exemptive order so the funds can invest in a broader range of instruments. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final rule or binding requirement.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of proposed nonbanking activities for a bank holding company under section 4 of the BHC Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on Brookfield Bancshares’ proposal to continue extending credit and servicing loans by 2026-07-22. This is a public notice and comment item, not a rule.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company formation/acquisition applications under the Bank Holding Company Act and Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the applications by 2026-08-06. The notice concerns proposed acquisitions in Oklahoma and Texas and does not itself approve any transaction.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of a Change in Bank Control Act filing for proposed acquisitions/retention of voting shares in a bank holding company and indirectly a bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-22. This is a notice, not a rule or decision.

title: Interest Rate Paid on Cash Deposited To Secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Immigration Bonds
summary: Treasury set the quarterly interest rate on cash deposited to secure U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement immigration bonds at 3% per annum for the period July 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026. This is a published rate notice for the stated period and does not impose a broader new rule for banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Partial Amendment No. 1 to Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 2210 (Communications With the Public)
summary: SEC notice seeking comment on FINRA’s Partial Amendment No. 1 to a proposed rule change for FINRA Rule 2210. The amendment would allow members, subject to conditions, to project performance or provide targeted returns in public communications. This is a consultation only; no immediate rule change or compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Relating To Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange's Rules Governing Security Futures Product Listing Standards, Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.'s Rules Governing Security Futures Adjustments, and Adoption of Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.'s Rules Governing Cash-Settled Single Stock Security Futures
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on CME’s proposed rule change to add listing standards and adjustments for cash-settled single-stock security futures, including a new Chapter 711 and revised Chapter 700/701 rules. It affects CME and market participants trading these products. No compliance date is stated; the notice is for immediate effectiveness and consultation.

title: Muzinich Aviation Income Fund (mAIR) and Muzinich & Co., Inc.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Muzinich Aviation Income Fund and Muzinich & Co. seeking exemptive relief under the Investment Company Act to allow multiple share classes, distribution/service fees, early withdrawal charges, and related relief. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. No obligations are created by the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC and NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Changes Concerning the Single Component Concentration Limit of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to NYSE American and NYSE Arca rule changes that raise the MSCI Emerging Markets Index single-component concentration limit for EM Options from 15% to 20%. This allows continued listing and trading of those options and avoids a potential delisting issue. The change applies immediately upon approval; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 to a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain Parts of Its Opening and Closing Auctions
summary: The SEC is publishing a notice of a revised proposed rule change by Texas Stock Exchange LLC for comments. The filing would amend TXSE opening and closing auction rules, including late order handling, order modification cutoffs, auction information dissemination, and tie-break procedures. No compliance date is set yet; the comment/approval process remains open until the SEC acts by July 28, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 2900 Regarding Information Circular Requirements
summary: MIAX PEARL filed a proposed rule change to amend Rule 2900 on information circular requirements for UTP exchange-traded products. It would remove a duplicate pre-trading circular requirement, add cross-references, and change timing/form requirements for written descriptions. The SEC is seeking comments; no compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rules 5.32-O and 5.35-O
summary: The SEC is publishing a comment request on NYSE Arca’s proposed rule change to amend FLEX Options rules, including expanding cash settlement eligibility to up to 50 non-ETF FLEX Equity Options and changing the selection metric from average daily volume to average daily notional value. This is a proposal only; comments are being solicited and no immediate compliance date is set.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 903G and 906G
summary: The SEC has published a notice of NYSE American’s proposed rule change to amend FLEX Options Rules 903G and 906G. The proposal would expand cash settlement eligibility to certain non-ETF FLEX equity options and change the selection metric from highest average daily volume to highest average daily notional value. Comments are being solicited; no compliance date is set in the text.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change to Except Accounts Pursuant to Section 530A of the Internal Revenue Code From the Requirements of FINRA Rule 3210 (Accounts At Other Broker-Dealers and Financial Institutions)
summary: The SEC published notice that FINRA has filed a non-controversial proposed rule change to exempt accounts under new Internal Revenue Code Section 530A from FINRA Rule 3210. It invites comments but does not itself change requirements. The filing relates to broker-dealers and their associated persons.

title: Goehring & Rozencwajg Investment Funds and Goehring & Rozencwajg Associates, LLC
summary: SEC notice announcing an application for exemptive relief for Goehring & Rozencwajg Investment Funds to operate a multi-class ETF structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-27. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final rule or order.

title: No Adjustment to Civil Monetary Penalty Amounts
summary: The SEC published a notice saying there will be no 2026 inflation increase to its civil monetary penalty amounts. The January 2025 penalty levels will continue to apply to penalties under the Securities Act, Exchange Act, Investment Company Act, Investment Advisers Act, and certain Sarbanes-Oxley penalties.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice inviting comments on a proposed change in bank control involving the Regan Family Control Group’s planned acquisition of shares in PB Bancshares, Inc. and Premier Bank in Minnesota. Comments are due by 2026-07-23. This is a notice about an ownership-control application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is requesting comments on a proposed three-year extension, without revision, of the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (FR 3077). Comments are due by 2026-09-08. This is an information collection notice, not a new rule or obligation for firms.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend, with revision, the FR 3016 Ongoing Intermittent Survey of Households for three years. The changes are effective immediately if approved and include moving from phone interviews to a web questionnaire and increasing the sample size to 1,150 households. Comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting comments on a bank holding company application by Nebraska Bankshares and its subsidiary to acquire Foundations First Corporation and indirectly acquire Foundation One Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-10. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend, for three years without revision, the information collection tied to CFPB Regulation DD disclosures. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. The notice affects state member banks, certain branches of foreign banks, commercial lending companies owned or controlled by foreign banks, and section 25 organizations.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is seeking comment on a proposal to extend for three years, with revision, its Ad Hoc Clearance for Board-Wide Use (FR 3100). The proposal would reduce anticipated surveys from 20 to 10, and comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Proposed Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request
summary: The Federal Reserve Board is requesting comment on a proposal to extend, with revision, its employment application information collection (FR 28) for three years under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. The notice covers Board job applicant forms, including optional self-identification and conflict-of-interest screening materials.

title: Community Development Revolving Loan Fund
summary: NCUA issued a notice of funding opportunity for the Community Development Revolving Loan Fund, offering revolving loan awards to eligible low-income-designated credit unions. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, the notice is effective on publication, and NCUA expects to notify applicants after about 180 calendar days. Credit unions must meet NCUA eligibility and application requirements, including SAM registration and an EIN.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Notice of Qualified Equity Investment for New Markets Credit
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form 8874-A, used by community development entities to notify taxpayers of a qualified equity investment for the New Markets Credit. There is no change to the underlying requirement; the comment deadline is 2026-09-08.

title: Prompt Payment Interest Rate; Contract Disputes Act
summary: The U.S. Treasury’s Fiscal Service set the prompt payment interest rate at 4.75% per annum for July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026. Federal agencies must use this rate when calculating late-payment interest penalties under the Prompt Payment Act and Contract Disputes Act for obligations accruing during that period.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the BondBloxx Private Credit Trust Under BZX Rule 14.11(f), Trust Issued Receipts
summary: The SEC has started proceedings on Cboe BZX’s proposal to list and trade shares of the BondBloxx Private Credit Trust under BZX’s Trust Issued Receipts rule. This does not itself approve or reject the product, but it moves the exchange filing into an opposition/decision phase. No firm deadline for firms is created in this notice, but the exchange must still await SEC action.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the LCH SA Liquidity Plan
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on LCH SA’s proposed change to its liquidity plan, which sets governance, procedures, and responsibilities for liquidity management at the clearing agency. The filing says implementation depends on SEC approval. It affects LCH SA and is subject to comment through the SEC notice process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Fixed Income Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Modify the GSD Rules To Adopt a U.S. Treasury Clearing Trade Submission Requirement
summary: The SEC has published FICC’s proposed rule change to require Netting Members to submit eligible U.S. Treasury secondary market transactions for clearing and settlement, and to add monitoring, self-reporting and disciplinary provisions. It is a proposal open for comment, not a final requirement. It affects FICC Netting Members and aligns the GSD rules with the SEC’s Treasury clearing standards.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MX2 LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 2.13, Application Process and Waive-In
summary: The SEC published a notice of MX2 LLC’s proposed rule change to make its waive-in membership application process available on an ongoing basis, rather than only for the now-expired post-approval window. Eligible applicants would still need to meet existing membership standards and file the prescribed application. Comments are being solicited; the proposal is not yet final.

title: Datum One Series Trust and Polar Capital LLP
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and Polar Capital LLP seeking exemptive relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure combining exchange-traded and mutual fund share classes. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of a request, not a rule or order.

title: Datum One Series Trust and First Sentier Investors (US) LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and First Sentier Investors (US) LLC seeking exemptive relief to operate a multi-class ETF structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or order, so it creates no immediate obligations.

title: Datum One Series Trust and Brandes Investment Partners, L.P.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Datum One Series Trust and Brandes Investment Partners seeking exemptive relief to operate a multi-class ETF structure combining an ETF class with mutual fund classes. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of a pending application, not a final order or rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Form 20-F
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a proposed extension of the existing Form 20-F information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Foreign private issuers using Form 20-F would continue to file annual or transition reports, and comments are due by 2026-09-08.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Revenue Procedure 2014-49
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection tied to Revenue Procedure 2014-49, which concerns low-income housing tax credit guidance for state housing credit agencies and owners after presidentially declared disasters. Comments are due by 2026-09-08. No substantive rule change is made.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend PIXL
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its PIXL options auction rules, removing price from the PIXL Auction Notification so only side, size and options series are disseminated. The exchange plans to implement the change on or before 2026-07-15 and says the SEC is soliciting comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Long-Term Stock Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend LTSE Rule 11.410(a) by Adding the Texas Stock Exchange LLC and Changing Nasdaq BX, LLC to Nasdaq Texas, LLC
summary: LTSE filed an immediately effective rule change to update Rule 11.410(a) so its data-feed list adds Texas Stock Exchange LLC and renames Nasdaq BX, LLC to Nasdaq Texas, LLC. The filing is effective under SEC Rule 19b-4(f)(6) and is open for Commission/public comment. It affects LTSE and other market participants using its order handling and surveillance rules.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change by Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC Amend Rule 612, Aggregate Risk Manager (ARM), To Adopt a New Origin Multiplier To Be Used When Calculating a Market Maker's Option Percentage
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on MIAX’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 612 (Aggregate Risk Manager) by adding a new Origin Multiplier used to calculate a market maker’s option percentage. The change affects MIAX market makers and their risk controls; no firm deadline is stated in the notice, but the proposal is open for comment.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company proposals to engage in or acquire companies involved in permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the listed proposal by 2026-08-12. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change, and applies to the named bank holding company activity in the United States.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice of bank holding company applications, including OppFi, Inc.’s proposed acquisition of BNCCORP and indirect acquisition of BNC National Bank. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-12. This is a notice of an application, not a rule or decision.

title: Inflation Adjustments for Civil Money Penalties
summary: The Federal Reserve Board says its civil money penalty amounts will not increase for 2026 and that the 2025 penalty levels in 12 CFR 263.65 remain in effect. This is a notice only and does not impose a new filing or compliance deadline.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on U.S. Information Returns and Related Forms, Schedules, Attachments, and Published Guidance
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on its information collection for U.S. information returns and related forms, under the Paperwork Reduction Act. Comments are due by 2026-09-11. The notice discusses burden estimation methodology and OMB control number administration, but does not itself impose new requirements.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Interagency Guidance on Lending to Individuals Not Legally Authorized to Work in the United States
summary: The FDIC, OCC and NCUA issued interagency guidance for supervised financial institutions on lending to individuals not legally authorized to work in the United States. It reminds institutions to apply existing credit risk management obligations. It applies to all FDIC-supervised institutions and was published on 2026-07-13.

title: Dawson Private Markets Evergreen Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC issued a notice of an application for exemptive relief allowing certain BDCs and open- and closed-end funds to co-invest in portfolio companies with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-03. This is a notice only; it does not itself change requirements.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for July 16, 2026. The notice gives the time, place and general subjects to be discussed, including enforcement and litigation matters, but it does not create any new obligations or deadlines for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change Relating to the CDS Instrument On-Boarding Policies and Procedures
primary_functions: Product; Risk; Operational resilience; Compliance; Regulatory change
summary: The SEC is seeking comment on ICE Clear Credit’s proposed rule change to its CDS instrument on-boarding policy. ICC would add a new criterion for considering single-name CDS instruments based on minimum outstanding debt notional, while keeping the change subject to Commission approval before it takes effect. No firm action is required yet, but clearing participants and related risk/governance teams should review the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 100, Definitions, To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: The SEC published notice of MIAX Sapphire’s proposed rule change to shorten the review of customer order activity from quarterly to monthly for Professional Interest/Priority Customer designations. Members would need to review customer activity each month and update order classifications for the next month. Comments are being solicited; the change is proposed but not yet final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Clarify Language Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change to clarify its fee schedule so the free trial periods for its 1-minute and 10-minute Intraday Open-Close Historical Data products are separate and independent. The filing was published by the SEC for comment and became immediately effective on filing. It affects TPHs and non-TPHs using those data products; no implementation date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Clearance of Additional Credit Default Swap Contracts
summary: The SEC published a notice extending the time to act on ICE Clear Credit LLC’s proposed rule change to clear additional credit default swap contracts. The Commission sets August 25, 2026 as the new deadline to approve, disapprove, or start disapproval proceedings.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: MIAX Emerald filed a proposed rule change, immediately effective but subject to SEC notice-and-comment, to shorten the review of Professional Interest orders from quarterly to monthly. Members would have to review customer activity each month and update order designations within five days after month-end. The change applies to MIAX Emerald members trading listed options.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18-E Regarding Regulatory Halts for Corporate Actions and Issuer-Related Events
summary: NYSE Arca filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.18-E on regulatory halts and trading resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions and issuer-related events. The change is intended to support 23/5 trading and clarify when trading will be halted and reopened via a Trading Halt Auction. No filing deadline is stated in the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Relating to ICC's Fee Schedule
summary: ICE Clear Credit has filed a proposed change to its CDS client fee schedule, increasing discount levels under its Client Volume Incentive Program and adding a 100% discount above $6.94 million in annual billed fees. The change is immediately effective but will not be implemented until certified under CFTC Regulation 40.6. It applies to client clearing activity for ICC CDS clients.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Permit VIX Future-Option Orders
summary: The SEC extended its review period for Cboe Exchange’s proposed rule change to permit VIX future-option orders. The Commission must now approve or disapprove the filing by 2026-09-13. This is a procedural notice about a pending exchange rule, not a final requirement.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 4120 Regarding Regulatory Halts for Corporate Actions and Issuer-Related Events
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to amend Rule 4120 on regulatory halts and resumption of trading for securities subject to certain corporate actions and issuer-related events. It would apply to securities primarily listed on Nasdaq and is intended to support 23/5 trading. No compliance date is stated, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations: Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 100, Definitions, To Amend the Quarterly Review of Professional Interest Orders
summary: MIAX filed and made immediately effective a rule change to amend Rule 100 so members must review and reclassify customer orders monthly, not quarterly, for Professional Interest/Priority Customer treatment. Members must complete the review and any changes within five days after each calendar month-end.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a notice updating the identifying information for one or more persons on the SDN List. The updated listing continues the U.S. asset-freeze/blocking effect for persons whose property is subject to U.S. jurisdiction. Firms dealing with sanctions screening, payments, onboarding and customer remediation should update controls immediately.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Gold & Silver Products
summary: The U.S. Mint announced 2026 retail prices for three Freedom Ringing—Liberty Bell gold and silver products. This is an informational pricing notice for Mint products, with no compliance action or regulatory requirement for banks.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Suspension of and Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove the Proposed Rule Change To Amend the DTC Operational Arrangements (Necessary for Securities To Become and Remain Eligible for DTC Services)
summary: The SEC issued a notice suspending and instituting proceedings on DTC’s proposed rule change to update its operational arrangements for ATOP/ASOP agents and related corporate action processing. It is not the rule itself and does not create new requirements, but it signals continued review of the proposal and received comments. No compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule for Its Complex Order Book Data Feed
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Cboe Exchange proposal to amend its fee schedule for the Complex Order Book data feed, including expanding the Retail Broker Waiver Program to waive Internal Distributor Fees. This affects Cboe Options distributors and retail brokers; the filing is immediately effective but still open to SEC review and comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Partial Amendment No. 1 and Order Instituting Proceedings To Determine Whether To Approve or Disapprove a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, to Exempt Specified Collective Trust Funds From FINRA Rules 5130 (Restrictions on the Purchase and Sale of Initial Public Offerings) and 5131(b) (New Issue Allocations and Distributions)
summary: The SEC issued an order instituting proceedings on FINRA’s proposed rule change to exempt specified collective trust funds from FINRA new-issue rules 5130 and 5131(b), and is soliciting comments. The proposal would apply to certain collective trust funds if they were not formed or maintained to let restricted persons invest in new issues. No firm deadline is set in this notice beyond the comment/proceedings process.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Remove the Silexx Logical Port Fee Waiver in the Fee Schedule in Accordance With SEC Exemptive Relief Issued
summary: Cboe Exchange filed a proposed rule change, immediately effective under SEC procedures, to remove the Silexx logical port fee waiver from its fee schedule. The change is tied to prior SEC exemptive relief and was proposed to become operative on 2026-07-01. This affects exchange members and users of the Silexx OEMS.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Designation of Longer Period for Commission Action on Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Treasury Clearing Rules and Treasury Clearing Service Treasury Operations Policies and Liquidity Risk Management Framework
summary: The SEC published a notice extending the review period for ICE Clear Credit LLC’s proposed changes to its Treasury clearing rules, liquidity risk management framework and treasury operations policies. The Commission set August 24, 2026 as the new deadline to approve, disapprove, or start proceedings on the proposal. No direct obligations are created by this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Certain Rule Language Regarding its Handling of Orders and Other Miscellaneous Provisions
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on TXSE’s proposed rule changes to its order-handling and miscellaneous trading provisions, mainly to clarify and conform rule text for market orders and related functionality. No immediate compliance deadline is set in this notice. Comments are being invited on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Quarterly Review of Priority Customer Orders
summary: The SEC published MIAX Pearl’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend how Priority Customer Orders are reviewed and re-designated. The exchange would move from quarterly to monthly review, requiring members to reclassify affected customer orders for the next calendar month. This is a proposal open for comments, not a final rule, and applies to MIAX Pearl members and options market participants.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Fee Schedule
summary: MEMX filed a proposed change to its fee schedule, and the SEC is seeking comments. The exchange would remove an expired tier criterion, raise fees for certain retail sub-dollar liquidity-removal executions, and eliminate the Tape A liquidity-removal tier. The notice is not itself binding, but the filing is already immediately effective under exchange-rule procedures.

title: Coatue Innovative Strategies Fund and Coatue Management, L.L.C.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application from Coatue Innovative Strategies Fund and Coatue Management seeking exemptive relief under section 6(c) of the Investment Company Act to allow certain closed-end funds and business development companies to pay advisory fees in shares of common stock. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-03. This is a notice, not a rule or order.

title: Elevation Series Trust and CresAlta Investment Management, Inc.
summary: SEC notice announcing an application by Elevation Series Trust and CresAlta Investment Management for exemptive relief from shareholder approval and certain fee/disclosure requirements for subadvisory arrangements. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-03. This is an application notice, not a final order or rule.

title: VALIC Company I and The Variable Annuity Life Insurance Company
summary: SEC notice of an application by VALIC Company I and The Variable Annuity Life Insurance Company seeking exemptive relief from the Investment Company Act’s in-person meeting requirement for board approval of sub-advisory agreements and amendments. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-03. No rule is adopted in this notice.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on a Change in Bank Control Act application for the Garst Family Control Group to retain voting shares in Greene Investment Co. and indirectly in two Iowa banks. Comments are due by 2026-07-30. This is a notice of a pending ownership-control application, not a rule change.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC has added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-07-13 and is effective immediately. Sanctions screening and payment controls should be updated at once.

title: Churchill Asset Management LLC
summary: The SEC issued a notice of an application by Churchill Asset Management LLC for an exemptive order under the Investment Company Act of 1940. It concerns employee-related investment partnerships and requests relief from most Act provisions, subject to conditions and a hearing request deadline of 2026-08-07. This is a notice only; it does not itself change obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Definition of Professional To Require Monthly Reviews of Orders
summary: Cboe EDGX has filed a proposed rule change to move the Professional-order review and reclassification process from quarterly to monthly reviews, with affected options members needing to apply the new designation for the next month. The SEC is publishing the filing and requesting comments; no final effective date is set in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Review of Professional Orders
summary: MEMX has filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to shorten the review period for “Professional” options orders from quarterly to monthly. Members would need to reassess customer activity each month and represent qualifying orders as Professional orders for the next calendar month. The SEC is seeking comments, but the proposal is not yet a general market rule until the filing process is complete.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Rules To Permit the Listing of Binary Options Overlying Key Performance Indicators (“KPIs”) Reported by Certain Issuers of Stock (“Binary KPI Options”)
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on a Cboe proposed rule change to allow listing of binary options tied to issuer-reported KPIs. This would affect exchange-traded options products if approved, but it is not yet binding. No filing deadline is stated in the excerpt; firms should monitor the proposal and any later SEC approval date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq Texas, LLC; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as modified by Amendment No. 1, To Establish a Package of Complimentary Services
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to Nasdaq Texas’s proposed rule change to add Rule 5950, allowing certain newly listed or existing dually listed companies to receive one complimentary Nasdaq service for one year. Eligible companies may choose among stock surveillance, investor targeting, or market analytics tools, with the complimentary period starting on listing/approval or first use in some cases. Comments on Amendment No. 1 were also solicited.

title: Order Under Section 36 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the “Exchange Act”) and Rule 6h-1(d) Thereunder Granting Conditional Exemptive Relief to the Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc. From the Opening Price Settlement Requirements of Rule 6h-1(b) Under the Exchange Act for Certain Cash-Settled Security Futures
summary: The SEC issued an order granting CME conditional exemptive relief from Rule 6h-1(b)’s opening-price settlement requirement for certain cash-settled security futures, allowing settlement based on the closing price of the underlying security. This is a firm-specific exemption for CME, not a new generally applicable rule. No compliance deadline is set in the notice.

title: Notice of Proposals To Engage in or To Acquire Companies Engaged in Permissible Nonbanking Activities
summary: The FRB published a notice of bank holding company proposals to engage in or acquire companies conducting permissible nonbanking activities under Regulation Y. Interested persons may comment on the listed proposals by 2026-08-17. This is a U.S. notice process for bank holding companies and related acquisitions, not a rule change.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice that Ark Financial Holding, Inc. has applied to become a bank holding company by acquiring Cooper Lake Financial Corporation and its bank subsidiary. Interested persons may submit comments on the application by 2026-08-17.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published bank control notices for proposed acquisitions of shares in two US banking groups. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-07-31. This is a notice of applications, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Handling of Highly Sensitive Information During Examinations
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter pointing readers to a joint statement from the FDIC, Federal Reserve and OCC on handling highly sensitive information during examinations. The letter says the statement does not create new expectations and applies to all FDIC-supervised financial institutions. No compliance date or new obligation is stated.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a change to the timing of a previously scheduled closed Sunshine Act meeting, moving it from 2:00 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. on July 16, 2026. This is a meeting notice only and does not create any new obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.; Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Amendments to Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.'s Rules Governing Performance Bond Requirements: Account Holder Level
summary: The SEC approved CME’s rule change on performance bond and margin requirements for security futures at the account-holder level. The approved rule aligns CME’s rules with SEC and CFTC customer margin requirements, including a 15% base margin and specified offsets/exclusions for non-customers such as exempted persons and market makers. It is effective on approval, with CME and affected trading participants needing to implement the amended rulebook provisions.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Sapphire Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Extend the Temporary Discount Program for Historical Requests of Certain Open-Close Report Data Until December 31, 2026
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed a proposed rule change to extend, through 2026-12-31, its temporary 20% discount program for historical Open-Close Report data fees. The SEC is soliciting comments, so the change is not yet final, and it affects exchange data subscribers, including members and non-members.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Emerald Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Extend the Temporary Discount Program for Historical Requests of Certain Open-Close Report Data Until December 31, 2026
summary: MIAX Emerald filed a proposed rule change to extend until 2026-12-31 a temporary 20% discount on certain historical Open-Close Report data fees. This affects exchange data subscribers and purchasers of the report, including members and non-members. The SEC published the notice and is soliciting comments; the change is not yet final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Pearl Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Extend the Temporary Discount Program for Historical Requests of Certain Open-Close Report Data Until December 31, 2026
summary: MIAX Pearl filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to extend, through 2026-12-31, its temporary 20% discount on fees for certain historical Open-Close Report data requests. The filing is for exchange members and non-members purchasing this optional data product; comments are being solicited, but the fee change is already effective under SEC rule filing procedures.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Pearl Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Amend Certain Fees and Rebates Applicable to Transactions in Non-Penny Classes for All Origins
summary: MIAX Pearl filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fee schedule for non-Penny classes, increasing maker rebates and taker fees for Priority Customers, Market Makers, and Professional origin participants. The SEC is publishing the filing and soliciting comments. The change affects exchange users trading on MIAX Pearl and is already effective upon filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Options Regulatory Fee (ORF)
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its options regulatory fee schedule, setting the ORF at $0.0220 per contract side effective July 1, 2026 and clarifying how the fee is assessed and collected. The notice also explains the exchange’s monitoring approach for regulatory cost recovery and possible future fee adjustments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Emerald, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Options Regulatory Fee (ORF)
summary: MIAX Emerald filed an immediately effective exchange rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule and methodology. The notice sets the ORF at $0.0220 per contract side effective 2026-07-01 and clarifies how customer trades, clearing instructions and CMTA adjustments are handled. It applies to MIAX Emerald members and customer options transactions.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Definition of Professional To Require Monthly Reviews of Orders
summary: Cboe filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to shorten the review cycle for identifying “Professional” options customers from quarterly to monthly. Trading permit holder organizations would need to review customer order activity each month and reclassify accounts above the 390-orders-per-day threshold for the next month. The notice solicits comments; no separate compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change to Amend the Definition of Professional To Require Monthly Reviews of Orders
summary: Cboe BZX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options rules so customer accounts that average more than 390 orders per day in a month must be treated as Professional orders for the next month, with monthly rather than quarterly reviews. Options Members would need to update their review and designation process for listed options orders.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Definition of Professional To Require Monthly Reviews of Orders
summary: The SEC published Cboe C2’s proposed rule change to amend the definition of “Professional” in options trading, moving the review of customer order activity from quarterly to monthly. Trading permit holder organizations would need to review orders each month and reclassify eligible accounts for the next month. This is a proposal, not yet binding.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 1210 (Registration Requirements)
summary: FINRA has filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend FINRA Rule 1210 and shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed qualification exams. The SEC is publishing the notice and seeking comments. This affects FINRA member firms and registered persons, but no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public notice listing a financial institution now in receivership/liquidation, naming Kentland Federal Savings and Loan Association as closed on 2026-07-10. This is an updated “of record” notice for firms checking failed-institution status and related depositor/receivership actions. No filing or conduct obligations are created for banks beyond awareness and operational checks.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC added one or more persons to the SDN List, blocking their property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction and generally prohibiting U.S. persons from dealing with them. The action was issued on 2026-07-10 and is effective immediately for screening and blocking purposes.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC updated the identifying information for one person on the SDN List. The person’s property and interests in property remain blocked under U.S. jurisdiction. No filing or response deadline is set, but sanctions screening and list-management controls should reflect the updated entry immediately.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Collection of Qualitative Feedback on Agency Service Delivery
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-09-15 on an extension of an existing information collection for qualitative feedback on agency service delivery. There is no change to the collection itself; the notice is issued under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

title: Financial Institution Letter: GENIUS Act: Proposed Reporting Forms and Instructions for FDIC-Supervised Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuers
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter accompanying a proposed information collection for FDIC-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act. It provides notice of proposed weekly and quarterly reporting forms and instructions; no filing deadline is stated in the letter itself. It is aimed at FDIC-supervised financial institutions.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 904 and Rule 905 To Increase Position and Exercise Limits for Options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
summary: The SEC published a notice of NYSE American’s proposed rule change, filed with immediate effectiveness, to raise the position and exercise limits for options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF to 1,000,000 contracts. The notice invites comments, but the exchange change is already effective. Relevant teams should review trading, limits and surveillance impacts for options activity on IBIT.

title: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application from Kennedy Lewis Capital Company and related entities seeking an exemptive order to allow certain business development companies and closed-end funds to co-invest with affiliated investment entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-10. This is a notice, not a rule or order, so it creates no direct obligation yet.

title: Cliffwater Corporate Lending Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by several Cliffwater funds and affiliates for exemptive relief to co-invest in portfolio companies alongside certain affiliated funds and subsidiaries. Interested persons may request a hearing by August 10, 2026. This is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe EDGX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to raise its Options Regulatory Fee for customer-range options transactions occurring on the exchange, effective 2026-07-01, and to make related clarifying edits to the fee schedule. The SEC is soliciting comments on the filing. Firms trading or clearing EDGX options should review the fee impact and fee-billing mechanics.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of the Fourth Amendment to the Limited Liability Company Agreement of CT Plan LLC
summary: The SEC published notice of an immediately effective amendment to the CT Plan LLC agreement to add Texas Stock Exchange LLC as a member and reflect Nasdaq BX's name change to Nasdaq Texas. The notice also solicits public comments on whether the amendment is consistent with the Exchange Act. No new compliance deadline or rule requirement is created by the notice itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Options 7, Section 4
summary: The SEC published a Nasdaq PHLX proposed rule change, effective immediately on filing, to amend Options 7, Section 4. It would increase certain floor options transaction charges for Lead Market Makers and Market Makers and change Floor Broker rebate incentives. Market participants can comment on the proposal; no compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the PHLX Pricing Schedule at Options 7, Section 4, Multiply Listed Options Fees
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its options pricing schedule by excluding certain PIXL, SOM and facilitation contra-order transaction charges from the Monthly Market Maker Cap. This affects exchange members and market makers trading multiply listed options. The SEC is soliciting comments, but the change is already effective on filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 100, Definitions, and Rule 204, Members and Persons Associated With a Member Who Are or Become Subject to a Statutory Disqualification
summary: MIAX Sapphire has filed a proposed rule change to amend its rules on members and associated persons subject to statutory disqualification, including replacing the current 30-day application deadline with a uniform 10-business-day deadline. The SEC is seeking comments, so the change is not yet binding. The proposal affects exchange members and firms seeking admission, readmission, or continued membership.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the NYSE Arca Equities Fees and Charges
summary: NYSE Arca gave notice that it had immediately filed a fee change to waive the Gross FOCUS Fee for ETP Holders from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31. The filing is effective immediately but is subject to SEC notice-and-comment; it affects exchange fee billing rather than creating a broad new compliance regime.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Fee Schedule
summary: The SEC published a notice that MIAX filed and immediately made effective a proposed rule change to amend its options fee schedule. The changes raise maker fees for certain simple orders and add a new Priority Customer Rebate Program tier with new rebate and volume thresholds for MIAX market participants. Comments are being solicited; no filing deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Price List
summary: NYSE filed a proposed rule change to temporarily waive its Gross FOCUS fee for member organizations from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31. SEC published the filing and is seeking comments. The change affects NYSE member organizations and is effective immediately as filed, but it is still a proposal rather than a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe C2 filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule and raise the ORF for certain customer-range options trades cleared through OCC, effective July 1, 2026. The filing also makes clarifying and conforming fee-schedule edits. Comments are being solicited on the proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: Cboe Exchange filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, raising the ORF for customer-range options transactions to $0.01248 per contract under its new on-exchange methodology and making clarifying fee-schedule edits. It applies to Cboe Options participants and clearing firms, with the Exchange stating the new approach was effective July 1, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; National Securities Clearing Corporation; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change To Enhance NSCC's Clearing Fund Methodology
summary: The SEC approved NSCC’s proposed rule change to enhance its Clearing Fund methodology for exchange-traded products. The change affects NSCC members and their margin/clearing fund calculations under the NSCC Rules, with the approved methodology now binding for covered clearing activity in the U.S.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 11.23
summary: Cboe BZX filed and the SEC published notice of an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Exchange Rule 11.23 on auction pricing. The filing would revise the Collar Price Range and Collar Midpoint definitions and separate the price standards for IPO auctions in BZX-listed corporate securities and ETP IPO auctions. No compliance date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Renewal of the Agricultural Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced the renewal of its Agricultural Advisory Committee for two years. The committee will continue advising on agricultural derivatives markets, including hedging, trade execution, and emerging issues such as digital assets, blockchain and AI. No direct regulatory obligations are created for firms.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC published a notice adding one or more persons to the SDN List under U.S. sanctions authorities. U.S. persons are generally prohibited from dealing with the listed persons and any property or interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction are blocked. The action was issued on 2026-07-15 and published on 2026-07-20.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a closed Sunshine Act meeting for July 23, 2026, covering enforcement, administrative proceedings, litigation claims and examination matters. This is a meeting notice only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the FINRA Rule 6300 Series (Trade Reporting Facilities) To Extend the Trade Reporting Facilities Operating Hours to 23 Hours Per Day, Five Days Per Week
summary: FINRA has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to extend Trade Reporting Facility operating hours to 23 hours per day, five days per week, and to align related FINRA reporting rules. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal. This affects FINRA members that report OTC trades in NMS stocks, with no stated compliance date in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 6.8-O To Increase Position and Exercise Limits for Options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
summary: NYSE Arca filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to raise the position and exercise limits for options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) to 1,000,000 contracts. The SEC is seeking comments on the filing; no firm compliance date is stated in the excerpt. The change affects market participants trading IBIT options on NYSE Arca.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change Relating to the Operational Risk Management Framework
primary_functions: Compliance; Risk; Operational resilience; InfoSec; Board
summary: The SEC approved ICE Clear Credit’s proposed changes to its Operational Risk Management Framework. The revisions are mostly terminology and governance updates, but also add information-security reporting to the Operational Oversight Committee and make the Board Risk Committee a required reviewer. ICC must now operate under the approved framework.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The FRB published a notice of Change in Bank Control Act filings for proposed acquisitions or retention of voting shares in named bank holding companies and banks. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-05. This is a notice of applications, not a rule change, and it applies to the named US banking organisations and their shareholders.

title: Agricultural Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announces a public meeting of its Agricultural Advisory Committee on 29 July 2026. The committee will discuss Basel III topics, risk management tools for agricultural end users, 24/7 trading, and emerging markets. Public comments on the meeting may be submitted by 7 August 2026, but the notice itself does not change any rules.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; ICE Clear Credit LLC; Notice of Proposed Rule Change to the Risk Management Model Description for the CDS Clearing Service
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on ICE Clear Credit’s proposed rule change to its CDS clearing risk model. ICC would revise the risk management model description, including a new Profit Given Default concept and enhancements to contagion/wrong-way risk methodology. The filing says the changes would take effect only after SEC approval; no compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified and Superseded by Amendment No. 1, To Amend Rule 4.21 (Series of FLEX Options)
summary: The SEC approved, on an accelerated basis, a Cboe rule change amending Rule 4.21 for FLEX options on ETF underlyings. The change raises eligibility thresholds for newly FLEX-eligible ETFs to qualify for cash settlement, adds tiered treatment if an ETF later falls below the criteria, and removes the cap limiting cash settlement to 50 underlying ETFs. It is effective on approval and affects Cboe options participants.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; LCH SA; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change Relating To Providing Clearing Services for Fee Grid for the Triparty Collateral Mechanism
summary: LCH SA filed an immediately effective proposed rule change with the SEC to expand triparty collateral eligibility to certain CADES, UK government, and U.S. government securities and to amend its fee grid for those assets. The notice solicits public comments; implementation is expected from 2026-07-10 or later once approvals are in place. It affects LCH SA clearing members.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change by The Options Clearing Corporation Concerning the Synthetic Futures Model
summary: The SEC published notice of OCC’s immediately effective proposed rule change to expand use of its Synthetic Futures Model in STANS so it can margin additional futures products, including new CFE Lead & Lag Futures and similar futures listed later. The notice solicits public comments; no filing deadline or in-force date is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; 24X National Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Limited Liability Agreement for 24X Bermuda Holdings LLC To Provide for Board Observer Roles
summary: The SEC published a notice of 24X National Exchange LLC’s proposed rule change, filed with immediate effectiveness, to amend 24X Bermuda Holdings LLC’s agreement to create non-voting board observer roles for Rakuten and Shinhan. Interested persons may submit comments. This affects the exchange and its governance arrangements, not customer-facing products, and no compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend FINRA Rule 4515.01 (Allocations of Orders Made by Investment Advisers)
summary: FINRA has filed a proposed rule change to expand the exception in Rule 4515.01 for allocations of investment adviser bulk orders, so members would not need principal approval if allocation instructions are received after the trade date. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal; no compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adopt the Initial Schedule of Fees and Rebates Applicable to Members of the Exchange and Adopt a Monthly Membership Fee
summary: The SEC published notice of TXSE’s proposed rule change to introduce its initial fee and rebate schedule and a monthly membership fee for members, effective when the exchange begins operating. The notice solicits public comment on the filing. This is relevant to exchange access, trading costs, and rule-change monitoring, but it is not itself a final rule.

title: 360 Funds and M3Sixty Capital, LLC
summary: SEC notice of an application by 360 Funds and M3Sixty Capital, LLC seeking exemptive relief to allow subadvisory agreements to be entered into or materially amended without shareholder approval and to relieve certain fee-related disclosure requirements. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-10. This is a notice only; it does not itself change rules.

title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
summary: OFAC removed certain Hong Kong-related names from the SDN List and moved other names to the NS-MBS List under the Hong Kong Autonomy Act. U.S.-jurisdiction property blocking ended for persons designated only under the now-terminated Hong Kong emergency, while HKAA sanctions continue for the transferred names. Firms should update sanctions screening and watchlists immediately.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend IEX Rule 16.160 Regarding Information Circular Requirements
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on IEX’s proposed rule change to amend Rule 16.160 for UTP exchange-traded products. The proposal would remove a duplicative information-circular requirement, add cross-references, and revise when written descriptions must be delivered. It affects IEX members and market participants; no compliance date is set in this notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule General 8 Regarding Intrafirm Cabinet Connectivity
summary: Nasdaq has filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to expressly classify non-contiguous intrafirm cabinet connectivity as Fiber connectivity under Rule General 8 and remove it from the custom installation provision. The filing would also amend related fees and pricing disclosure. It is a proposal open for comment, not yet binding.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified and Superseded by Amendment No. 1, To Amend Its Rules Related to Binary Options
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to a Cboe Exchange rule change, as amended, that revises binary options rules. The change narrows the scope to the Cboe Magnificent 10 Index and updates how binary index options may be listed and how position limits apply. It is effective on approval and affects exchange options activity.

title: Herzfeld Credit Income Fund, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application for exemptive relief allowing certain business development companies and closed-end funds to co-invest with affiliated entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-11. This is a notice only; it does not itself create new obligations.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15c6-2
summary: The SEC requested comment on extending the PRA information collection for Rule 15c6-2, which supports broker-dealers’ policies and recordkeeping for same-day allocation, confirmation and affirmation in institutional trades. This is a notice about paperwork approval, not a new rule. Comments are sought before OMB approves the collection; no new compliance date is stated.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 613 of Regulation NMS
summary: The SEC is seeking public comments for an extension of the Paperwork Reduction Act clearance tied to Rule 613 of Regulation NMS and the CAT NMS Plan. It does not create new requirements; it is a notice about existing information collections and OMB approval, affecting participants in the CAT framework.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 17a-10
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day PRA notice seeking comments on extending the existing information collection under Rule 17a-10 for broker-dealers’ FOCUS and related annual filings. Comments are due by 2026-09-21. This is a notice request, not a rule change.

title: Update to Notice of Financial Institutions for Which the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Has Been Appointed Either Receiver, Liquidator, or Manager
summary: The FDIC updated its public notice of institutions for which it has been appointed receiver, liquidator, or manager. The notice lists Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas, as placed into receivership effective 2026-07-17. This is informational and updates the official failed-bank record; it does not impose a new compliance deadline.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection Renewal; Comment Request
summary: FDIC requests public comment on renewing an existing information collection for regulatory capital rules (OMB 3064-0153) by 2026-08-24. It does not itself change the rule; it only seeks comments on burden and recordkeeping/disclosure requirements for insured state nonmember banks and state savings associations. The FDIC also notes a related NPRM that may later revise the collection.

title: Quarterly Publication of Individuals, Who Have Chosen To Expatriate
summary: IRS notice publishing the quarterly list of individuals who expatriated and lost U.S. citizenship for the quarter ending 2026-06-30. It is informational only and does not impose requirements on firms. No action date applies to the reader.

title: Apogem Capital LLC, et al.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief allowing specified BDCs, closed-end and open-end investment companies, and affiliated entities to co-invest in portfolio companies. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-17; otherwise the Commission may grant the order. This is a notice, not a rule or order, so it does not itself create obligations.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Establish the Options Regulatory Fee (ORF) Under the New Methodology for Transactions That Occur on the Exchange
summary: MEMX filed a proposed amendment to its options fee schedule to set an on-exchange Options Regulatory Fee rate of $0.0200 per contract side, effective immediately, and to tidy related fee text. The notice applies to MEMX members and options market participants trading on the exchange. No filing deadline is set, but the fee change is already effective under the exchange filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; CME Securities Clearing Inc.; Order Approving Proposed Rule Change To Support Members' Risk Management of and Enhance Their Ability To Authorize Persons as Users
summary: The SEC approved a CME Securities Clearing Inc. rule change that updates member rights around authorized users, including termination rights, secondary security interests in user funds, and participation in close-out of a defaulting user’s positions. The change is relevant for members that are banks or bank affiliates and supports capital treatment and risk management. It is effective as approved; no comment deadline remains.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: The SEC is publishing NYSE Texas’s proposed rule change, filed under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1), to add MX2 Options to the list of third-party data feeds available for connectivity and charge a $2,000 monthly fee. The change would become operative as soon as practicable after the MX2 Options feed goes live, currently announced for 2026-09-14. Comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; BOX Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend BOX Rule 3060 (Gratuities) To Conform With FINRA Rule 3220
summary: The SEC published BOX Exchange’s proposed rule change to amend Rule 3060 on gratuities so it matches FINRA Rule 3220 and can be treated as a common rule under the 17d-2 agreement. This is a consultation and comment solicitation, not a final rule. It affects BOX Exchange members and common members with FINRA; no compliance date is stated.

title: Change in Bank Control Notices; Acquisitions of Shares of a Bank or Bank Holding Company
summary: The Federal Reserve published a change-in-bank-control notice for proposed retention of voting shares in a Florida bank holding company and its bank by members of the France Family Control Group. Interested persons may submit comments by 2026-08-10. This is a public notice of an application, not a rule or enforcement action.

title: Cboe Clear U.S., LLC; Notice of Filing of an Application, as Amended, for Temporary Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on Cboe Clear U.S., LLC’s amended application for temporary registration as a clearing agency under Exchange Act Section 17A to provide central counterparty services for binary options securities. This is not a final approval; it is a notice seeking input on the application and proposed rules, with no compliance date stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.190 to Permit Trading of Pegged Orders During Pre-Market and Post-Market Sessions
summary: The SEC published an IEX proposed rule change that would let pegged orders and D-Limit orders trade during pre-market and post-market sessions, instead of only in the regular session. It is a notice seeking comment on the change and does not itself impose a new requirement. IEX submitted the filing as non-controversial under Rule 19b-4(f)(6).

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing of Partial Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4 To Establish Listing Criteria and Withdrawal Standards for Options on Commodity-Based Trusts That Hold Multiple Crypto Assets
summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to MEMX’s rule change allowing options to be listed and traded on commodity-based trusts that hold multiple crypto assets, subject to stated market-cap and surveillance-sharing criteria. The exchange’s amended rules also renumber related listing provisions. This is effective immediately on approval, with the notice also soliciting comment on the partial amendment.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Modify Rules 971.1NYP and 971.2NYP To Allow FLEX Options To Trade in Its CUBE Auction for Single-Leg and Complex Orders
summary: The SEC published a notice of NYSE American’s proposed rule change, filed with immediate effectiveness, to let FLEX Options trade in the exchange’s CUBE auction for single-leg and complex orders. This affects market structure and options trading participants on NYSE American. There is no stated firm action date in the notice, but comments are being solicited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 13.003 Related to Proxy Voting
summary: The SEC issued a notice extending the deadline to act on TXSE’s proposed exchange rule change on proxy voting. The Commission now has until 2026-09-09 to approve, disapprove, or institute proceedings. This is a procedural timing notice only; it does not itself change any rule or create new obligations.
